izzyondroid:org.wbftw.weil.sos_flashligh.name: SOS Flashlight: Advanced Morse Code Tool

izzyondroid:org.wbftw.weil.sos_flashligh.description:
SOS Flashlight App transforms your smartphone into a powerful Morse code signaling device, capable of transmitting emergency messages or custom text through multiple channels simultaneously.
 Features 
 Signal Transmission Methods Flashlight : Utilizes your device's camera led flashlight to transmit visual signals.
 Vibration : Sends tactile signals through device vibration.
 Audio : Generates clear audio tones at 700Hz frequency.
 Screen Light : Maximizes screen brightness to create visual signals in darkness.
 Core Capabilities Background Service : Continue signaling even when the app is minimized or screen is locked.
 Message Customization : Send any custom message in Morse code.
 Adjustable Speed : Choose from slow, medium, fast, or custom transmission speeds.
 Morse Code Decoder : Convert received Morse code into readable text.
 User Preferences : Independently toggle each signaling method based on your needs.
 Usage 
 Emergency SOS : Press the SOS button to immediately begin transmitting the international SOS signal (... --- ...).
 Custom Message : Enter your text in the input field and press "Send" to convert and transmit.
 Decoder : Navigate to the decoder screen to translate incoming Morse code signals.
 Settings : Customize transmission speed and toggle different signaling methods.
 Contribute 
 Contributions are welcome! Feel free to open issues or submit pull requests on our GitHub repo.
 License 
 This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License (GPLv3) - see the LICENSE file for details.
 Source 
 https://github.com/WeilJimmer/SOSFlashlightApp.git

fdroid:com.cax.pmk.ext.name: Extended emulator of МК 61/54
fdroid:com.cax.pmk.ext.summary: Emulator of "Electronika МК 61/54" RPN programmable calculators.
fdroid:com.cax.pmk.ext.description:
МК 61 was the best seller of all USSR programmable calculators of 1980-s (B3-34, MK-54, MK-56, MK-61, MK-52).
Calculators are emulated on microcode level so they behave exactly like the original devices, including all non-documented features and inaccurate calculations. For ease of use application features saving and loading emulation states.
This app's emulation engine Java code is based on C++ source of Felix Lazarev's emu145 project.
Emulation was highly optimized for speed and should run in real time on any phone.
It's an extended version of the original emulator МК 61/54 by Stanislav Borutsky
(https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cax.pmk). This version allows to export/import programs from external files and contains some UI improvements.
Hint 0: you can found the list of all tips in the About dialog
Hint 1: touch calculator's indicator to toggle slow/fast mode. Indicator's blinking looks better in slow mode.
Hint 2: you can choose between MK-61 and MK-54 using menu option that becomes visible when calculator is switched off. 
Hint 3: with the menu "Import" you can import programs from external files, several such programs you can find in https://xvadim.github.io/xbasoft/pmk/pmk.html
Hit 4: you can open menu by long tap on the "Вкл" label.

fdroid:com.groce.app.name: Groce
fdroid:com.groce.app.summary: Grocery, to-do, and packing lists, ordered by store aisle or category. No ads.
fdroid:com.groce.app.description:
Groce is a practical list app for everyday life: grocery shopping, to-do tasks, and packing for trips — all in one place, without distractions.
Free. Open source. No ads. No analytics. No tracking. No account required.
GROCERY LIST — SHOP BY AISLE
The standout feature: define the aisles in your own store and assign each item to its aisle. Your shopping list is always displayed in aisle order — you walk through the store once, in order, never doubling back and never frantically scanning the list before moving to the next aisle. Once you've tried it, you won't shop any other way.
Keep a full catalogue of items and use the "Needed" view to see only what you're currently out of. Mark staples as weekly recurring so they're easy to add back each week.
TO-DO LISTS
Create as many named to-do lists as you need, organised by category in your own order. Tasks can be marked recurring so they're easy to re-add each time you start fresh.
PACKING LIST
Pack for a trip without forgetting anything. Items are grouped by category in your chosen order — everything grouped logically, no hunting through the list. Recurring items (passport, charger, and so on) can be set once and reused for every trip.
SHARING
Share a grocery, to-do, or packing list with other users.
PRIVACY
All data is stored in plain CSV files on your device. This F-Droid build has no network access. Nothing is sent to any server.
BACKUP
Export and import your lists as CSV files from the Settings screen. The full version also supports automatic Google Drive backup.

fdroid:com.jjrapps.bebeagua.name: Drink Water!
fdroid:com.jjrapps.bebeagua.summary: Track water intake and get timely reminders. No accounts or ads.
fdroid:com.jjrapps.bebeagua.description:
Drink Water! is a simple app for logging the water you drink each day and getting reminders throughout the day, with no accounts, no ads and nothing sent off your phone.
The home screen is built for speed: one tap logs the amount you used last time. If you want something different today, switch between the sizes you have set up or type a custom amount with "Other amount…". A progress ring shows what you have drunk against your goal, and below it you will find today's records, which you can delete if you make a mistake.
Reminders are spread evenly between the start and end times you choose, with as many alerts as you like. They stop once you reach your goal, are recalculated every time you log water, and the home screen shows when the next one is due. They vibrate without making a sound, so your phone can stay in sound mode without being disturbed; if you wear a paired watch, the alert reaches it too. If you prefer, you can turn on skipping the reminder that would land right after you drink.
From the notification itself you can log your usual amount or snooze the alert for 15 minutes. There are also two home screen widgets, a 1x1 and a 2x1 that also shows today's progress. One tap logs your usual amount without opening the app.
At the end of the day you can get a summary notification (11:00 PM by default, with a configurable time, and you can turn it off) with what you drank against your goal. Each day in the history also opens a detail screen with its entries, where you can delete any you like.
History covers the last 30 days with each day's total, the average, your best day and your current streak. You can pick the language (automatic, Spanish or English) and the theme (automatic, light or dark), read what is new in each version inside the app, and email the author from Settings.
Your privacy: there are no accounts, no cloud, no ads and no tracking. Your records and settings are stored only on your device. The code is open source under the MIT license.
Main features:
- One-tap water logging with the last amount you used.
- Configurable sizes and a custom amount option.
- Daily progress ring and today's list of records.
- Reminders spread across your time window, with the number of alerts you choose.
- Alerts that vibrate without sound, forwarded to a paired watch.
- Option to skip the reminder right after you drink.
- Quick notification actions: log your amount or snooze for 15 minutes.
- 1x1 and 2x1 home screen widgets (the latter with today's progress) to log with a single tap.
- End-of-day summary notification at the time you choose.
- 30-day history with average, best day and streaks, plus a detail screen for each day.
- Automatic, Spanish or English language; automatic, light or dark theme.
- No accounts, no ads, no tracking: your data never leaves your device.

fdroid:com.nfcarchiver.banana_split.name: Banana Split
fdroid:com.nfcarchiver.banana_split.summary: Split secrets into QR-code shards using Shamir's Secret Sharing
fdroid:com.nfcarchiver.banana_split.description:
Banana Split uses Shamir's Secret Sharing to split secrets into QR-code shards. Any majority of shards can reconstruct the secret — fewer reveal nothing.
 How it works 
1. Enter your secret (e.g., a seed phrase, private key, password).
2. Choose how many shards to create and how many are required to reconstruct.
3. Use the auto-generated passphrase or enter your own.
4. Banana Split encrypts the secret with the passphrase, then splits the ciphertext into N QR codes using Shamir's scheme.
5. Print or save the QR codes. Write the passphrase by hand on every sheet.
To reconstruct: scan a majority of QR code shards, enter the passphrase, and your secret is restored.
 Features 
• Offline — all cryptography happens on-device, no server communication
• Save shards as PNGs or PDF with full Unicode font support
• Open saved shards in another app, save them to Downloads or any folder, or share them
• Camera and gallery QR scanning with multi-file import
• Custom or auto-generated passphrases
• User-selectable quorum (how many shards needed)
• 9 languages: English, Russian, Turkish, Belarusian, Georgian, Ukrainian, Polish, Spanish, Italian
• Cross-platform shard compatibility with the Banana Split web app
 Security 
Encryption: scrypt key derivation + NaCl secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305).
Splitting: Shamir's Secret Sharing over GF(256).
No data collection, no analytics, no trackers.
 Web App 
Also available as a web app — no installation needed: https://nfcarchiver.com/banana/
Shards created in the app and web version are fully compatible.
 Open Source 
This app is a fork of banana_split by Parity Technologies, licensed under GPLv3.
Source code: https://github.com/mezinster/banana_split

fdroid:dev.forgesworn.cambium.name: Cambium
fdroid:dev.forgesworn.cambium.summary: NIP-55 signer that holds no keys: signing is proxied to a NIP-46 hardware bunker
fdroid:dev.forgesworn.cambium.description:
Cambium is an Android NIP-55 signer that holds no user keys. Cryptographic results come from a paired Heartwood hardware signer over NIP-46 (Nostr relays), with only safe, exact repeats answered from bounded per-identity caches.
Amethyst, Primal and most other Amber-compatible Android Nostr clients cannot log in to a remote NIP-46 bunker directly, but they all support signing in via any installed NIP-55 external signer. Cambium fills that gap: it registers as a signer, but it is not one. It is a thin proxy that sends uncached NIP-55 work to your hardware signer and hands the result back.
Security model:
- No user secrets ever touch the phone. Cambium stores only the bunker pairing (the paired signer's public key, its relay list, and the per-pairing connection secret) and Cambium's own ephemeral NIP-46 client keypair. Compromising the phone exposes the ability to request signatures — which the hardware signer's policy engine and physical confirmation button still gate — never the identity key itself.
- All pairing state lives in Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage.
- Per-app approval is tracked locally, in addition to whatever the hardware signer's own policy enforces. The signer remains the authority on what actually gets signed.
- All NIP-46 payloads are NIP-44-encrypted.
- Phone unlock is the one exception, and it is opt-in: a Heartwood set up to be unlocked from this phone gives it an unlock secret for that board. It signs nothing, is useless without the board's own flash, and is released only by your screen lock, once per unlock.
Features:
- Pair by QR scan or pasted bunker:// URI; multiple identities, each fully isolated.
- NIP-55 intent handling: get_public_key, sign_event, nip04/nip44 encrypt and decrypt, decrypt_zap_event (private zaps, recipient path), current_user identity selection.
- Website NIP-55 support through nostrsigner: links, with explicit one-shot approval and a validated HTTPS callback or clipboard result. Browser approval is never remembered.
- A silent content-provider path answers already-approved apps without any visible popup.
- Per-identity bounded priority queues reserve room for user work. Exact relay-authentication duplicates coalesce and cache briefly; distinct AUTH bursts are admitted one at a time, never retried internally, and paused for 60 seconds after a transport failure.
- Native approvals can be once, for an hour or day, or indefinite, with operation and signing-kind limits. Review, edit or forget choices in the connected-apps list; denial remains permanent.
- Clear request summaries and bounded, temporary request details, with private and encrypted content hidden.
- Rename paired identities, check connection health and last contact, and explicitly test or reconnect. Supported signers can securely update their NIP-46 transport relays.
- Native NIP-55 signing batches return ordered results and per-request rejections.
- Optional keep-warm foreground service so silent signing skips the reconnect penalty.
- Phone unlock: a Heartwood that restarts locked after a power cut asks this phone to unlock it. The notification names the board, why it restarted and on which network, and warns that anyone holding the board can make it ask. One tap and your screen lock unlock it. Nothing on the wire names the phone.
- Says when a paired signer has gone quiet (a power cut or network problem at the board).
- A metadata-only activity log with safe failure categories, timings and app/identity/outcome filters. Review a redacted diagnostic report before explicitly sharing it; no event content, credentials, relay addresses or identifying labels are exported.
- Optional biometric or device-credential app lock on the management screen and approval decisions.
No Google Play services, no Firebase, no analytics. Runs on any 64-bit Android 8.1+ device, including GrapheneOS.

fdroid:io.github.quantember.lector.name: Lector
fdroid:io.github.quantember.lector.summary: Text to speech (TTS) reader for TXT, PDF & EPUB: free, private, offline
fdroid:io.github.quantember.lector.description:
Lector is a text to speech (TTS) reader: it reads your documents aloud — beautifully, privately, and completely free.
Open a TXT, Markdown, EPUB, or PDF — a single file or a whole folder — or paste text, or share to Lector from any app. Lector turns it into a clean, paged reader and reads it to you using your device's own text-to-speech voices, highlighting the current sentence as it goes. Turn any ebook or document into a spoken audiobook.
Features:
* Text-to-speech (TTS) read-aloud for TXT, Markdown, EPUB, PDF, and other text files
* Works with any installed TTS engine and voice (choose voice and language)
* A real library: scan a folder and Lector remembers your books
* Picks up where you left off in every document
* Page view with a slider to move through a whole book
* Adjustable speech speed, sleep timer, and background-friendly controls
Private by design: no ads, no accounts, no trackers, no network access, and no permissions at all. Your text never leaves your device. Speech is generated on-device by the text to speech engine already on your phone.
Free and open source (GPLv3).

The Home Assistant Companion app allows you to access your Home Assistant instance on the go. Home Assistant is the smart home solution focused on privacy, choice, and sustainability. It runs locally in your home via a device like the Home Assistant Green or Raspberry Pi.

fdroid:org.fedisuite.mobile.name: FediSuite
fdroid:org.fedisuite.mobile.summary: Schedule, manage and analyze Fediverse accounts on any FediSuite instance
fdroid:org.fedisuite.mobile.description:
FediSuite is an open platform for the Fediverse: plan posts in a calendar, collect drafts, automatically split long posts into threads, see reach and engagement, and manage multiple accounts across 20+ platforms, including Mastodon, Pixelfed, PeerTube, Misskey, Friendica, WordPress (via the ActivityPub plugin) and BizzFed.
The whole stack is open source under the GPL-3.0, with no Google Play and no tracking. Official website: https://www.fedisuite.com
To use this app you first need an account on a FediSuite instance. A list of public instances that accept new registrations is available at https://www.fedisuite.com/instances. You can also run your own instance, the server source code is freely available too. Reach, the calendar and drafts need an instance running FediSuite 2.0 or newer.
 The Android app 
This is a real native Android client, not a WebView wrapper and not a shrunk-down desktop clone. It connects to the FediSuite instance you choose and brings the most important workflows to your phone:
 Keep an eye on multiple Fediverse accounts from one dashboard, with compact analytics on follower growth, engagement, best posting times and tips
 See reach per account: net and gross estimates, trend, top posts and a short explanation of how the estimate is made
 Write posts, attach media and alt text, and publish right away, plan with a date and time picker, or save as a draft
 Where the platform supports it: send a post as plain text, Markdown or HTML; hashtags, mentions and links are colored while you write
 Reopen and finish drafts later, including drafts you started on the web
 Calendar for a month or a week with filters for status and account; move, publish now, send again, take back to drafts, copy or delete posts right there
 Browse your posts by status, follow the delivery status after publishing and send failed posts again
 View and disconnect connected accounts
 Use the admin area if your account has the right permissions on that instance
 Sign in securely, also with a two-factor code; signing out ends the session on the server as well
 Available in German, English, French, Spanish and Italian
Built for touchscreens: large tap targets, cards instead of tables, dark and light theme. No Google Play required, no tracking, no ads. License: GPL-3.0.

 FEATURES 
 Item Management

• Quick photo registration - snap a photo to register instantly
• Switch toggle to manage task status
• Visual distinction for active tasks
• Swipe left to delete, swipe right to archive
• Drag & drop to reorder items
 Smart Reminders 
• Periodic notifications: "Anything to put in your pocket?"
• Tap "Yes" to open app, "No" to dismiss
• Notifications don't pile up - stays as one
• Configurable interval and quiet hours
 Persistent Status 
• Always-visible notification when tasks are active
• Silent, non-dismissible notification
• Shows active tasks
 Privacy First 
• Works completely offline
• No accounts, no tracking
• No Google Services required
• Your data stays on your device
• Open source (GPL-3.0)

apple-itunes:914635909.name: Divine Office
apple-itunes:914635909.description:
The Divine Office App is an opportunity for you to participate in the recitation of the Liturgy of the Hours, an ancient and meditative collection of psalms, hymns and scripture that represent the public prayer of the Christian community.
If you are unable to pray in community, but love the contentment of praying with others, a praised feature of the Divine Office App lets you view locations where other Christians around the world are simultaneously praying with you.
This version is the official prayer book of the Catholic Church, however, it is suitable for all Christian faith traditions. It contains the official text and audio of daily prayers from the Liturgy of the Hours of the Roman Catholic Church (Breviary) and has been approved for use in the United States by USCCB.
The Divine Office App is designed to make praying more convenient, enjoyable, and simple enough for anyone to use. It automatically downloads the appropriate prayers for each office, every day of the year, including Solemnities, Feasts, and Memorials.
When St. Paul advises us in 1 Thessalonians 5:17 to “pray without ceasing,” he intends more than simply bowing our heads and speaking to God on a regular basis. He means for us to adopt an ongoing attitude of prayer that is a way of life and a constant intercession for the salvation of all mankind.
As the mystical body of Christ prays in unison, it fulfills what Paul advises as Christian conduct, that believers at once pray for the good of themselves, their neighbors, and the world. In this way, prayers become liturgy, a way to fulfill our divine calling and a practical approach for addressing the suffering of the world.

apple-itunes:629666111.name: Scenic Map
apple-itunes:629666111.description:
A 3D topo map with coverage of the entire world. The map is streamed directly from Apple's servers and cached on your device for use when there is no cell coverage. Use Scenic Map in a car, a boat, a plane or while hiking. It is like having the entire Earth in your pocket. Satellite image overlays add breathtaking detail and realism to the maps (tap preset 2 or 4). You can use them as you travel to see what is hidden from view at ground level. This takes moving maps to a whole new level.
To get started, tap the arrow button in the toolbar to begin GPS tracking and center the map at your current location. The spinner in the status bar shows that the map is being loaded. The spinner stops when the map is fully cached at that location. You can scroll around the map or tilt the map with a two finger vertical swipe to see it in 3D.
Use the two finger vertical swipe gesture to tilt the map for a 3D view. Scroll like a map or fly like a flight simulator. Enable Joystick Gestures in the Settings menu and then fly around the terrain using a virtual joystick. Prefer only 2D maps? Enable the 2D Map option in the Settings menu.
Scenic Map is simply the best 3D topo map available for a mobile device. You will see incredible detail while scrolling, rotating and zooming perfectly smoothly. You will see every road even if you zoom out to the altitude of a satellite. As you zoom in, you will see every small bump and hollow of the Earth and terrain features as small as ten meters. Unlike old fashioned topo maps, Scenic Map’s roads and trails are up to date thanks to OpenStreetMap.org. It contains polygons for urban areas, shopping malls, an ever growing number of buildings and many other features, The best lake, pond, stream and rivers from the USGS and Canadian public databases are also included.
Your tracks can be replayed with video like controls to speed up, slow down, pause, restart or skip to the end. You can display existing tracks while recording another if you want to retrace your route. When online, you can automatically create a route from your current GPS location to any other point on the map. Tracks can be received from or sent to other apps in GPX format. GPS recording stops automatically after you have remained stationary for some time or you can choose to manually stop tracking by tapping on the top track in the Tracks view.
Never before have maps been this customizable. For example, you can turn on or off the roads. You can change the lighting direction or remove terrain shading entirely. You can display contour lines even over satellite images. There are five presets which let you quickly switch between map styles. Use Metric, English or Nautical units and choose one of four different coordinate displays including UTM.
Want to learn more about a map feature? Tap the target icon and center the feature under the compass rose to display its name, type, urban area, county, state, elevation and coordinates. You will also see a bearing line back to your current GPS location or from your location to a selected waypoint. The status bar shows the bearing direction and distance along with the map and GPS elevation, the track length, and your current speed and direction of travel.
In-app documentation is provided in the Help section at the top of the Settings menu. Links are provided in the documentation to detailed coverage maps, tutorial videos, installation guide and blog at ScenicMap.com
Map data © OpenStreetMap and contributors under the Open Database License 
Scenic Map supports GPS tracking while the app is in the background.
Caution: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

 line based.

 The response can be viewed either as syntax highlighted code, with JSON even being made readable,
 as the raw output, which means no syntax highlighting, and view it in a webview.

 Sending custom POST data
 Syntax highlighting for all responses
 Preview for HTML response

fedora-packages:atool/atool.description: atool is a script for managing file archives of various types. It includes aunpack (to extract archives), apack (to create archives), als (to list files), acat (to extract files to the standard output), etc. atool relies on external programs to handle the archives. It determines the archive types using file extensions whenever possible, with a fallback on 'file'. It includes support for tarballs, Gzip, Bzip, Bzip2, Lzop, Lzma, Pkzip, Rar, Ace, Arj, RPM, CPIO, Arc, 7z, Alzip.

fedora-packages:bison/bison.name: bison
fedora-packages:bison/bison.description: Bison is a general purpose parser generator that converts a grammar description for an LALR(1) context-free grammar into a C program to parse that grammar. Bison can be used to develop a wide range of language parsers, from ones used in simple desk calculators to complex programming languages. Bison is upwardly compatible with Yacc, so any correctly written Yacc grammar should work with Bison without any changes. If you know Yacc, you shouldn't have any trouble using Bison. You do need to be very proficient in C programming to be able to use Bison. Bison is only needed on systems that are used for development. If your system will be used for C development, you should install Bison.

fedora-packages:perl-HTML-LinkList/perl-.name: perl-HTML-LinkList

fedora-packages:perl-HTML-LinkList/perl-.description: This module contains a number of functions for taking sets of URLs and labels and creating suitably formatted HTML. These links are "smart" because, if given the url of the current page, if any of the links in the list equal it, that item in the list will be formatted as a special label, not as a link; this is a Good Thing, since the user would be confused by clicking on a link back to the current page. While many website systems have plugins for "smart" navbars, they are specialized for that system only, and can't be reused elsewhere, forcing people to reinvent the wheel. I hereby present one wheel, free to be reused by anybody; just the simple functions, a backend, which can be plugged into whatever system you want.The default format for the HTML is to make an unordered list, but there are many options, enabling one to have a flatter layout with any separators you desire, or a more complicated list with differing formats for different levels.

fedora-packages:perl-HTML-Template/perl-.description: This module attempts make using HTML templates simple and natural. It extends standard HTML with a few new HTML-esque tags - <TMPL_VAR>, <TMPL_LOOP>, <TMPL_INCLUDE>, <TMPL_IF> and <TMPL_ELSE>. The file written with HTML and these new tags is called a template. It is usually saved separate from your script - possibly even created by someone else! Using this module you fill in the values for the variables, loops and branches declared in the template. This allows you to separate design - the HTML - from the data, which you generate in the Perl script.

bluejetty:00116723:ios.name: Idle Cult Empire - Evil Tycoon
bluejetty:00116723:ios.summary: Welcome to Idle Cult Empire, a tycoon-style experience where you build and expand your own mysterious cult empire. Step into the role of an idle evil genius and take control of a hidden underground operation, where your goal is to rise to p
bluejetty:00116723:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Cult Empire, a tycoon-style experience where you build and expand your own mysterious cult empire. Step into the role of an idle evil genius and take control of a hidden underground operation, where your goal is to rise to power and dominate the world. Blending elements from idle games, simulator games, and tycoon games, Idle Cult Empire offers a dark and engaging take on building games and long-term simulation games.
In Idle Cult Empire, you begin as a small cult leader with a limited following. Your mission is to recruit new members, perform rituals, and unlock forbidden knowledge to grow your influence. Manage resources, automate processes, and transform your cult into a thriving business empire. With clicker mechanics and support for offline idle games, progress continues even when you’re away.
As your empire grows, you’ll make strategic decisions involving money games, expansion systems, and resource management. Control large groups of followers through strategic mob control, operate secret facilities that resemble a controlled prison, and expand into multiple locations. Dig beneath the surface using mining games, idle miner, and digging games mechanics to uncover rare materials and fuel your rise to supremacy.
Idle Cult Empire combines idle progression with active choices. Conduct experiments, automate rituals, and unlock powerful upgrades as your influence spreads. Manage unusual areas like abandoned sites, forests, or a corrupted junkyard, and expand production chains inspired by lumber idle systems. With themes touching on cultist simulator, evil hunter, and demonized idle concepts, the game delivers a dark but playful atmosphere. Shape your followers’ destiny in a light god simulator style as you build a powerful empire.
Featuring atmospheric visuals, immersive sound effects, and steady progression, Idle Cult Empire keeps you engaged for hours. Expand across regions, unlock new abilities, and optimize every system to become a true top tycoon. Whether you enjoy tycoon games, simulation games, or slow-burn idle experiences, there’s always something new to build and improve.
If you love growing an empire from nothing and watching it thrive through automation and strategy, Idle Cult Empire is ready for you. Are you prepared to claim control and guide your cult toward total domination?
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if you have any feedback, need help beating a level, or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!

bluejetty:00065917:ios.description:
DÀN QUÂN - CHÉM TƯỚNG - HẠ THÀNH - BÌNH THIÊN HẠ. 
Kỳ Vương - Game Cờ số #1 Việt Nam: 
- Có thể chơi hoàn toàn miễn phí.
- Xem lại trận đấu đã chơi.
- Cộng đồng người chơi, cao thủ đông nhất.
- Kết nối ổn định, cảnh báo khi mạng yếu.
- Kết bạn, mời bạn bè cùng chơi qua facebook.
- Theo dõi các trận đấu hay.
- Đua top danh hiệu cao thủ Kỳ Vương, top Elo.
Cờ tướng từ lâu đã là môn thể thao trí tuệ không thể thiếu của nhiều nước Á Đông. Những nước cờ ảo diệu, thế cờ biến hóa nơi đình làng hay những ván cờ dịp lễ hội đã đi vào tiềm thức của nhiều người Việt. Ngoài cờ truyền thống, cờ úp là một nét sáng tạo mới với các quân cờ úp lúc khai cuộc. Các ván chơi có thêm yếu tố may rủi, ngẫu nhiên khi lật quân lần đầu tạo nên những tình huống đầy thú vị, bất ngờ.
Với mong muốn đưa cờ tướng, cờ úp đến với nhiều người hơn nữa, Kỳ Vương phát triển cổng game cờ hàng đầu Việt Nam. Với những tính năng ưu việt, chất lượng vượt trội, Kỳ Vương là sự lựa chọn số 1 của các kỳ thủ chơi cờ tướng online trên mọi nền tảng điện thoại, máy tính.
Nổi bật: 
+ Chơi cờ úp, cờ tướng online với ba chế độ: cờ nhanh, cờ chậm và cờ chớp.
+ Hệ thống CSKH chuyên nghiệp, luôn tận tâm giải đáp mọi ý kiến của game thủ.
+ Giao diện chau chuốt tuyệt đẹp, âm nhạc lôi cuốn, mang đậm nền văn hóa Á Đông vượt trội cờ tướng zingplay hay bigkool ..
+ Cộng đồng kỳ thủ đông đảo tới từ mọi miền đất nước.
+ Hệ thống phân cấp theo điểm số ELO, thước đo chuẩn mực để đánh giá trình độ của các kỳ thủ.
+ Bảng xếp hạng chi tiết cùng bộ huân chương cấp độ vô cùng phong phú.
+ Các sự kiện trong và ngoài game cờ, các giải đấu, giao lưu phong phú cùng hàng loạt phần thưởng hấp dẫn.
+ Kết bạn, giao lưu, xem, bình luận, chơi cờ tướng online mọi lúc, mọi nơi.
+ Luôn được cập nhật, phát triển các tính năng theo góp ý của người chơi
Nếu từng tải game cờ zingplay hay bigkool hẳn sẽ thấy rõ sự khác biệt khi tải Kỳ Vương vì sự chau chuốt, mượt mà và phong phú trong game. Khi các bạn yêu thích cờ zingplay, bigkool hẳn sẽ thấy sự tương đồng và có phần vượt trội với bình chọn 4.8* của 4K người chơi.
Cảm ơn bạn đã tải Kỳ Vương để trải nghiệm những tính năng tuyệt vời và tham gia những trận cờ hấp dẫn đang chờ đón!
Chúc bạn chơi cờ tướng vui vẻ, đánh cờ úp may mắn!

listings.description:
DÀN QUÂN - CHÉM TƯỚNG - HẠ THÀNH - BÌNH THIÊN HẠ. 
Kỳ Vương - Game Cờ số #1 Việt Nam: 
- Có thể chơi hoàn toàn miễn phí.
- Xem lại trận đấu đã chơi.
- Cộng đồng người chơi, cao thủ đông nhất.
- Kết nối ổn định, cảnh báo khi mạng yếu.
- Kết bạn, mời bạn bè cùng chơi qua facebook.
- Theo dõi các trận đấu hay.
- Đua top danh hiệu cao thủ Kỳ Vương, top Elo.

Cờ tướng từ lâu đã là môn thể thao trí tuệ không thể thiếu của nhiều nước Á Đông. Những nước cờ ảo diệu, thế cờ biến hóa nơi đình làng hay những ván cờ dịp lễ hội đã đi vào tiềm thức của nhiều người Việt. Ngoài cờ truyền thống, cờ úp là một nét sáng tạo mới với các quân cờ úp lúc khai cuộc. Các ván chơi có thêm yếu tố may rủi, ngẫu nhiên khi lật quân lần đầu tạo nên những tình huống đầy thú vị, bất ngờ.

Với mong muốn đưa cờ tướng, cờ úp đến với nhiều người hơn nữa, Kỳ Vương phát triển cổng game cờ hàng đầu Việt Nam. Với những tính năng ưu việt, chất lượng vượt trội, Kỳ Vương là sự lựa chọn số 1 của các kỳ thủ chơi cờ tướng online trên mọi nền tảng điện thoại, máy tính.
Nổi bật: 

+ Chơi cờ úp, cờ tướng online với ba chế độ: cờ nhanh, cờ chậm và cờ chớp.
+ Hệ thống CSKH chuyên nghiệp, luôn tận tâm giải đáp mọi ý kiến của game thủ.
+ Giao diện chau chuốt tuyệt đẹp, âm nhạc lôi cuốn, mang đậm nền văn hóa Á Đông vượt trội cờ tướng zingplay hay bigkool ..
+ Cộng đồng kỳ thủ đông đảo tới từ mọi miền đất nước.
+ Hệ thống phân cấp theo điểm số ELO, thước đo chuẩn mực để đánh giá trình độ của các kỳ thủ.
+ Bảng xếp hạng chi tiết cùng bộ huân chương cấp độ vô cùng phong phú.
+ Các sự kiện trong và ngoài game cờ, các giải đấu, giao lưu phong phú cùng hàng loạt phần thưởng hấp dẫn.
+ Kết bạn, giao lưu, xem, bình luận, chơi cờ tướng online mọi lúc, mọi nơi.
+ Luôn được cập nhật, phát triển các tính năng theo góp ý của người chơi

Nếu từng tải game cờ zingplay hay bigkool hẳn sẽ thấy rõ sự khác biệt khi tải Kỳ Vương vì sự chau chuốt, mượt mà và phong phú trong game. Khi các bạn yêu thích cờ zingplay, bigkool hẳn sẽ thấy sự tương đồng và có phần vượt trội với bình chọn 4.8* của 4K người chơi.
Cảm ơn bạn đã tải Kỳ Vương để trải nghiệm những tính năng tuyệt vời và tham gia những trận cờ hấp dẫn đang chờ đón!
Chúc bạn chơi cờ tướng vui vẻ, đánh cờ úp may mắn!

Mọi thắc mắc hoặc góp ý xin vui lòng liên hệ:

- Email: support@kyvuong.mobi
- Website: kyvuong.mobi
- Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/kyvuong.mobi

bluejetty:00073668:ios.description:
Your New Favorite Podcast App: Immersive Stories & Binge-Worthy Audio for Every Listener!
Looking for immersive stories, can't-miss interviews, or just something to make you laugh? Wherever your day takes you — the couch, the commute, the office or the gym – with the Wondery app, you’ll discover podcasts that pull you in and keep you coming back. Whether you’re into gripping True Crime podcasts, inspiring Business insights, laugh-out-loud Comedy, or eye-opening History, Wondery delivers binge-worthy audio that’s anything but boring. Download the Wondery app today and dive into your next great podcast. 
The Wondery app is more than just a podcast player. It’s your destination for premium audio storytelling with standout originals. From listener favorites to global hits, there’s something here for every kind of podcast listener. Enjoy endless podcast streaming, all in one place.
Listen to Chart-Topping Podcast Series Across Genres:
•True Crime: Discover some of the most gripping crime stories, from cold-case investigations and scams to horror tales of medicine gone wrong in Dr. Death, Scamfluencers, RedHanded, & The Shrink Next Door
•Business & Finance: Go behind-the-scenes of big brands with Business Wars, learn from founders on How I Built This, & stay up to date with business trends on The Best One Yet (TBOY)
•Sports: From laughs to expert analysis, tune into New Heights with Jason and Travis Kelce, Mind the Game hosted by LeBron James and Steve Nash, & Men in Blazers 
•History: Revisit pivotal moments in time with American Scandal, American History Tellers, & Against the Odds
•Comedy & Entertainment: Join Dax Shepard on Armchair Expert for candid conversations with celebrity guests
Fun for the Whole Family: Kids & Family Podcasts
Wondery Kids & Family blends education and entertainment with a curated lineup the whole family can enjoy:
•Beloved stories like Little Stories Everywhere, musical twists on Once Upon a Beat, and the global hit Disney’s Frozen: Forces of Nature
•Educational favorites Greeking Out from National Geographic Kids and Wow in the World
•Seasonal picks like ‘Tis The Grinch Holiday Podcast and Cat in the Hat Cast
Perfect for road trips, bedtime, or anytime you want screen-free entertainment that sparks the whole family’s imagination

bluejetty:00099400:ios.summary:
Start your day with Faith, Purpose and Peace.
Graceful - Bible, Study, Chat is a faith app designed to fit seamlessly into your life. Whether you are new to the Bible or looking to deepen your walk with God, Graceful helps you stay connect
bluejetty:00099400:ios.description:
Start your day with Faith, Purpose and Peace.
Graceful - Bible, Study, Chat is a faith app designed to fit seamlessly into your life. Whether you are new to the Bible or looking to deepen your walk with God, Graceful helps you stay connected through scripture, guided prayer, and personal reflection.
Inside the app, you will find a friendly and approachable way to explore God’s Word. With our built-in chat, you can ask questions, learn more about scripture, and receive encouragement in times of need. It feels like having a personal faith companion when you are not sure where to start.
Each morning begins with Today’s Journey. This daily section gives you a Bible verse, a short message, and a moment of prayer to prepare your heart for the day ahead. For deeper study, you can follow one of our focused reading plans covering books of the Bible, life topics, or personal growth.
Bring scripture and prayer into your daily routine with Home Screen Widgets. Add today’s verse or a quick devotion right to your home screen, so you never miss a moment of inspiration, even on busy days.
You can read the Bible in several trusted translations, including the King James Version, World English Bible, Free Bible Version, Amplified Bible, New American Standard Bible, and Die Bibel in German. More languages and versions are coming soon.
Graceful also includes prayer tools to help you stay mindful and focused. Keep a journal, write down personal prayers, or take time to pause and reflect whenever you need it.
Everything in Graceful is designed to feel calm and simple. The clean layout helps you focus on God’s Word without distractions. For added motivation, you can earn points and complete small challenges that help you build strong spiritual habits.
Graceful Premium gives you unlimited access to Faith Chat, all study plans and devotionals, plus extra customization for your widgets. Enjoy a deeper, ad-free experience designed to help you grow your faith.
Graceful is made for all believers. No matter your background or experience, this app welcomes you with warmth and simplicity. It is here to help you grow in faith, one day at a time.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.dailybible-app.com/ios/privacy
Terms of Use:
https://www.dailybible-app.com/ios/terms

● From the creators that gave you the #1 game of all time, Subway Surfers!

bluejetty:00154095:ios.summary: City Legends: The Witness in the Rye – a terrifying harvest awaits! It’s harvest time, but something sinister lurks in the fields… Immerse yourself in the thrilling hidden object games, where every shadow hides a clue, and every secret coul
bluejetty:00154095:ios.description:
City Legends: The Witness in the Rye – a terrifying harvest awaits! It’s harvest time, but something sinister lurks in the fields… Immerse yourself in the thrilling hidden object games, where every shadow hides a clue, and every secret could be your last. Explore the sunless city, find hidden objects, and unravel a chilling narrative woven with object finding games. As the unsolved mysteries games unfold, your choices will determine your fate. Will you uncover the truth behind the mystical riddles, or will the land claim you as its own?
The autumn breeze brings you to the sunless city of Darkwood, where you intend to find some inspiration and finish your new horror book in peace. You hear many tourists have come to these parts, fascinated by talk of the miraculous properties of local crops, although few people hear of their return afterward... Nevertheless, the gray of the sky and the red rye fields are bewitching! One can say, they have become something of a muse for the not-so-hospitable locals. So beware. The harvest festival is approaching and I'm afraid by that time you won't be able to leave the city.
· Hidden Object Gameplay!
Search through eerie locations and find hidden objects that will help you uncover the truth behind Darkwood’s terrifying legend. Explore haunted mansions, abandoned barns, solve crimes and mysteries in our thrilling hidden object games!
· Unravel Darkwood’s Secrets!
Discover spine-chilling legends and experience the horrors of this town firsthand. Solve unsolved mysteries games by piecing together cryptic notes, speaking with residents, and finding disturbing evidence hidden in the shadows. Can you escape before the Harvest Festival seals your fate?
· Mystical Riddles & Puzzles!
Test your detective skills with a variety of intricate puzzles and mystical riddles that hold the key to the town’s dark past. From deciphering coded messages to unlocking cursed chests, every challenge will bring you one step closer to solving Darkwood’s most sinister unsolved mysteries games!
· A Story of Dread and Suspense!
Your decisions define your journey in this heart-pounding object finding games adventure. The deeper you dig, the more horrifying secrets you’ll uncover. With multiple endings and spine-tingling twists, only the bravest will survive this hidden object games nightmare!
Dare to step into the haunted town of Darkwood? Download the free trial of the "City Legends: The Witness in the Rye" and test your courage!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/

Build your cozy dream farm in Farm Town!
Grow crops, raise cute animals, decorate your village and enjoy a peaceful farm life. Create your own farm story and relax in this charming offline farming game.
Merge items and complete orders to earn tickets, then build, renovate and decorate cozy rooms.
What you can do:
• Merge items, complete orders and earn tickets to renovate beautiful rooms
• Plant and harvest vegetables, fruits and flowers every day
• Raise adorable animals: cows, chickens, sheep, even a pony
• Build, upgrade and customize farm buildings and workshops
• Produce goods: bake cakes, cook tasty food and make sweets
• Trade with neighbors and complete delivery orders
• Decorate your farm with gardens, paths, trees and furniture
• Expand your village, unlock new areas and welcome visitors
• Play offline anytime, anywhere

Relaxing gameplay, satisfying progress and the warm feeling of building a cozy home at your own pace.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation.
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal.
Manage your subscription in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00117680:ios.description:
Forest Clans – the game for fans of the nature, walks for mushrooms and forest kitchen! In our forest always there are a lot of mushrooms! Play for free!
THE COLOURFUL FOREST is full of so many kinds of mushrooms – from well-known to rare and little-known. So take a basket and come on to the mushroom hunting! Gather mushrooms, cook from them various dishes, equip and decorate your village and farm to your taste.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS, chat and help each other! You will be able to join in clans with players from other social networks and mobile platforms. Continue to play on other mobile devices without loss of game progress!
FASCINATING GAME PROCESS, immersion to the kind world of the nature, a lot of the most different mushrooms, beautiful graphics and pleasant sounds of the forest, communication in a clan and rivalry in a tournament – all this won't leave indifferent mushroom hunters of any age, young and old!
GAME FEATURES
- Open new mushroom places and gather a special kind of mushrooms in each of them
- Study mushrooms at School to gather them more
- Build the new equipment on the farm and cook new mushroom dishes
- Play with thousands of other players, go hiking to them and get not only mushrooms, but also horseshoes and tournament stars
- Join a clan or create your own, communicate in a chat and help each other mushrooms, participate in a tournament and receive a gold award
- Construct Laboratory and create in it the magic potions helping to gather more mushrooms
- Perform tasks and achievements and earn gold coins and experience
- Play on any other mobile device or on social networks
- Enjoy beautiful graphics and pleasant sounds of the nature
- Play for free in English - it is Farm Frenzy!
You had questions or our help is necessary? We will help: support@vigr.ru
Attention! Game "Forest Clans" requires continuous connection to the Internet.

bluejetty:00015410:ios.description:
Hey! We've been cooking this app for 7 straight years and we believe we can PROFOUNDLY CHANGE THE WAY LANGUAGES ARE TAUGHT.
The best way to learn a foreign language is to immerse yourself in it by visiting the country, listening and talking to the native speakers.
So we created the platform that gives the very same experience!
OUR STORY
7 years ago, my father and I started learning a foreign language online but we soon realized there was something really wrong on the market. 
We learned several words and phrases but it was impossible to start speaking. Later on, we found a lot of people with the same problem and gave our entrepreneurial mindset, we set out a mission to create the platform that would truly give people a chance of learning a language.
AFTER 7 YEARS of creating, testing and refining, HERE WE ARE!
AVAILABLE LANGUAGES:
· ENGLISH
· SPANISH
· FRENCH
· ITALIAN
· RUSSIAN
with more than 5 intermediate languages.
With Lingwing you will develop all necessary skills:
· Speaking
· Writing
· Listening
· Spelling
and you’ll have time to improve your pronunciation. 
· Study in a chat-like interface
· Native speakers will direct you
· Every course is personalized by our algorithm
· Our gamification tools will engage you
· No need to memorize words or complex grammar, our algorithm lets you relax and focus on one task at a time.
INSTANT RESULTS
For us, the most important part is RESULTS. Just after a couple of days, you will realize you are already familiar with the chosen language and have the confidence to start speaking.
TIME IS VITAL
Imagine what you can do with our app within weeks! - Learn a new language from zero to a level when you will be able to read a newspaper, watch the news, understand your favourite music lyrics, listen and talk to native speakers. 
Our freemium model gives you the opportunity to do exercises every day for free!
Isn’t that amazing? 
Isn’t that what you wanted? 
Try it now!

bluejetty:00042423:ios.description:
PERSONALIZED THERAPY. JUST HIT PLAY.
Therapy can change your life. Explore an extensive audio library of recorded therapy sessions with our team of experienced, handpicked therapists. Anonymous listening, anytime, anywhere. Only on Meomind.
HOW MEOMIND WORKS
Download the Meomind app and explore our library of recorded therapy sessions. Choose a session that fits your needs. Listen and get real, concrete help from licensed therapists. As they grow and feel better, so do you.
WHY MEOMIND?
- Listen to our entire library!
- Anytime, Anywhere: Explore at your own pace. Listen whenever you want.
- Totally Anonymous: No payment info, no insurance claims, no medical records.
- Handpicked Therapists: We have a small team of carefully vetted mental healthcare providers.
- Community: You’re not alone. Listen to like-minded users who share your experience.
- Effective: Over 80% of members show a reduction in anxiety and depression within 2-3 weeks based on PHQ-2 and GAD-2 scores.
WHAT OUR USERS SAY
“I felt like it was me talking. I was on the edge of tears. I felt like I’m not alone in this, and that I am not crazy.” Molly, 23
“A good therapy session is one where I realize something on my own and that definitely happened in the sessions I listened to.” Sam, 22
“I got more out of this than my 8 therapy sessions combined. The client was speaking my exact words.” Rachel, 32
“It is hard for me to find time for therapy given my family circumstances. Listening to your sessions at my convenience has been tremendously helpful.” Lisa, 43
PRICING
Meomind offers an extensive library of over 800 therapy sessions and unlimited coaching with board certified coaches. To enjoy access to the app, subscribe to one of our payment plans (includes a minimum 7-day trial). Your subscription unlocks full, unrestricted use of Meomind.
Terms of service: https://meomind-legal.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Meomind+Terms+and+Conditions.pdf
Privacy policy: https://meomind-legal.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/Meomind+Privacy+Policy.pdf

bluejetty:00014901:ios.description:

Join Communities
Discover and participate in org-wide communities to connect with colleagues with similar interests and skillsets.
Engage with Leadership
Viva Engage app enables leaders and employees to engage and co-create company culture.

Express Yourself
Share your unique perspective at scale through your storyline.

Share Knowledge
Ask questions, share knowledge and feedback, crowdsource ideas using org-wide communities.
Stay Connected
With the Viva Engage app, you're just a tap away from leadership, coworkers, information, and conversations whether you are in the office or on the go.
Rich Intuitive Mobile Experience
Viva Engage enables you to engage on mobile in a way that is intuitive on iOS. Share photos and videos with your colleagues, respond with a quick GIF to welcome a new employee or praise someone.
Get interactive notifications that are tuned to the right amount of information you need. Access these notifications from your lock screen.

bluejetty:00138962:ios.description:
Take GB News with you wherever you go with the GB News app. 
The GB News app puts Britain's number one news channel in your pocket. Watch live or catch up anytime, get breaking news as it happens, follow your favourite presenters, and be part of the national conversation... all in one place.
Whether you're reading the latest headlines or catching up on award-winning programmes including Patrick Christys Tonight, Dewbs & Co, GB News Breakfast, Farage, and more, the GB News app keeps you informed and connected wherever you are.
With the GB News app you can:
- Watch GB News live 24/7 or catch up on your favourite programmes anytime
- Stay ahead of the latest headlines with breaking news from the UK, US and around the world
- Receive breaking news alerts on the stories that matter most to you
- Personalise your news feed with the topics, presenters and stories you care about
- Read exclusive opinion, analysis and feature articles from GB News presenters and Britain’s leading commentators
- Have your say by commenting on articles, joining discussions and voting in daily polls
- Listen live to GB News Radio or enjoy your favourite podcasts on the go
- Save articles to read later and easily share stories with others
- Challenge yourself with daily crosswords and puzzles
- Earn GB Loyalty Points by reading, watching, commenting and voting in our app. Redeem your points for exclusive rewards and special offers. 
- Support independent journalism and free speech while unlocking even more from the GB News app by becoming a GB News member.
Membership includes:
- An ad-lite app experience 
- Unlimited access to exclusive opinion, analysis and premium articles 
- Enhanced commenting and community features 
- Early access to original documentaries, interviews and videos
- Invitations to member-only events and experiences 
- Enter competitions and claim rewards 
- Access to our full collection of daily puzzles and games
Privacy Policy: https://www.gbnews.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.gbnews.com/terms
Membership Terms: https://www.gbnews.com/terms/membership-rules

bluejetty:00140691:ios.description:
More than a period tracker. Harmony helps you sync your lifestyle with your cycle. Your energy, meals, movement, and mindset, all in one place.
Your body follows a unique rhythm that shapes how you feel, move, and think. Harmony helps you understand it and work with it, not against it.
Most cycle apps track your period. Harmony helps you live better because of it.
What Harmony offers:
- Cycle Syncing Guidance
Personalized tips for each phase of your cycle. What to eat, how to move, and how to recharge based on where you are right now.
- Smart Cycle Tracking
Log your period, symptoms, and mood. Get a clear view of your current phase and what's coming next.
- Daily Insights & Rituals
Meditations, journaling prompts, and mindset tips aligned with your natural rhythm.
- AI Lifestyle Assistant
Friendly, personalized guidance to help you stay organized and in tune with yourself every day.
- Harmony Together
Connect with your partner so they can better understand and support your cycle.
- Your data stays yours.
Built with privacy at its core. We never sell your data. Ever.
Harmony is a lifestyle and wellness tool. It does not provide medical advice or diagnoses.
Start with a free trial and find your rhythm.

bluejetty:00065465:ios.name: WMCB Mobile
bluejetty:00065465:ios.summary: WMCB Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by em
bluejetty:00065465:ios.description:
WMCB Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with WMCB Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the WMCB Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a West Michigan Community Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00035990:ios.name: Minute Cryptic
bluejetty:00035990:ios.summary:
Introduce a cryptic riddle into your day. Minute Cryptic is the fun, free and easy way to get up to speed with cryptic crossword clues - a puzzle style loved and obsessed over by solvers for over 100 years!
Minute Cryptic started on TikTok
bluejetty:00035990:ios.description:
Introduce a cryptic riddle into your day. Minute Cryptic is the fun, free and easy way to get up to speed with cryptic crossword clues - a puzzle style loved and obsessed over by solvers for over 100 years!
Minute Cryptic started on TikTok and Instagram, with one video a day explaining a new cryptic crossword clue. Our fan-base exploded and kept asking for a game to play, so we made it! 
With the Minute Cryptic app, you get one cryptic clue per day, specially crafted for our audience based on their regular feedback on social media. You can dial up or down the difficulty of the clue by asking for a hint or revealing letters, and when you’ve solved it, each clue links to its video explanation. 
We’ve found that this has been a great way to introduce hundreds of thousands of people to cryptic crosswords. Our solvers agree:
“Hands down the best website I have found this year. Love what you guys are doing!”
“You have created a new daily routine for me these last couple of months. I didn't know about cryptic clues or crosswords before stumbling upon you guys, and you make it extremely accessible, fun and engaging.”
“I love this project! Best part of my morning routine”
“Wordle, Connections, Mini-crosswords on NYT would be the first thing I did as soon as I woke up in the morning. Minute Cryptic has replaced them."
“I’m a newcomer to this puzzle and I absolutely love it. It’s frustrating in the best way, and the sense of accomplishment upon solving it is immense! Thank you for it”
"Been playing Minute Cryptic for almost two weeks now and as someone who doesn't have the time for a full crossword puzzle, this has been scratching an itch real good. One word, big blast of fun. Like a triple espresso at 4pm"
"No lie, Minute Cryptic is the first thing I think about each morning."
“Just want to say thank you for all you’re doing with Minute Cryptic! I had always wanted to be able to tackle cryptic crosswords but found it difficult to know where to begin. Your videos but even more the guide to cryptic clues in the how to section have really unlocked it for me and now it’s one of the best parts of the day to work on the daily clue. Keep up the amazing work!”
"I really appreciate your advice and posts. I thought cryptic crosswords were an impenetrable arcane art, beyond my reach. But you explain them really well."
“Tha

bluejetty:00165573:ios.name: Hidden Objects: Cursed Hearts
bluejetty:00165573:ios.summary: Would you like to escape reality and experience the intricacies of royal life, where love, sacrifice, and destiny intertwine? Then prepare yourself for the twists and turns that lie ahead in this "Royal Romances: The Cursed Hearts" hidden o
bluejetty:00165573:ios.description:
Would you like to escape reality and experience the intricacies of royal life, where love, sacrifice, and destiny intertwine? Then prepare yourself for the twists and turns that lie ahead in this "Royal Romances: The Cursed Hearts" hidden object game consisting of the beloved episodes of the love story series. Immerse yourself in a magic world of intrigue with hidden treasures, challenging magic puzzles, myths and monsters, and dive into the realm of point and click adventure games! Are you ready to set off on an unforgettable adventure once again?
Would you like to spend some time as a delicate princess in a world full of magic? Life in a royal palace is not as easy as it may seem! Your formidable father organizes a deadly contest among the contenders for your heart, a stab in the back is something to be expected daily even from your dearest, and instead of grand feasts and balls, you have to settle the problems of the subjects living within and beyond the borders of your kingdom. But the result can bring luscious rewards – an undying love willing to pull a star from the high skies just for your pleasure.
· LOVE AMIDST CHALLENGES!
Break free from binding traditions, outsmart rival princes, and showcase your strategic prowess to solve hidden object games, magic puzzles and win the heart of the fairest princess, navigating through a tapestry of royal romances!
· A VARIETY OF ACHIEVEMENTS!
Put your intellect to the test with intricate puzzles and relaxing mini-games scattered throughout your hidden objects quest. Earn a variety of achievements as you unravel bright objects and hidden objects of the kingdom and prove that true love can conquer any challenge!
· BONUS MATERIALS!
Explore a wide range of fantasy-themed bonus materials that expand the game experience, offering additional layers of storytelling and immersive content. Enjoy this wonderful magical world with these captivating extras of our hidden object games!
· YOUR OWN CHOICES!
Join a captivating world of royal romances as you embark on an exciting journey. Explore point and click adventure games where you'll search for hidden treasures and uncover clues that could lead you to the heart of the princess. Every choice you make carries weight, shaping the fates and lives of the characters around you!
Are you ready to experience the complexities of royal life, where love knows no boundaries and every decision shapes the destiny of kingdoms?
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00128972:ios.description:
Are you always searching for the latest trends? Do you love discovering new outfits? 
Do you always go for looks that are a hit wherever you go? Then this is the place for you! 
Download the Bershka app now and discover a new way of buying clothes and fashion online, view fashion items on a daily basis, see the latest trends for him and for her, manage your account and find the nearest stores.
THE COMPLETE BERSHKA CATALOGUE IS WITHIN REACH 
With the Bershka app, you will get access to the online store and can buy clothes in the most comfortable way, get the latest news, the latest fashion trends and items, women’s clothing (dresses, coats, shirts, skirts, blouses, boots…) men’s clothing (trousers, shirts, jackets, t-shirts, shoes…) and accessories (bags, purses, jewellery, belts…) as well as beauty and make-up. 
CREATE A WISH LIST WITH ALL THE ITEMS YOU LOVE 
You can do more than just buy clothes. You can also look at the complete catalogue, select the items that you like the most, choose complete outfits, and make a list of the latest trends for your next shopping trip - choose what you love best! 
MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNT 
With the app, you can do more than just buy clothes. 
You can also manage your orders, keep track of your online purchases, contact the customer service team if you have any questions and recommend the app to your friends. 
DISCOVER THE STORES CLOSEST TO YOU 
Thanks to geolocation, the app can tell you where the nearest store is and whether the store sells womenswear, menswear or both, and also provides you with a contact number for the store in case you want to order a specific item. You can also save your favourite items to a list and access them immediately if necessary.
EVERYTHING YOU CAN DO WITH THE BERSHKA APP
√ Discover the latest fashion trends
With the app, you can quickly see which clothes will be in fashion each season.
√ Buy all the catalogue items 
Choose the clothes you love and buy them! You only have to choose your payment method, enter the delivery address and wait for your order to arrive as quickly as possible.
√ Create a wish list with the items you love the most 
You can find out which clothes and accessories are on-trend and you can also save the items you like the most to a wish list. You can add items for women and men in the app with a QR code or with a scanner. 
√ Manage your account 
Via your user account, you can review your purchases, track your orders and contact the customer service department with any questions you may have.
√Find new places to shop
The app shows you a list of the nearest stores. You can also see their location on the map and add them to your favourites list or view their details (contact phone number, if they sell womenswear, menswear or both, and the exact address)
Do you like to dress in the latest fashion? Do you like to buy clothes, shoes and accessories for women and men directly from your mobile? Do you want to see all the orders you have placed? Do you want to discover new stores? In that case, the Bershka app is exactly what you have been looking for. 
It’s much more than an online store.

bluejetty:00073396:ios.description:
VeSync is your all-in-one app for a smarter, healthier home life. Control smart devices from the VeSync family of brands, build better habits, connect with a like-minded community, and unlock member-only perks.
CONNECT YOUR HOME
Control and monitor your smart devices from anywhere. Create schedules, customize settings, and get notifications. Optimize comfort and simplify daily routines, all from the app.
CRUSH YOUR GOALS
Track health metrics, plan meals, manage your nutrition, and build healthy habits, all designed to help you reach your lifestyle goals.
CHAMPION EACH OTHER 
Join our community of people building healthier habits together. Discover recipes, wellness tips, and success stories from members around the world. Share your questions and experiences, and get support from others on the same journey. 
CLAIM MEMBERS-ONLY PERKS
Get access to special offers, discover new products, and earn rewards as a VeSync App member.
Have questions? We're here to help support@vesync.com
* VeSync is connected to Apple's HealthKit platform, and can now feed health and wellness data into Apple Health.
* Some products and features may not be available in all regions. Compatible devices required.
* For the best experience, download the latest version of the app, and make sure your firmware is updated.
* VeSync Fit has been upgraded to VeSync, we will continue to provide you with a better experience.
Medical Device Jurisdiction Statement:
We specifically declare that the medical devices in VeSync are only sold and used within the United States and are governed by U.S. laws. If you are outside the United States, you need to comply with the laws and regulations in your region when using and purchasing medical devices. Please note that we are not responsible for the consequences of use of medical devices outside the United States.
Disclaimer for Medical Device Equipment:
The diagnostic results provided by personal medical device equipment in VeSync are for reference purposes only and cannot replace a doctor's diagnosis. Please refrain from taking any treatment measures based on self-measurement results. We strongly recommend that you promptly consult and seek advice from your doctor if you have any questions about the diagnostic results or require treatment guidance. The use of personal medical device equipment should be combined with professional medical services to ensure accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment. We shall not be held responsible for any consequences arising from failure to consult a doctor or taking action based on self-measurement results.

bluejetty:00026192:ios.description:
Ask AI Anything: Chat&Talk – Your Ultimate AI Chatbot and Voice Assistant
Welcome to Ask AI, the most advanced AI-powered chat assistant designed to help you with anything, anytime. Whether you want to ask questions, chat about your favorite topics, talk to an intelligent bot, or get assistance with writing an essay, paragraph, or even a detailed text, Ask AI is here for you. Built with next-generation AI technology, this app brings the future of AI chat to your fingertips, making it your trusted companion for all tasks, big or small.
Why Choose Ask AI Anything: Chat&Talk?
• Ask Anything, Anytime: Stuck on a problem? Need answers fast? Whether it’s academic, professional, or just for fun, simply ask and get instant, accurate responses. Using advanced AI models, the app can tackle anything—from generating an essay or copywriting to answering complex questions or composing a creative paragraph.
• Chat or Talk with Ease: Prefer typing? Enjoy a smooth, intuitive chat interface for text-based conversations. Prefer speaking? Use the voice interaction feature to talk directly with the AI, making it feel like a personal assistant at your service.
• Favorites: Quick Access to Top Chatbots: Customize your experience by saving your favorite chatbots for instant access. Popular options include the Astrologer, Dietitian, Doctor, Math Teacher, and more.
• Explore 200+ Specialized Chatbots: With over 200 chatbots covering every imaginable subject, you’ll never run out of options. Whether you need advice, entertainment, or specialized knowledge, the library has you covered.
• Organized Chat History: Never lose track of a conversation. Access all your previous chats, organize them into folders, or delete them when no longer needed. Share your interactions with friends or colleagues directly from the app.
• Powered by Advanced AI: At the core of Ask AI is state-of-the-art intelligence that delivers fast, accurate, human-like responses. Whether you’re crafting a detailed text, solving math problems, or seeking advice, the AI adapts to your unique style and needs.
Key Features for Everyone:
• Students: Generate detailed essays, write clear paragraphs, or get answers to tough homework questions.
• Professionals: Draft emails, brainstorm ideas, or organize your thoughts with ease.
• Curious Minds: Explore fascinating topics, chat with engaging bots, and learn something new every day.
What Makes Ask AI Stand Out?
Unlike other apps, Ask AI combines text and voice interactions, letting you communicate however you prefer. Its advanced AI system delivers precise, intelligent answers—making it your trusted companion for both work and play.
Examples of What You Can Do with Ask AI:
• Write an entire essay on any topic.
• Solve math problems step by step with the Math Teacher chatbot.
• Plan your meals and fitness routines with the Dietitian chatbot.
• Get personalized horoscope readings from the Astrologer chatbot.
• Brainstorm ideas, create engaging content, and organize your thoughts.
• Revisit previous chats, organize them, and share insights when needed.
The AI Chat Assistant for Everything:
Whether you need quick facts, in-depth research, creative writing help, or just a friendly conversation, this app has you covered. Powered by cutting-edge AI, Ask AI delivers accurate results every time. Your data is secure, and your chats are private—giving you peace of mind as you explore the possibilities.
Download Ask AI Anything: Chat&Talk Now!

bluejetty:00026285:ios.description:
Turn any product photo into a ready-to-post listing image. Remove the background, protect it with your watermark, add a price tag, and export it sized for popular marketplaces and social media - all in one tool built for people who sell online, with no subscription: Pro is a one-time purchase.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Remove Background (Pro) - cut your product out of any photo automatically, right on your device (iPhone with iOS 17 or newer)
- Watermark - protect your photos with your shop name; save one preset free, or go Pro for a logo watermark and unlimited presets
- 300+ Stickers - sale badges, price tags, shop icons, and cute mascots to decorate your photo; a starter set is free, the full library unlocks with Pro
- Price Tags - add a price in several styles, cross out the old price for a sale
- Text and Captions - write on your photo in any font, size, or color
- Export For Your Marketplace - one tap sizes your photo correctly for popular marketplaces and social media: square 1:1, 3:4 portrait or 9:16 stories
- Filters - blur, darken, or vignette the background
- Undo/Redo, plus save your projects and pick up where you left off
WHY SELLERS TRUST US
This app has been helping people sell online for years, with thousands of 5-star reviews from real sellers. The core app is completely free - no account needed. A one-time Pro purchase (never a subscription) unlocks logo watermarks, unlimited watermark presets, and background removal.
Questions or ideas? Write us at myshoptags@gmail.com - we read every message.

bluejetty:00039896:ios.description:
Topup your Israeli Rav-Kav transit card with your iPhone!
Tap the Rav-Kav card near the camera area on your device (back or front), check your balance, select the contract you want, pay using all major credit cards, debit cards or Apple Pay. Don't forget to tap your Rav-Kav again to complete the topup and you're ready for your next journey!
You can choose between Credit value which is acceptable by all public transit operators in Israel, or a Daily and Monthly passes according to the area of your travel.
Contracts sold on this app are valid for your rides on Trains, Light rail, Tram and in the following bus service operators: Dan, Egged, Derech Egged, Metropoline, Kavim, Superbus, Electra Afikim, Tnufa, Extra and more
Eligible for a discount? scan your personal card, submit your eligibility documents, and add the entitlement to the card.
We also like to emphasize that writing on Rav-Kav is a very delicate process, and displacement of Rav-Kav or smartphone cover which is too thick can interfere with the success of charging the Rav-Kav.

bluejetty:00142092:ios.name: Timemark: Photo Proof for Work
bluejetty:00142092:ios.summary: Timemark is the trusted photo documentation app for teams in construction, fiber optic, cable & telecom, HVAC, property management, cleaning, security, and more. Every photo carries verified time, GPS location, and anti-tamper protection, s
bluejetty:00142092:ios.description:
Timemark is the trusted photo documentation app for teams in construction, fiber optic, cable & telecom, HVAC, property management, cleaning, security, and more. Every photo carries verified time, GPS location, and anti-tamper protection, so you have proof of work that stands up in any dispute.
Tamper-proof photo evidence
- Network-verified timestamps that can't be faked by changing device settings
- Precise GPS coordinates and street address on every photo
- Unique photo codes link each photo to its original metadata
- Photos prove when your crew arrived, what was done, and when they left
- Prevent disputes and get faster payment approvals
Teamspace: auto-collect team photos
- No more texting photos to one person to sort. Every photo your crew takes syncs to Teamspace automatically
- Time and location on every photo give the office full site context, without a phone call
- Organize by project, client, or location
- Share live links so clients and inspectors can view photos without downloading an app
- Role-based permissions so each team sees only their projects
- Teams report saving 2-4 hours per week on photo organization
One-click professional reports
- Build closeout packages and as-built records that meet client and government requirements
- Export as PDF, Excel, or ZIP, ready to submit
- KMZ files show every photo on the map in Google Earth
- GPS-tagged photos of every handhole, vault, and splice point, so you can find buried equipment years later
- Before & after comparison layouts for inspections
Built for the field
- Works offline: capture photos with full metadata even without signal, then they upload automatically
- Lightweight app designed for job site conditions
- No training required. Your crew can start in minutes
- 20+ languages supported
Who uses Timemark
- Construction: track project progress with templates and cloud sync
- Fiber Optic: document splicing, trenching, and FTTH installs
- Cable & Telecom: aerial/underground runs, node inspections, service drops
- Property Management: move-in/move-out inspections, maintenance logs
- Field Service: auto-collect job photos and quickly make client reports
- HVAC & Plumbing: before/after repairs, compliance records
- Cleaning & Janitorial: service verification, quality checks
- Security: record patrols and incidents with map links
- Delivery & Logistics: proof-of-delivery photos, avoid disputes
- Retail & Sales: store visits and audits with timestamped proof
- Landscaping & Roofing: job site progress, weather documentation
- Business Owners: branded photos with your logo or business card
- Other Jobs: flexible templates for any kind of work
Trusted by millions
From fiber splicers to property inspectors, field teams in 100+ countries rely on Timemark every day.
Flexible plans
- Free: capture job photos with customizable watermark templates
- Plus: advanced features, designed for individual use
- Business: full Teamspace access for your team, with centralized billing
- Enterprise: custom plans for large organizations
Download Timemark and turn every job photo into trusted proof of work.
Plus plan subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel subscriptions anytime in your App Store account settings.
Questions or suggestions? Write to us: support@timemark.com
Website: https://www.timemark.com/
Terms of use: https://help.timemark.com/policy/terms-of-service/
Privacy policy: https://help.timemark.com/policy/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00149717:ios.description:
Pet Cloud features:
Inbox & Docs: Create folders for medical records, adoption records, vet bills, pictures, and create personalized folders. Especially helpful during a pet emergency: Access all your records wherever and whenever you need them; and upload and share documents with anyone.
Reminders: The Pet Cloud lets you know when the important stuff is due. You set the date, and it will remind you when your pet is due for their shots and vaccinations.
Connect: The Pet Cloud makes it easy for you to meet other pets and their parents. Use the search tool to discover who's around you and get connected. Chat, share photos, plan play dates, and more!
Explore: Never feel lost again—wherever you roam, you’ll have access to all things pet. Easily find pet hotels, groomers, daycares, dog parks, shelters, pet-friendly restaurants, and emergency pet hospitals in a flash.
Loss Prevention: Unique pet tags integrate with your Pet Cloud profile. If your pet ever goes astray, they can be reunited with you using the unique code on the back of the tag. You and your family are alerted via text message.
Live Vet Access: Have a pet emergency or question for a veterinarian? Pet Cloud users can access live veterinary professionals 24/7.
Pet Insurance: The Pet Cloud seamlessly integrates with Figo Pet Insurance. Submit claims, add medical records and anything pertaining to your pet’s health through the app. Also, information about your pet’s insurance policy—deductible, payment history, coverage, etc.—is automatically populated.
