bluejetty:00028759:ios.name: Shedevrum
bluejetty:00028759:ios.summary: Type a phrase, and Yandex neural networks will generate an image, video, or text based on your description. You can also transform your photos using filtrums. Generate without limits. Download the app and step into the world of digital art.
bluejetty:00028759:ios.description:
Type a phrase, and Yandex neural networks will generate an image, video, or text based on your description. You can also transform your photos using filtrums. Generate without limits. Download the app and step into the world of digital art.
To make Shedevrum create an image in the exact style you want, you can specify it manually. For example, enter "a portrait of a man on a spacewalk in the style of Picasso" or "a fluffy, cute little cat in a fairy-tale style", and then select the best result.
In addition to images, you can generate videos and even create clips. To make a clip, think of a short story and select fragments of your own or other users' masterpieces for it. Pick a template — adventure, action, romance, and more — add transitions and a soundtrack, and your clip is ready.
To create a video, enter a prompt and add effects like timelapse or zoom. Use manual mode to fine-tune your masterpiece for even more individuality. We have updated the new model, so the quality has become even higher, and generations are more lively and dynamic. If you want to make your masterpiece unique, use manual mode and adjust the video just the way you like it.
You can also upload your photo and transform it with filtrums. They work like magic, turning your selfie into a plush-style portrait or transforming a plain yard into a winter wonderland.
While the AI works, browse the feed, comment on posts, and like your favorite works. The feed has several sections: your masterpieces, recent posts, and the best of the day, week, or all time. Follow your favorite creators and view their posts in a separate feed. 
What’s more: Shedevrum has a kids mode—a safe, bright, and inspiring space. Here, children can draw pictures using their voice. Parents can rest easy: there are no followers, no comments, no unnecessary noise; the content is monitored, and exiting kids mode is only possible with a password.
By downloading the application, you accept the terms of the License Agreement:
https://yandex.ru/legal/shedevrum_mobile_agreement/en/

bluejetty:00016290:ios.summary: Catch up with your favorite Discovery shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new Discovery GO app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including TLC, HGTV, Food Network and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pay TV sub
bluejetty:00016290:ios.description:
Catch up with your favorite Discovery shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new Discovery GO app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including TLC, HGTV, Food Network and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pay TV subscription. 
Link your pay TV provider (cable, satellite, telco, live TV streaming service) to access Discovery favorites like Gold Rush, Moonshiners, Bering Sea Gold, Deadliest Catch, Battle Bots, Street Outlaws, Naked and Afraid, Naked and Afraid XL, Expedition Unknown, Alaska: The Last Frontier and many more - plus top shows from other networks including Home Town (HGTV), Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives (Food Network), Dr. Pimple Popper (TLC), Evil Lives Here (ID), Ghost Adventures (Travel Channel) and more. New episodes are available the same day as they premiere on TV. 
With Discovery GO You Can:
• Stream Discovery and more networks LIVE anytime, anywhere on all your favorite devices
• Find shows to watch with the live schedule guide
• Access thousands of episodes on demand - from current hits to classic favorites
• See new episodes of shows on the app the same day and time they premiere on TV
• Binge your favorite Discovery series and specials including Gold Rush, Moonshiners, Bering Sea Gold, Deadliest Catch, Battle Bots, Street Outlaws, Naked and Afraid, Naked and Afraid XL, Expedition Unknown, Alaska: The Last Frontier - and many more! 
• Get unlimited access to everything the Discovery family of networks has to offer - free with your pay TV subscription.
Features:
• Stream live TV when you log in with your pay TV provider
• Watch select episodes and entire seasons of your favorite shows from up to 15 networks!
• Browse by genre - from Natural History, Science and Tech to Food, Home and more - to find your favorite shows and discover new ones
• Continue watching episodes where you left off across all of your devices
• Save shows and episodes to watch later with My List
• Compatible with tvOS and Chromecast
• Closed-captioning support
Requirements:
• Available in the U.S. only
• Wi-Fi connection recommended
• iOS 12 or higher 
Need help? Visit gohelp.discovery.com.

bluejetty:00024144:ios.description:
Welcome to EMERGENCY Operator, the ultimate 911 location-based game that turns your hometown into a thrilling playground of rescue missions! If you've ever wanted to step into the shoes of a firefighter, police officer, or any other first responder, this casual yet engaging game is for you. Jump into the action! Answer emergency calls in real time!
Dive into EMERGENCY Operator and embrace your sense of duty, as you manage a fleet of emergency vehicles and tackle a variety of real-world situations. Whether it's a blazing fire, a high-speed chase, or a medical emergency, your willingness to help and quick thinking will save the day.
This seriously fun game takes you on a wild ride through real streets and neighborhoods, making every mission feel like a true-to-life adventure. As an Operator, you'll answer 911 calls and dispatch police, firefighters, and other emergency vehicles to keep your city safe and maintain order.
With a lively and informal tone, EMERGENCY Operator lets you enjoy a unique, justice-oriented gaming experience. You'll manage 16 different types of vehicles, from firetrucks to SWAT teams, all in a location-based game that keeps you on your toes. Don't forget to train your units to boost their performance, ensuring you're always ready to face whatever challenges arise.
So, gear up and join the ranks of lawful heroes in EMERGENCY Operator. Compete with fellow players in your area and around the world to prove you're the ultimate 911 dispatcher. It's time to embrace your passion for justice and put your skills to the test in this one-of-a-kind location-based game! Ready for the challenge? Tackle emergency missions today!

bluejetty:00062994:ios.description:
Washed ashore a desolate island and surrounded by savage beasts, can you thrive...or merely survive?
Blaze trails into unknown territory...and then make it your own! Plant crops, build housing and power sources, and transform the island into your own personal paradise. As you progress, you'll be able to develop new gear and technology to take your adventure to the next level, including ways to travel to unexplored islands nearby!
The native fauna eyeing you as their next meal? Capture the critters, trade them with friends, and train them to fight for you! Most have elemental strengths and weaknesses, so use these to your advantage in battle.
Venture far enough afield and you may find signs of civilization. If you make the right friends, your humble isle could grow into an economic powerhouse, complete with hot springs, hotels, and heliport. The possibilities are as limitless as the horizon!
Survival of the fittest was never so fun! You call the shots as you develop your primitive isle into a luxurious slice of paradise!

bluejetty:00034679:android.description:
Do you want to have a restaurant that belongs to you completely? Then you have come to the right place! 🤩
 In this game, you are the restaurant owner in charge of everything, from restaurant design to restaurant management, you just need to make it look like you want.
The freshly sold restaurant is messy and dilapidated, to clean it up! ✨
It is so empty… Lacking some tables, chairs and kitchen utensils, to buy it! 💸
The guests ordered food, to cook it! 🍔
Here, you can do everything you want to do. Be a designer to complete restaurant design and furniture procurement. Be a chef to perform restaurant cooking management. Be a waiter to complete restaurant delivery and ordering. Be a happy restaurant executive managing the restaurant business. You will witness the perfect transformation of this restaurant and write your own restaurant story.
So are you ready to start your restaurant story? 😉
Maybe you are curious, what can you experience in the exciting restaurant games? Let me tell you~
-- 🏘 Design Restaurant
Buy the furniture you like for the restaurant and design it as you want. Not just the dine-in area, you can also complete kitchen design and kitchen remodel, turn it into a perfect cooking kitchen!
-- 📃 Make Food and Serve Customers
Take orders for the guests and make the food they want to eat. Burger, pizza, sandwich; milk, cola, icecream... try to meet the needs of the guests. 
-- 💰 Mange And Upgrade Your Business
Seriously manage the restaurant, expand the scale and upgrade your business.
Restaurant Story: Decor & Cook is always waiting for you. 
Hope you like this cooking diary restaurant game. 🥰 At the same time, we also welcome your suggestions and complaints. If you have any questions, please email us: Beyondthegame01@gmail.com.

Create professional i
bluejetty:00035304:ios.description:
Invoice Maker for Contractors is an invoice generator, estimate maker, and invoicing app for contractors, freelancers, self-employed professionals, consultants, creatives, and small business owners on iPhone and iPad.
Create professional invoices and estimates in seconds, manage clients and reusable items, track unpaid balances, generate polished invoice PDFs, and share or print documents directly from your Apple devices.
SIMPLE INVOICING FOR EVERYDAY BUSINESS
Invoice Maker helps you create an invoice without the complexity of traditional accounting software. It is built for independent professionals and small businesses that need a fast way to bill clients, prepare estimates, and keep invoicing organized.
Use Invoice Maker to:
• Create professional invoices
• Build and send estimates
• Manage clients, products, services, and invoice items
• Track unpaid and outstanding invoices
• Generate professional PDF invoices
• Share invoices and estimates
• Print invoices from iPhone or iPad
• Keep invoicing data organized across supported Apple devices
FAST INVOICE GENERATOR
Choose a client, add products, services, work, or other billable items, review the total, and create a customer-ready invoice.
Improved client and item workflows reduce repetitive steps, making Invoice Maker useful as a contractor invoice app, freelancer invoice generator, invoice builder, service invoice maker, and small business invoicing tool.
CREATE ESTIMATES BEFORE WORK STARTS
Prepare an estimate when a client needs pricing before approving a job or service. Add the relevant items or work, review the details, and share the finished estimate using your preferred method.
REDESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Invoice Maker has been redesigned from the ground up with a new adaptive workspace for iPhone and iPad.
On iPhone, create and review invoices quickly away from a desk. On iPad, use the larger workspace to review clients, items, totals, and documents with more room.
Creating, reviewing, sharing, and printing invoices is now faster and easier across Apple devices.
PRIVATE ICLOUD SYNC
On iOS 17 and later, Invoice Maker can privately sync your business information, clients, items, and invoices through iCloud.
Keep invoicing records available across supported Apple devices so you can continue working between iPhone and iPad without manually transferring business data.
PROFESSIONAL INVOICE PDFS
Turn invoice details into clean, client-ready PDF documents. Review the invoice before sending, then share it through email, messaging apps, or your preferred method.
Refined PDF sharing and printing help contractors, freelancers, and small businesses present professional billing documents to customers.
CLIENTS, ITEMS, AND BUSINESS DETAILS
Save client information, reusable products and services, business details, and invoice items so you do not have to enter the same information every time you create a new invoice or estimate.
TRACK UNPAID INVOICES
Keep invoices organized and review outstanding balances that still need attention. Invoice Maker gives independent professionals and small business owners a straightforward way to stay on top of billing.
ACCESSIBLE ON IOS
Invoice Maker supports Dark Mode, Larger Text, VoiceOver.
WHO IS INVOICE MAKER FOR?
Invoice Maker is designed for:
• Contractors and construction professionals
• Freelancers and independent professionals
• Self-employed workers and owner-operators
• Consultants and service businesses
• Creatives and designers
• Small business owners
If you are looking for an invoice generator for iPhone or iPad, contractor invoice app, freelancer invoice maker, invoice builder, estimate maker, small business invoice software, PDF invoice creator, or a simple way to create invoices and track unpaid balances, Invoice Maker provides a focused workflow for everyday business.
Create invoices. Send estimates. Manage clients. Generate PDFs. Track outstanding balances.

bluejetty:00087374:ios.summary:

We‘ve built this app in a partnership with the Easy German Youtube channel and have
bluejetty:00087374:ios.description:
Seedlang's focus is on improving your German speaking and listening skills. We do this by building interactive experiences using videos of native speakers.
We‘ve built this app in a partnership with the Easy German Youtube channel and have a strong focus on teaching German with real people and authentic language.
Why Seedlang?
Simply put, we combine real humor and fun with a deep understanding of the German language. We craft experiences that are unlike others you have experienced before. 
=== Interactive stories
We use video to tell stories that are fun, surprising, and memorable. This will help to give context to what you are learning and make building new memories feel effortless.
=== A new type of flashcards
You've never seen flashcards like these before. They combine video, speaking practice, and embedded grammar to create a fun and effective learning experience.
=== Active learning through speaking
Recording audio of your speech and comparing it with that of native speakers allows you to improve your pronunciation. As you practice these improvements, your muscle memory for the language strengthens and speaking becomes effortless.
=== Grammar at your fingertips
We are most receptive to learning grammar after we've made a mistake. So, if you make a mistake with a word, simply click it to display detailed grammar information. It's like having a grammar book always ready to tell you what you need to know, when you need to know it.
=== Customize your learning
Use our vocab trainer to build flashcard decks tailored to specific vocabulary that you want to learn. Each card is pulled from one of our stories and has all of the fun context that will make this vocabulary easy to remember.
=== Trivia game
Test your German comprehension by competing against other German students in an interactive trivia game.

⁃ Create unlimited reminders.

bluejetty:00065105:ios.description:
The Mobile Express banking app from Farmers Trust & Savings Bank is fast, secure and FREE for our Online Express internet banking customers. The Mobile Express app blends the security of Online Express internet banking with the convenience of your mobile device to provide you with 24/7 access to all your Farmers Trust accounts. Features include:
SEE YOUR ACCOUNTS
• View account balances and activity
• View transaction details
TRANSFER FUNDS
• Transfer funds between your Farmers Trust accounts
• View pending and scheduled transfers
• Transfer funds between your Farmers Trust accounts and accounts you own at other financial institutions
PAY BILLS
• Schedule payments and pay bills to established BillPay Express payees
• View, edit and cancel scheduled payments
POPMONEY
• Send money to someone you owe or know by using their email address or mobile phone number
• You must be enrolled in Bill Pay Express through Online Express internet banking to use this service
• The person you are sending money to must accept the funds using Popmoney services
MOBILE CHECK DEPOSIT
• Deposit checks into your checking or savings account using your smartphone
• View previous checks you have deposited
To access Mobile Express banking, you must be enrolled in Online Express internet banking. If you are not already signed up for Online Express internet banking visit https://www.ftsbia.com or call 319-668-2525 for assistance.
Mobile Express banking is offered as a free service to Farmers Trust’s Online Express internet banking users. You may incur, and are responsible for, any charges assessed by your communications service provider.

bluejetty:00022967:ios.summary:
There is nothing more exciting than shooting in beautiful zombie games. And if you’re looking for shooting games to play anytime and anywhere, without the internet, without paying to win, why don’t try our ZOMBIE HUNTER - Offline Games?
ZO
bluejetty:00022967:ios.description:
There is nothing more exciting than shooting in beautiful zombie games. And if you’re looking for shooting games to play anytime and anywhere, without the internet, without paying to win, why don’t try our ZOMBIE HUNTER - Offline Games?
ZOMBIE HUNTER - Offline Games is another combination between Dead zombie shooting & Apocalypse, except that you will shoot zombies offline through really challenging game matches. Thus, in the beginning, you might feel it’s kind of similar to some zombie shooting games out there. Don’t worry, it is much simpler but only better with:
- Story-driven offline shooting game (Campaign mode)
- Heroic characters have their own story and personality
- Nearly 100 modern weapons (Assault Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Machine guns), melee (Katana, Tomahawk, Machete), and thrown objects (grenades)
- Drones as side weapons and companions
- Unique zombies requiring smart strategy to kill
- Precise and easy-to-learn game controls
- High-quality 3D graphics and realistic sounds
- Unpredictable, steady non-stop action
- Theme-driven Event Pass: new unique weapons every 2 weeks
- Global Outbreak: online leaderboard to find who can go farthest
- Bounty: players experience special modes such as shooting big-headed zombies or only shooting at the body, etc.
This intense game is easy to learn to play. You will have fun for hours with endless shooting mode to train your skills as a zombie hunter on a variety of dead targets and mad zombies. Zombie hunter is a fearless shooting hero.
The zombie virus is unpredictable and dangerous. Fat zombies, jumping zombies, mad zombies, and toxic unkilled zombies are everywhere, there’s no place to hide. In ZOMBIE HUNTER - Offline Games, there’re zombies that can crawl on the floor and the ceiling. They can come to you at any time. So, be aware! The main rule of surviving in this world is shooting all zombies till the last day on the planet.
The game has diversity in weapon systems such as sniper rifles, assault rifles, shotguns, machine guns, and more. Killing is no more difficult in this shooting game. It gives you a cyber environment to use different shooting tactics in an open world of zombies! 
LESS FRUSTRATION WITH OFFLINE GAMES
Most zombie shooting games require wifi or an internet connection to play. But when you decide to download offline shooting games, you might soon be disappointed with their low-quality graphics. Don’t mind, Zombie Hunter - Offline Games is at your service! This zombie game is a great time killer. With super nice graphics and cutting-edge technology, it will surprise you with shooting effects that are realistic and stunning in different gameplays. Save more data and play offline games!
BUILD AND UPGRADE YOUR BASE
Hunters also need to build their bases to ensure that they can survive through the world war zombie's tough time. A base is a place that can provide you with stuff that is crucial to join shooting campaigns and fight against zombie hordes! Death is coming to humans no matter by daylight or night, and no one can assure your life.
Download Zombie Hunter - Offline Games now! Get this fun offline game and ready to kill all the dead targets. If you want to socialize with other players in-game, don’t hesitate to join Leaderboards (online modes) and gain amazing rewards. A lot of awesome zombie shooting matches are waiting for you, so play now and explore all the great features this offline game has to offer.

bluejetty:00186960:ios.summary: Ready to turn learning the ABCs into a joyful adventure for your child? Introducing "ABC Learning Fun!", the ultimate educational app completely redesigned for toddlers and preschoolers! We've rebuilt our app from the ground up to be more e
bluejetty:00186960:ios.description:
Ready to turn learning the ABCs into a joyful adventure for your child? Introducing "ABC Learning Fun!", the ultimate educational app completely redesigned for toddlers and preschoolers! We've rebuilt our app from the ground up to be more engaging, interactive, and effective in helping your little one master the alphabet.
With vibrant illustrations and a huge variety of mini-games, our app transforms learning into a fun experience that kids will want to play again and again.
Key Features:
- Multiple Game Modes: From memory matching and picture-to-letter quizzes to uppercase/lowercase challenges and phonics games, there's always a new way to learn and play.
- Fun ABC Song: The classic ABC song is just a tap away! Let your kids listen and sing along to help them effortlessly remember the alphabet sequence.
- Interactive Flashcards: Explore each letter and its corresponding word with our beautiful flashcards. Tap to hear the letter name and the phonic sound, reinforcing auditory learning.
- Letter Tracing Practice: Develop fine motor skills with our intuitive letter tracing activity. Children can trace both uppercase and lowercase letters with guided steps and a palette of fun colors.
- Progressive Learning System: Unlock new levels as you master the alphabet. Our level-based progression provides a sense of accomplishment and keeps children motivated.
Why Choose Our App?
- Kid-Friendly Design: A simple, colorful, and intuitive interface designed for little hands.
- Quality Content: Developed with early childhood education principles in mind to ensure a meaningful learning experience.
- Playful Learning: We make education feel like play, keeping your child engaged and eager to learn.
Download "ABC Learning Fun!" today and give your child the gift of a lifelong love for learning!

bluejetty:00065249:ios.description:
Enjoy doing more with QIB Mobile app. Available 24/7, QIB Mobile allows you to access all your accounts, check your finance status, perform many activities on your cards, transfer money locally and internationally, pay for your utility bills and more. 
QIB Mobile is available to all QIB Individual customers with an active ATM Card and PIN. As soon as you download and install the application, you can create your username and password to enjoy a seamless banking experience.
FEATURES
· Login using your Touch ID
· View all your current and saving accounts and fixed deposits
· Check the status of your finance
· Check the status of your investments
· View accounts transaction history
· Transfer funds within locally and internationally
· View all your debit, charge and credit cards, settle early payments, view transactions history, activate/deactivate your cards and enable cards’ Magnetic stripe for international use
· View and Pay your bills/Top up Ooredoo, Vodafone and Kahramaa
· Locate the nearest QIB Branch or ATM and book a visit to meet your teller or Customer Service representative
· Check foreign currency exchange rates
· Update your contact details
SECURITY AND PRIVACY
QIB Mobile Banking is secure and safe. We have introduced the two factor authentication using the One-Time-Password authentication (OTP) to further secure your banking account. OTP will be received either by SMS to your registered mobile number or by downloading QIB Aman app to be used upon logging in to your account and upon performing a banking transaction.
Your account information is not and will not be stored anywhere on your device. We have also implemented the latest security technologies. We are committed to your privacy and account details safety. See our online privacy policy on www.qib.com.qa
CONTACT US
We are there to help you 24/7. You can contact us through email
Mobilebanking@qib.com.qa
or call our Contact Center on 4444 8444 for further assistance

bluejetty:00036992:ios.description:
Take your best shot on the world’s most iconic golf courses with PGA TOUR Pro Golf, an Apple Arcade exclusive that brings the thrill of professional golf to your fingertips. Compete, upgrade, and rise to the top in this immersive golf experience.
Play Real-World Courses
Test your skills on breathtaking recreations of legendary courses, including:
- Pebble Beach Golf Links
- The Links at Spanish Bay
- Spyglass Hill Golf Course
- Firestone Country Club
- Bay Hill Club & Lodge
- Harbour Town Golf Links
- Latrobe Country Club
- TPC Sawgrass
- Craig Ranch
- Sedgefield
- TPC Southwind
- TPC Scottsdale
- Bear's Best Atlanta
- Fairmont Chateau Whistler Golf Club
…and more on the way!
FedExCup Mode
Just like the pros on Tour, your path to glory starts right here. Every tournament you play earns you FedExCup Points, the better you place, the more points you rack up. Climb the leaderboard over the course of the season, outplay your rivals, and go after some amazing prizes. This is your chance to show you’ve got what it takes to be the best!
PGA TOUR Campaign Mode
Hone your skills as you take on unique challenges, set in real-world courses, in this engaging single-player mode. Everyone win gets you closer to PGA TOUR greatness.
Simultaneous Head-To-Head Mode
Forget waiting for turns—compete in real-time against fellow golfers as everyone plays simultaneously. Fast-paced and thrilling, it’s golf like you’ve never played before.
Daily and Multi-Day Tournaments
Challenge yourself with multi-round tournaments held daily or across multiple days. Prove your skills and climb the leaderboards to earn exclusive rewards.
Gear Up and Earn Big
Customize your game by upgrading clubs and equipment. Earn coins across all modes to unlock the best gear to improve your performance.
Download PGA TOUR Pro Golf now on Apple Arcade and bring your A-game to the most celebrated golf courses. Are you ready to tee off and take the crown?
Features at a Glance:
- Stunning real-world courses, faithfully recreated
- Real-time, simultaneous head-to-head mode
- Competitive daily and multi-day tournaments
- Gear upgrades and rewards to enhance your play
- Tee up on the world’s greatest golf courses. 
Download now and start your journey!

bluejetty:00088939:ios.name: Swvl - Daily Rides
bluejetty:00088939:ios.summary:
Where comfort, affordability, and reliability meet in one transportation app⁠—Swvl is the ultimate solution to premium and safe rides in Egypt and Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
The Swvl app is an online platform, trusted by millions of people, t
bluejetty:00088939:ios.description:
Where comfort, affordability, and reliability meet in one transportation app⁠—Swvl is the ultimate solution to premium and safe rides in Egypt and Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
The Swvl app is an online platform, trusted by millions of people, that provides inter and intra city affordable rides every day. Get access to thousands of daily comfortable rides and make commuting as easy as a click of a button.
- 5 Million people around the globe use Swvl regularly
- 16000+ reliable rides every day in more than 115 cities
- 75000+ bus stations across the cities
Swvl Daily -
Move around in your city effortlessly while saving up on your transportation costs. Whether you need a flexible ride to class, or fixed daily rides to work, or a last-minute ride from the nearest stop to run errands—Swvl makes hassle-free intra city commute possible in Cairo, Alexandria, Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Faisalabad, Nairobi, Amman, Buenos Aires and Santiago. Enjoy comfortable bus rides that operate at fixed stations and timings, and make your daily commute easier and better at the best price.
Swvl Travel - 
Book your comfortable bus rides, whether it’s for a quick vacation or a long commute. Swvl Travel connects cities together with a network of hundreds of stations across megacities so that you can travel from the nearest station and arrive at your destination hassle-free. 
Swvl Charter - 
So, you’re planning a weekend getaway, family picnic, or a corporate trip—the question is, how do you get there comfortably while keeping the cost down? This is where Swvl comes in. With experienced captains, on-request vehicle inspection, and constantly available customer support, we’ll make sure you’re always taken care of. Request a private bus all for yourself that can take you anywhere in the country.
App -
The Swvl app is super easy to use. All you need to do is turn on location settings and enter your destination, the app will show you all available stations and timings. Once you pick your perfect ride, Swvl will show you a google maps link with directions to go meet your captain at your chosen station.
Safety -
All Swvl rides are tracked and monitored on the app to ensure the best quality, and all Swvl Captains are well-trained and punctual. The Swvl Support Team is available 24/7 to take care of your concerns.
Affordability -
Swvl is considered 70% more affordable than other options, also, you can find your first ride promo code in the app as a small welcome gift.
Earn Swvl credits easily by referring Swvl to your friends and sharing your code.
Pro tip: Subscribe to a Swvl Package and it will give you the maximum discount in your city.
Swvl Business -
If you’re a decision-maker in your business and want to add transportation benefits for your employees, you’re at the right place. Swvl Business will tailor and optimize safe bus rides or car rides for your employees so that you can add the benefit of transportation at a minimal cost. Please send us an email at business@swvl.com and one of our Swvl Experts will contact you shortly.
Download the Swvl app and start Swvl-ing your way across cities.

bluejetty:00169699:ios.description:
Rizz: Step Your Game Up!
Are you tired of swiping left and right endlessly, hoping to catch the attention of that special someone on dating apps and websites? Look no further than Rizz, your ultimate AI companion dedicated to revolutionizing your online dating experience and helping you achieve more meaningful matches.
Step up your online dating game with Rizz, the app that empowers you to create the best dating profile tailored to attract the kind of person you've been searching for. Our cutting-edge AI technology is here to provide you with the guidance and support you need to present yourself in the best possible light.
**Dating Profile Pictures AI Evaluation**
Wondering if your profile pictures are making the right impression? Rizz's advanced AI system will give you accurate, kind, and judgment-free feedback about your photos. Say goodbye to the uncertainty of which pictures to use and let our intelligent algorithm assist you in selecting the ones that showcase your true essence.
**Match Points**
Improve your picture-taking skills with ease, as Rizz provides you with clear, fair, and concise Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to quickly understand how to enhance your visual appeal. With Match Points, you'll be well on your way to capturing the attention of potential matches.
**Personalized Tips**
At Rizz, we understand that every individual is unique. That's why our AI takes into account a wide array of variables to offer you the most accurate and personalized tips ever. Whether it's about your photo composition, style, or expression, rest assured that Rizz has got you covered.
**Generate New Pictures with Rizz Photoboot AI**
Why settle for just a few photos when Rizz can generate a plethora of options for you? Choose from over 15 different generative styles meticulously designed to suit your personality. Let our AI create a vast collection of photos, ensuring you find the one that resonates with your true self.
**Privacy First**
We prioritize your privacy and security. Your data is safe with us, and we take great care to delete all photos from our servers as soon as they are no longer required. Feel confident and reassured as you embark on your dating journey with Rizz by your side.
**No to Catfish**
Ever worried about being deceived by unrealistic or heavily edited photos? With Rizz, you can bid farewell to such concerns. We ensure that the results you receive are on par with those of a professional photoshoot – no less, no more. This way, you can be authentic and attract genuine connections.
Join Rizz today and take the first step towards enhancing your online dating experience. Step Your Game Up with our AI-powered platform and unlock the potential to find your perfect match effortlessly.
More features are on the way!
**SUBSCRIPTION PLANS**
Weekly or Yearly
**PAYMENT & CANCELLATION**
- You may cancel your subscription at any time
Subscriptions are billed at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless cancelled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period.
You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00088213:ios.name: Airway Trainer - Stop Snoring
bluejetty:00088213:ios.summary: Achieve quieter and healthier sleep in just 5 minutes a day! These exercises strengthen your tongue, throat, and upper airway muscles to reduce snoring and give you more restful nights. Most users notice significant results in just weeks.
bluejetty:00088213:ios.description:
Achieve quieter and healthier sleep in just 5 minutes a day! These exercises strengthen your tongue, throat, and upper airway muscles to reduce snoring and give you more restful nights. Most users notice significant results in just weeks.
One of the main contributors to snoring and breathing disturbances is weak muscles in the mouth and throat. This app provides a comprehensive 6-week guided program which helps tone your upper airway muscles to reduce snoring vibrations and improve healthy breathing.
Airway Trainer will guide your through exercises in the program to strengthen your tongue, soft palate, cheeks, throat, and jaw muscles. 
Key Features:
- Exercises tailored to your unique needs.
- Simple, step-by-step instructions for every session.
- See how your snoring and sleep improve over time.
- Just 5 minutes a day for real results.
- Further lifestyle techniques to improve breathing & snoring 
Benefits:
- Reduced snoring and quieter nights.
- Improved sleep quality and daytime energy.
- A natural, non-invasive solution to better breathing.
Join thousands of users who’ve already transformed their sleep and health. Whether you’re addressing snoring and/or breathing disturbances, this app is your path to better nights and brighter days.
Thank you to Nicole Goldfarb for exercise videos and guidance! Find her here: https://sandiegocenterforspeechtherapy.com/staff/nicole-goldfarb-m-a-ccc-slp-com/
Unlimited access to features:
- You can subscribe for access to all the app has to offer
- Subscriptions are billed automatically at a rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
Disclaimer: We do not provide medical advice. All recommendations are intended as suggestions only. Please consult your doctor before making any medical decisions.
The exercises provided are based on evidence-supported methods but are not certified as medical treatments. This app does not measure, diagnose or treat medical conditions.
Subscription Details:
Your App Store Account will be charged upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions can be managed and canceled through your Account Settings. Canceled subscriptions remain active until the end of the billing period. Subscriptions automatically renew 24 hours before the current period ends, with charges applied to your account during this time. Auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/snore-sleep-apnea-trainer/privacy-policy?authuser=0
Terms of service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Contact us: earlylanding@gmail.com

bluejetty:00175385:ios.description:
Parking convenience is at your fingertips with the new and improved MPLS Parking app. Pay for parking on your mobile device, get notified before your time runs out, and extend your time without visiting a parking meter (note that time extension rules vary location by location).
Key features of the app include:
 • Mobile Payments via smart phone or web
 • Find my car (for those of us who forget where they parked)
 • Face ID
 • Event parking
 • Snow Emergency Alert
Registration for MPLS Parking is free: just create your account via the app. Once you’ve created an account, you can park and pay for parking in any location parking available in Minneapolis. 
How to Use the App:
 • Create an account 
 • Choose the vehicle license plate
 • Select your location on the map
 • Use the dial to choose how long you want to park 
 • Confirm your payment
Payment with MPLS Parking App is ultra secure. Your data is protected and our process is certified via 3rd party audit against Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards.

Whether you’re stealing luxury cars, executing covert operations, or engaging in intense shootouts, every choice you make shapes your journey. As you progress, you’ll unlock new vehicles, weapons, and abilities that will help you dominate the city like a true **real gangster**.

The detailed environment of this **open city world crime game** brings the chaos and glamour of the criminal underworld to life.

Start small with basic units and merge identical ones to create stronger, more advanced forms. Every merge increases power, unlocks new abi
bluejetty:00132987:android.description:
Growvia: Merge to Scale Up is a relaxing yet strategic merge game where growth is the ultimate goal.
Start small with basic units and merge identical ones to create stronger, more advanced forms. Every merge increases power, unlocks new abilities, and pushes your progression to higher levels.
Earn resources through active play and idle rewards, then use them to upgrade your units and accelerate your growth. As you scale up, unlock a wide variety of unique units, each contributing differently to your overall strength and strategy.
Challenges become tougher as you progress, encouraging smart merging decisions and efficient upgrades. Even when you’re away, your units continue to grow automatically, ensuring constant progression.
With simple controls, satisfying merge mechanics, and endless scaling potential, Growvia: Merge to Scale Up offers a smooth and rewarding experience for players who love steady growth and long-term progression.

bluejetty:00144072:ios.description:
Stay ahead of the curve with exclusive offers and discounts on our exquisite floral arrangements and gifts at LolaFlora, your go-to online florist! With our user-friendly app, you can conveniently place orders anytime and surprise your loved ones with same-day delivery options, utilizing our daily alerts and special promotions. Explore our diverse selection of top-quality flowers and arrangements right at your fingertips. Sending heartfelt flowers is just a click away!
LolaFlora stands out as one of Mexico's most reputable and popular florists and shopping apps. Browse through our extensive range of flower bouquets and gifts, tailored to your preferences, with the convenience of filtering through hundreds of items in our flowers and gifts categories. Skip the trip to a physical store and enjoy the seamless experience on our iOS application. Simplify your online shopping with just a few clicks. Download the LolaFlora app today and send flowers or gifts across the country, leveraging our extensive vendor network. Sending flowers has never been this effortless!
Our diverse flower collection features roses, gerberas, lilies, orchids, carnations, daisies, lisianthus, and more, including fresh seasonal blooms and unique combined arrangements. Discover our products and surprise your loved ones on any occasion - be it a thank you, birthday, anniversary, or a spontaneous gesture! Share a stunning arrangement customized to your requirements...
Send flowers within seconds with our same-day delivery service, available throughout Mexico!
At LolaFlora, we strive to be your preferred florist and online store. Our dedication to detail and commitment to crafting exquisite bouquets have brought us closer to you each day, allowing us to cater to your needs, special moments, and celebrations. Sending flowers or gifts adds a touch of surprise to every event. Explore our app to view our range of products for your special occasions and take advantage of our exclusive discounts.
Imagine the joy of gifting a perfectly timed flower arrangement at a birthday party or anniversary dinner - a double surprise that guarantees smiles and adds a special touch to celebrate the lives of your loved ones. Whether it's vibrant gerberas for a birth or opening ceremony, red roses for love and romance, white roses for weddings, or even blue and yellow roses, we have a bouquet for every occasion. From white daisies to colorful lisianthus, lilies, and orchids, celebrate a friend's birthday or new job with our diverse selection.
Explore our wide variety of carnations and exotic plants. In recognition that life has its challenges, we also offer funeral arrangements and bouquets to support you and your loved ones during difficult times.
From flowers and potted plants to anniversary and birthday gifts, or simply 'just because,' showing someone how much they mean to you is always a thoughtful gesture. Special gifts bring love, affection, and happiness into the lives of those you cherish. A bouquet of flowers symbolizes new beginnings, good wishes, love, and the beauty of life - a reminder to flourish and grow even in tough times...
Effortless Payment Solutions for Seamless Shopping
Experience the ultimate convenience in online shopping with our app, designed to provide you with a smooth payment experience. Whether you prefer credit cards like Visa, Mastercard, and American Express or convenient options like OXXO and PayPal, we ensure a secure and hassle-free payment process. Introducing Comodo as a payment method further enhances your security and flexibility. Shop worry-free by downloading our app today.
Explore our extensive collection of flowers, arrangements, potted plants, and more! Don't hesitate - surprise your loved ones with flowers today, with LolaFlora making it all possible with just one click.

bluejetty:00092887:ios.name: London Taxi.
bluejetty:00092887:ios.summary:
London Taxi is the leading provider of taxi ride services in London Ontario, Canada.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free London Taxi application.
Key Features of the Lon
bluejetty:00092887:ios.description:
London Taxi is the leading provider of taxi ride services in London Ontario, Canada.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free London Taxi application.
Key Features of the London Taxi application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call London Taxi with the push of a button
To begin using the London Taxi application today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The London Taxi application retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the London Taxi application or calling us at 877-657-1122 or 519-657-1111. 
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the London Taxi application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00015433:ios.summary:

It is reported that the Prophet
bluejetty:00015433:ios.description:
Manzil is a beautiful collection of selected Quranic verses, traditionally recited as a means of spiritual protection and healing (Ruqyah) from black magic, jinn, witchcraft, sihr, sorcery, and the evil eye.
It is reported that the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) himself was once afflicted by sorcery, and he sought relief through the recitation of Quranic verses. Various authentic traditions highlight the powerful impact of certain parts of the Quran in repelling harm, promoting general well-being, and helping us become better practicing Muslims.
The Manzil consists of 33 verses from different parts of the Quran, offering protection from spiritual harm, evil forces, and physical dangers such as thieves or harmful creatures.
It includes verses from the following chapters:
- Al-Fatihah (1:1–7)
- Al-Baqarah (2:1–5, 163, 255–257, 284–286)
- Aal Imran (3:18, 26–27)
- Al-A'raf (7:54–56)
- Al-Israa (17:110–111)
- Al-Mu’minoon (23:115–118)
- As-Saaffaat (37:1–11)
- Ar-Rahman (55:33–40)
- Al-Hashr (59:21–24)
- Al-Jinn (72:1–4)
- Al-Kaafiroon (109:1–6)
- Al-Ikhlas (112:1–4)
- Al-Falaq (113:1–5)
- An-Naas (114:1–6)
It is recommended to recite the full Manzil once or three times in a single sitting, ideally once in the morning and once in the evening.
We hope this app serves you well on your journey of faith and protection. Please share your feedback and let us know if there's anything you'd like to see added.
And most importantly, remember us in your duas.
With gratitude,
RayhanLabs.com

bluejetty:00042148:ios.description:
Discover and enjoy online shopping from the biggest brands in sportswear fashion. From Nike, adidas, Reebok, Jordan, Under Armour and Puma, to lifestyle brands including Converse, Vans, Timberland and adidas Originals - Sun & Sand Sports houses them all. Our stores contain a variety of products from apparel to footwear, and equipment - suitable for women, men and kids for all kinds of sports. 
Got a sport or hobby? We’ve got the collections to match. From the perfect football shoes for men, to tech leggings for yoga and CrossFit for women, after-school activewear for kids - even fitness accessories for your sport. We provide all your essentials for all levels of athletes. From lifestyle basketball sneakers and track running shoes to swimming caps, tennis rackets and fitness kits. We narrow your choices down in a few easy steps. 
Following a fitness trend? Waiting on the new sneakers? We have the hottest products and looks just in, so you don’t need to shop anywhere else. This app shows you brand new trends on a regular basis so there’s always something exciting to discover. Want a fun, shopping experience? We’ll help you. On the go or from your own home, you can shop and get your favorite products delivered to your door in just a few clicks with the easy-to-use functions. 
Looking for offers and deals? We regularly provide you with all the updates on sales and the best discounts available. In addition, we notify you about product launches and seasonal releases beforehand so you can ready your shopping carts. Our app also gives you a chance to see what sports products and fitness ranges are available at our outlet stores.
Check out the app’s unique features: 
- Start your Sun & Sand Sports shopping journey, choosing from six categories: New In, Women, Men, Kids, Brands and Sports collections 
- Delve deeper and refine your search with our simple filters 
- Sort products by the latest style, brand name, or price - Save items to your basket as you shop for more 
- Customized location specific GCC stores whether you are in the UAE, KSA or Kuwait.
Just for you: - Pay by credit card, or Cash on Delivery (COD) - Free returns - Free exchanges 
Follow us on: - Twitter, Instagram and Facebook 
Have a question? - Shake your app! Shake your smartphone side to side and you can give us feedback directly from the app

bluejetty:00083862:ios.description:
DogHood is the neighbourhood community for dog parents.
Join 18,000+ dog owners across 400+ US cities. 
Find playdates for your dog, join monthly pack walks, get training advice from local certified trainers and discover dog-friendly parks and services near you — all in one app built exclusively for dog owners.
YOUR LOCAL DOG COMMUNITY 
The moment you sign up you're added to your local neighbourhood feed. See what dog parents near you are talking about, ask questions and connect with dogs within 25 miles.
PLAYDATES & PACK WALKS
Schedule one-on-one playdates with compatible dogs nearby. Join free monthly pack walks organised by local trainers and community leaders in your city. Real walks. Real dogs. Real neighbours.
MESSAGE DOG PARENTS DIRECTLY 
Connect and chat with dog parents near you. Our Handshake system means you only receive messages from people you choose — safe, private and spam-free.
DISCOVER NEARBY 
Explore dog-friendly parks, upcoming meetups and local pet services on a live map. Find a trusted trainer, walker or sitter in your neighbourhood with one tap.
TRAINING TIPS FROM LOCAL EXPERTS 
Certified dog trainers in your community answer real questions from real dog parents. Ask about behaviour, training, anxiety, socialisation and more — and get expert advice from someone who knows your neighbourhood.
100% DOG OWNERS 
Every single DogHood user owns a dog. No filtering needed. Every connection you make is with someone who understands exactly what your life looks like.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00175049:ios.summary: Parents who are divorced, separated, or were never legally married use TalkingParents to manage all communication regarding their children. Whether your co-parenting situation is amicable or high conflict, our cutting-edge tools make joint
bluejetty:00175049:ios.description:
Parents who are divorced, separated, or were never legally married use TalkingParents to manage all communication regarding their children. Whether your co-parenting situation is amicable or high conflict, our cutting-edge tools make joint custody easier to navigate, while keeping interactions saved to a court-admissible Record. TalkingParents is here to help you coordinate more seamlessly, set boundaries, and focus on what matters most: your children.
Secure Messaging: Send messages that can’t be edited or deleted and easily organize them by topic. All messages and read receipts are timestamped, allowing you to see when your co-parent sent or viewed a message.
Sentiment Scanner + Writing Assist: Scan messages for sentiment before you send them to understand how your words may come across. Rewrite messages using professionally developed communication methods designed to reduce tension and minimize conflict.
Accountable Calling: Make phone and video calls, complete with recordings and transcripts, without ever having to share your phone number.

bluejetty:00160123:ios.summary:
Spades card game classic • Solo and Multiplayer • Smart bots • Thousands of people to play with • Play online with friends • Interactive tutorial • Free and no signup required!
Play Spades to your heart's content with the official Spades c
bluejetty:00160123:ios.description:
Spades card game classic • Solo and Multiplayer • Smart bots • Thousands of people to play with • Play online with friends • Interactive tutorial • Free and no signup required!
Play Spades to your heart's content with the official Spades card game app from World of Card Games. Pair up with people by joining one of our tables, play by yourself against our bots, or create a private table and invite your friends and family to play. Our game is free to play and no signup is required.
Spades is a trick-taking game played by 4 people who are divided into teams of 2, with team players sitting across from each other. Teamwork, skillful bidding, and strategic cooperation are key to winning the game.
The goal of the game is to get your team to 500 points. Cards are ranked from Ace being the highest value to 2 being the lowest. At the start of the game, each player is dealt 13 cards, and the player to the left of the dealer goes first. In each round, players bid on how many tricks they can take. Each team combines their bids to determine how many tricks they have to take to avoid negative points.
Players must follow the suit of the card that has been laid down before their turn. If they don't have that suit on hand, they can play any card, except a suit of Spades, on the first trick. A suit of Spades can be played once they've been "broken" and have become the "trump" suit.
After each hand, scores are calculated. A team will receive 10 points per trick bid if they meet or exceed their bid, with 1 point for each extra trick taken. If a team fails to meet their bid, they'll get 10 points deducted from their score for each trick bid. Every 10 extra tricks, also called bags, a team accumulates costs the team 100 points. The game ends when a team either reaches 500 points or falls below -200 points. The highest-scoring team wins.
We're always open to suggestions, so feel free to reach out to us at https://worldofcardgames.com/spades with suggestions for improvements.
=== FEATURES:
=== Play against the computer using our bots
If you're new to a game, playing against others can feel intimidating. We always suggest playing against the computer before playing against other people. Our intelligent bots should be challenging enough, even for experienced players.
=== Play against other people online
We have a great community of card players. People are generally really nice to each other, and you can always find an open table to join. Just click List of Tables to find a table to your liking.
=== Play against friends or family at a private table
Meeting fellow card game enthusiasts online is nice, but nothing beats a game against friends or family. Start a private table and let your friends know about the table name to get them to join.
=== Ranked games and global leaderboards
If you're serious about your card games or have a competitive streak, ranked games are for you. These games are reserved for more series players and will only be accessible to you once you've signed up and played 10 games. Ranked players have a chance to end up on the daily leaderboard.
=== Custom design and avatars
Change the background and card design to something that suits you better. With 160+ different avatars, you're sure to be able to find one to your liking.
=== Join ongoing games and chat with other players
Click List of Tables to join an ongoing game. There are always live players at the site, so you're sure to find someone to play with. You can even chat with other players once you've joined a game, but remember to be friendly!
=== Detailed statistics and hand histories
Sign up to the site to be able to see detailed statistics. You can even save your hand history so you have a chance to analyze them later on!

Office Word: Edit Word Documents is a powerful and user-friendly app that lets you create, edit, view, share, and manage your documents and files on the go. Whether you're one busy professional crafting reports and proposals, a student juggling assignments, or simply need to jot down quick notes, this app equips you with everything you need to conquer your docs needs.
1. Interface and Formatting Tools
Sleek and intuitive interface for effortless document and file navigation and editing.
Variety of formatting tools to customize and edit your Word docs (fonts, text sizes, bold, italic, underline, highlight).
Ability to seamlessly insert tables, images, and charts into your Word files.
2. Collaboration Features
Real-time collaboration capabilities to create, edit, or annotate documents simultaneously with team members.
Commenting directly on specific parts of the document or file to facilitate clear communication and feedback.
3. Security Options
Password protection for your Word files to ensure security.
Two-factor authentication for authorized access to your documents.
Robust security features to keep your documents safe.

Suitable for both personal and professional document and file creation and editing.
Ideal for students, freelancers, and business owners to edit, create, or manage their documents.
Seamless integration with popular cloud services like Google Drive and Dropbox for easy document and file sharing.
5. Free trials and subscriptions
Try out all paid features for free for 3 days to experience the power of editing your documents and files.
Select a plan that best suits your needs to edit or create Word docs.
Cancel anytime without any obligations. Subscription will be charged to your credit card through your App Store account. Effortlessly create, edit, view, share, and manage Word docs.

Ensure security with password protection and two-factor authentication for your Word docs.

bluejetty:00155420:ios.description:
CookGo: Easy Recipe Import & Smart Management
CookPal is now CookGo — your all-in-one recipe app just got a fresh name and look.
CookGo makes it easy to save, organize, and cook recipes from anywhere. Whether it's a viral dish on Instagram, a recipe from Facebook, or a quick photo of your ingredients — CookGo turns everything into clean, structured recipes with nutrition info you can trust. With CookGo, cooking inspiration from any platform becomes your personalized digital cookbook.
Key Features
Easy Recipe Import
Import recipes directly from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, or any website link with CookGo.
One-tap import—no copy-paste needed when you use CookGo.
Snap a photo of a dish or ingredients, and CookGo will recognize and generate the recipe for you automatically.
Smart Recipe Search
Select ingredients you already have, and CookGo instantly suggests creative recipe ideas.
Search recipes by ingredient, cooking time, or dietary needs—all within CookGo's smart search system.
Intelligent Organization
Save recipes into smart recipe books that CookGo auto-categorizes for you.
Easily edit, organize, and manage your recipes your way with CookGo's intuitive interface.
Search and filter by name, tags, or ingredients—CookGo keeps everything at your fingertips.
Flexible Cooking Mode
Follow CookGo's step-by-step guided cooking mode with adjustable servings.
Each CookGo recipe includes clear steps, ingredient lists, and accurate nutrition values.
Scale ingredient amounts instantly in CookGo based on how many people you're serving.
Why CookGo?
Never lose viral recipes again—CookGo keeps them all in one secure place.
Cook smarter with CookGo's built-in nutrition info and calorie tracking.
Enjoy every meal with CookGo, your AI-powered recipe assistant that learns your taste over time.
From quick weekday lunches to weekend feasts, CookGo makes cooking simple, smart, and fun. With CookGo, every meal starts with confidence and ends with satisfaction.
Secure
Privacy: https://cookgo.life/privacy
Terms: https://cookgo.life/terms
Marketing URL: https://cookgo.life/

bluejetty:00062809:ios.description:
Discover the world of knowledge with Ultimate Facts. Our app is the ultimate source for fascinating and informative facts. Our team of experts has carefully selected thousands of facts from hundreds of different subjects, all verified for accuracy. 
**** Daily exciting and Random Facts! **** 
We make learning fun with Ultimate Facts. Ultimate Facts helps you learn something new and exciting daily by showing you random facts when you unlock your phone. Just set your preferences, like when and how many facts you want to know, and let Ultimate Facts do the rest. 
There are many features in Ultimate Facts that no fact app has. For example, It has an "Article" page with a detailed explanation of each point and a resource link to gain insight and learn more. 
**** Discover Fun Facts Now! **** 
Our editors meticulously check all the facts in Ultimate Fact from the most reliable sources such as academic papers, Wikipedia, History, National Geographic, Guinness World Records, and many more. 
All facts have audio recordings. This way, you can listen to the facts whenever you want while walking, running, or doing sports. 
With Ultimate Facts, you can be the most famous person in the environment. Knowing about everything will give you respect. You can start the most beautiful conversations with your friends. You can instantly share a fact you like from social media applications such as WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, 9gag, and Reddit. 
When you start Ultimate Facts, you will have more and more curiosity. It's an excellent opportunity to learn new things constantly. 
**** Remember, Knowledge is Power! **** 
We have brought together the most exciting and informative facts about hundreds of subjects, from History to Health, the Universe to the Brain, and Sports to Animals. You will see the appropriate facts when you specify the topics you want to be informed about. 
In Ultimate Facts, there is much information on topics like Science, the Universe, Art, WW1, WW2, and the Human body. And there is even more! Health, Sexuality, Cars, Continents, Brain, and the Vatican are other topics in the app. 
In Ultimate Facts, you will find lots of fun facts that are interesting and informative. You can go with a specific topic or let the app present you with random facts. You can bookmark your favorite facts for later viewing and share them with your friends. You can read detailed articles about the truth you want or even go directly to the source of information. 
Ultimate Facts provides exciting and informative facts and encourages the development of good learning habits. As Aristotle said, "Excellence is not an act, but a habit." Make learning a daily habit with Ultimate Facts. 
----------
Daily Facts terms of service
1 week Facts + from 4.99$ per week (prices may vary slightly depending on the region).
1 month Facts+ from 19.99$ per month (prices may vary slightly depending on the region)
You can find all in-app purchases on this app store page below under “In-app purchases”.
Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless they have been switched off at least 24 hours before the subscription period expires. Your account will be charged within 24 hours of payment. You can manage your subscriptions in the iOS settings and switch the automatic renewal on or off. A subscription that is already running cannot be canceled within the term that has already started.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/ultimatefactsios/privacy/ 
Terms of Use: https://zipoapps.com/ultimatefactsios/terms/

bluejetty:00085643:ios.description:
KiLi, c'est l'appli ludique et éducative de l'école des loisirs, dédiée aux enfants jusqu'à 10 ans. 
KiLi, c’est un large catalogue d’histoires lues ou filmées, de musiques et d’ateliers en compagnie des héros préférés de vos enfants. 
KiLi offre tous les plaisirs de la lecture, à partager en famille ! 
KiLi, c’est une utilisation encadrée avec des parcours, un contrôle parental et une gestion du temps d’écran. Sans publicité et dans un univers 100% sécurisé, les enfants peuvent naviguer en autonomie dans l’interface pensée pour eux et adaptée à leur âge.  
KiLi, l’écran intelligent pour tous les enfants ! 
LA 1ERE APPLI DÉDIÉE AUX PETITS 
• Une navigation conçue pour une utilisation des enfants en autonomie 
• Des voix-off, des parcours thématiques : découverte du monde, l’amitié, la famille… 
• Un large catalogue de contenus pour tous les goûts 
LE MEILLEUR DE L’ÉCOLE DES LOISIRS POUR TOUS LES ENFANTS 
• Des histoires à regarder avec les héros emblématiques de l’école des loisirs : Loulou, Cornebidouille, Simon, Elmer et tant d’autres… 
• Des histoires à écouter pour rêver et pour apprendre. 
• Des ateliers créatifs, bricolages, recettes de cuisine, leçons de dessin… pour s’amuser en famille. 
• Des prolongements hors écran : coloriages, jeux… 
AVEC KILI, LES ENFANTS SONT EN SÉCURITÉ 
• Des histoires, des activités et des jeux de qualité créés par des professionnels de l’enfance adaptés à l’âge de l’enfant.  
• Une utilisation encadrée (contrôle parental, gestion du temps d’écran…) 
• Aucune publicité pour une navigation en toute tranquillité.  
UNE APPLI QUI VOUS RESSEMBLE 
• Personnalisation de l’âge de l’enfant : avec des interfaces différentes selon l’avancée en lecture des utilisateurs. 
• Un avatar ou une photo pour chaque compte  
• Des contenus ajoutables en favoris
CONDITIONS D'UTILISATION DE KILI :
L'application KiLi est une application de l'école des loisirs.
Son utilisation est conditionnée 
- aux conditions d'utilisations standard de Apple : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- aux conditions générale d'utilisation de l'école des loisirs : https://www.ecoledesloisirs.fr/cgu-application-kili

bluejetty:00172890:ios.description:
Free up space, protect your privacy, and speed up your iPhone with AI-powered cleaning.
Cleaner Kit: Express Cleanup makes cleaning your phone simple, smart, and secure. Powered by advanced AI, it helps you reclaim valuable storage, hide sensitive data, and optimize your device – all with just a tap and a swipe.
Key Features:
Smart Photo & Video Cleaning
Find and remove similar photos, duplicate photos, and videos effortlessly. Free up storage space and improve your phone’s performance in seconds.
Swipe to Clean
Enjoy the easiest way to manage your camera roll – swipe left to delete unwanted photos or swipe right to keep your favorites. Cleaning has never been this fast and intuitive.
Secret Storage Space
Keep your private data safe. Securely hide photos, albums, contacts, recordings, notes, and files in an encrypted vault protected by password or Face ID.
Contacts Management
Merge duplicate contacts, remove unused ones, and back up your phonebook so you never lose important connections.
Photo Compression
Reduce photo file sizes without significant quality loss to free up space while keeping your memories intact.
Video Compression
Compress large videos while maintaining visual quality, reclaiming valuable storage instantly.
Home Screen Widgets
Add battery and contact widgets to your home screen for quick access and at-a-glance information.
Charging Animations
Enhance your charging experience with eye-catching animations when you plug in your device.
Internet Speed Test
Measure your network performance instantly and stay informed about your internet speed.
Custom Themes
Personalize the app’s appearance with a range of beautiful themes to match your style.
Unlimited Access to All Features
• Subscribe for unlimited access to all phone cleaner features.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly or annually, based on the selected plan.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• During the free trial, all features are available, but some may have limited usage.
• You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase.
• Payment is charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
• Renewal charges occur 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
• Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Keep your iPhone clean, organized, and private – all in one app.
Download Cleaner Kit: Express Cleanup today and experience a faster, clutter-free device.
TERMS AND PRIVACY
By using Cleaner Kit: Express Cleanup, you agree to our Terms of Service, Privacy Policy,
Terms of Use: https://ngappstudio.in/apps/express-cleaner-ios/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://ngappstudio.in/apps/express-cleaner-ios/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00024200:ios.description:
Are you looking for music games for children and adults; do you want to have piano lessons free and the best virtual piano online? With Virtual Piano Keyboard app for iPhone you can learn to play piano on virtual keyboard and record your own piano music with high quality sound!
With an in app purchase you can upgrade Virtual Piano Keyboard free to full ads free version - no ads or limit in recordings!
This is the iPad piano app for people who love musical instruments and want to play piano online; it doesn’t matter if you are a beginner piano player or experienced pianist. 
In Play Mode you can play without the help of our piano tutorial and record music, you can choose to only record audio or to record video view of screen and audio as you play. Recorded music files can be shared with family, friends and loved once.
In Learn to Play Mode you can choose to play easy piano songs or harder piano chords songs with the help of our piano software. Choose song to play and then follow the yellow keys to learn how to play the piano song. Learn to play piano before you go to Play Mode and record your own piano pieces.
With our realistic virtual piano keyboard you can choose between five different pianos and sounds:
1. Grand Piano and its horizontal soundboard with high sound volume are commonly used in classical music.
2. Pianino (Upright Piano) and its vertical soundboard with lower sound volume, compared to the Grand Piano, are commonly used as studio piano.
3. Electronic Piano and its electronic sound is commonly used in jazz piano music
4. Digital Piano and its digital sound is commonly used for piano chords in popular music 
5. Organ and its characteristic sound is commonly used for church music and Christian music
Most important buttons for functions are placed above the piano keyboard for best user experience and easy overview. If you have your own piano sheet music; you can choose to show label on keyboard piano keys in settings. 
If you want to learn to play piano online, or you are looking for fun piano games for free, this is the perfect piano player app for you. Learn to play your favorite piano song on your iPhone or tablet with virtual keyboard piano lessons online!
Download Virtual Piano Keyboard Free app now, bring out the pianist in you with this free piano game!
iPad Virtual Piano Free Features:
- Best pianist HD graphics optimized for User Experience 
- Five HQ piano sounds to choose from
- Compatible with all iPhones
- Adapted for iPad
- Adjustable volume
- Adjustable tough pressure ratio 
- Adjustable sustain sound ration 
- Show Label option for piano keys 
- Vibration option for piano keys
- Adjustable view and number of keys on piano keyboard
- Play Mode with audio and video recording options
- Play piano recordings
- Share my piano Recordings option via Email or Bluetooth
- Learn to Play Mode with a large collection of piano songs to choose from
- Auto play song options 
- Easy to follow yellow color on piano keys to play
- Adjustable piano notes speed 
If you like to play fun games and love to play music; this is the best free piano app for you!

bluejetty:00200011:ios.description:
Welcome to PineDrama - Short Dramas – TikTok's Official Short Drama App! 
Dive into a premium streaming experience tailored for your fast-paced lifestyle. PineDrama - Short Dramas brings you trending mini-series, captivating stories, and exclusive shows right to your phone. Enjoy high-quality, bite-sized episodes perfect for your daily commute, lunch breaks, or relaxing at home.
What Makes PineDrama - Short Dramas Special?
◼ Immersive Viewing & Smart Feed
Enjoy a smooth, high-definition vertical viewing experience. Our smart recommendation engine curates shows based on your unique tastes. Once you find a mini-series you love, sit back and enjoy seamless auto-play—perfect for binge-watching your new favorite stories.
◼ Discover Your Next Must-Watch Series
Use the "Discover" tab to easily explore a wide variety of genres. From trending hits to fresh new releases, finding the perfect short drama to stream is quick and effortless.
◼ Join a Global Community
Connect with a vibrant community of drama lovers! Like episodes, share your thoughts in the comments, save shows to your personal watchlist, and follow top creators so you never miss a new release.
Trending Genres You Will Love:
Fall in love with our massive library of exclusive mini-series! Explore our most-loved genres::
◼ Modern Romance: Enjoy heartwarming love stories, unexpected romantic encounters, and beautiful journeys of finding true love and mutual respect.
◼ Empowering Drama: Experience thrilling plot twists! Watch strong female leads overcome challenges, turn the tables in difficult situations, and achieve inspiring personal triumphs.
◼ Family Dynamics: Dive into emotional stories exploring family ties, personal growth, and heartwarming reunions that touch the soul.
◼ Inspiring Journeys: Follow captivating underdog stories of ordinary people fighting for success, independence, and a better life.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ):
Q: How long is each episode?
A: Each episode is about 1 to 3 minutes long. It’s the perfect bite-sized entertainment for your busy schedule, whether you're commuting, grabbing a coffee, or unwinding at night.
Q: Are there subtitles available?
A: PineDrama - Short Dramas provides high-quality subtitles and professional dubbing (including English, Spanish, and more). Enjoy global hit shows seamlessly!
Q: How often is new content added?
A: PineDrama - Short Dramas regularly releases new episodes and trending mini-series. There is always a fresh, exciting story waiting for you to stream.
Ready to discover your next favorite show? Download PineDrama - Short Dramas today and start streaming the best bite-sized entertainment!

bluejetty:00068113:ios.description:
Rainbow by Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise is a secure and relationship-building engine that facilitates quick, seamless collaboration between its users. 
It allows users to swiftly interact with each other through chat, voice or video and to share screens and files with astonishing ease.
But Rainbow goes beyond simple messaging and sharing. Rainbow leverages the latest technologies to securely integrate into your organization’s existing business processes, applications, and workflows, while streamlining user adoption, minimizing user disruption, and solving customer challenges. 
Rainbow helps you connect to the future through optimized time-management, secure platform access, and strict data integrity.
COMMUNICATE AND COLLABORATE
- Initiate high-definition audio and video calls.
- Start group chats (bubbles) to communicate with your teams and business contacts.
- Add people from outside your organization (Guests) in your conversations.
- Create or join audio and video meetings with up to 120 participants.
- Use channels to broadcast information inside or outside your organization.
- Always stay connected so you never miss messages, calls, meetings or any other event.
- Manage your phone calls (via the cellular network or using Voice over IP) through your enterprise telephony system, access your voicemail and much more.
ORGANIZE AND SHARE
- Share contents you want in your conversations (pictures, files, videos, animated GIFs, voice memos, locations).
- Search for people, bubbles, channels, files or text messages.
- Manage your contact network, see presence of your colleagues or people outside your company.
- Share you calendar information (free, busy, out of office) to let others know if you are available.
DATA INTEGRITY AND PRIVACY
We respect privacy. We don’t use data to monetize additional services and we respect international privacy laws and data privacy. 
Data of our partners and customers is private, safe and secure. Only our partners and customers process their own data. 
Transparency and traceability are critical elements of Rainbow and all regulatory requirements are respected.

Welcome to Office Tycoon, the ultimate idle game where you can unleash your inner manager and build the corporate empire of your dreams! Start small and work your way up to becoming a mogul of the business world. In this engaging tycoon game, you'll design, expand, and manage your very own office space, all while making strategic decisions to optimize your profits.
Build and Customize:
Begin your journey by constructing a small office space, and gradually expand it into a sprawling corporate complex. Design each room, arrange tables and chairs, and create a comfortable and productive environment for your employees. From sleek executive offices to vibrant communal areas, the design choices are yours to make!
Hire and Train Employees:
No office is complete without its workforce! Hire a diverse range of employees, each with their own skills and expertise. As your team grows, provide training to enhance their productivity and unlock special abilities. Match employees to their ideal roles and watch your office thrive!
Strategic Idle Gameplay:
Office Tycoon offers an engaging idle gameplay experience. Even when you're not actively playing, your office continues to generate profits. Strategically invest your earnings in new rooms, furniture, and upgrades to boost your income. Keep an eye on your resources and make smart decisions to maximize your efficiency.
Expand and Conquer:
Expand your corporate footprint beyond your initial office building. Unlock new locations and conquer different markets to increase your influence and earnings. With each expansion, you'll face new challenges and opportunities that will test your management skills.
Compete and Collaborate:
Join forces with other players in co-op challenges to tackle bigger objectives and earn special rewards. Compete on global leaderboards to showcase your management prowess and claim your spot as the top office tycoon.
If you've ever dreamt of building your own corporate empire, Office Tycoon is the game for you. Dive into the world of strategic decision-making, room design, and employee management. Download now and start your journey to become the ultimate office tycoon!

Start a FaceTime call and play your decks head to head with SharePlay.
Draw, shuffle, mulligan, and play out your hand on a real tabletop.
No friends online? Practice against a bot (beta).
