Type or say what you want, like “goblins with haste under 3 mana,” and Lion’s Eye builds the search for you.
Full support for Scryfall search syntax, with suggestions that find the exact card name without guesswork.

Drag-and-drop deck building with easy menus for moving and editing cards.

Tags: Organize and personalize with tags. Group, select, and filter by tag.

bluejetty:00060757:ios.name: SyroMalabar Praarthanakal
bluejetty:00060757:ios.summary: A collection of Malayalam Liturgy of the Hours ( Yaama Praarthanakal) and Sacramentals used in the Syro-Malabar Catholic Church. For your convenience, the app employs algorithms to determine the prayer combinations to be used for each day
bluejetty:00060757:ios.description:
A collection of Malayalam Liturgy of the Hours ( Yaama Praarthanakal) and Sacramentals used in the Syro-Malabar Catholic Church. For your convenience, the app employs algorithms to determine the prayer combinations to be used for each day (based on the nine Liturgical seasons, position of weeks, and day of the week) and presents you with a ready-to-read fully-composed text off the screen.
A mobile ministry of http://praarthana.org, this app has all the seven prayers: Ramsha, Leliya, Sapra, Qala d-Shahra, Qutta aa, Endana and d-Bassa Sayin, as well as al major Sacramentals such as blessings, Oppees etc.
The app also includes a convenient night reading mode to help read comfortably in the dark, like when reciting the late night or early morning prayers in solitude. The text size can also be increased or decreased per your convenience, and both these can be accessed via the Floating Action Button at bottom right corner of the application.
The prayer text also includes a play button, which turns your device into a teleprompter, enabling you to pray without the constant scrolling gestures on the phone. The feature can be used in conjunction with a big screen television or a projector for an entire gathering to comfortably say the prayers.

Welcome to Prosper Invest! Our beautiful new mobile experience was designed from the ground up based on feedback from Prosper investors like you.
Now you can easily manage your portfolio anytime, anywhere:
* Set up, review, and adjust your target portfolio allocations using our Auto Invest tool
* Invest manually by browsing and selecting from individual loan listings
* Add cash to your Prosper investment account in one-time, weekly or monthly increments
* View details on each Note you’ve invested in, at a glance
* View your total gain/loss to date
* See how your investments have impacted the lives of borrowers across the country
* Keep tabs on how your portfolio is performing
You must have an active Prosper investor account to use this app.
ABOUT PROSPER:
Prosper was founded in 2005 as the first peer-to-peer lending marketplace in the United States. Since then, we’ve facilitated more than $20 billion in loans to more than 1,000,000 people.
Through Prosper, people can invest in each other in a way that can be financially and socially rewarding. Borrowers apply online for fixed-rate, fixed-term loans between $2,000 and $50,000. Individuals and institutions can invest in the loans and earn solid returns.
For more info or to create a new Prosper investor account, please visit http://prosper.com/invest .

Container docklands and skidpad training maps
Realistic drift physics with controlled slip
Smooth and responsive controls
Vehicle customization: suspension, wheels, and paint
Skill-based gameplay focused on precision
Optimized performance for iOS devices

Build your car.
Train your control.
Just Drift.

bluejetty:00089682:ios.description:
Kairos makes healthy, tasty, craveable Mediterranean food teeming with goodness, created in our kitchens just for you. We deliver Greek favorites that leave you feeling energized and ready to power through the day. Kairos keeps you moving forward with dine-in, pick up or quick delivery.
Kairos App Features:
• Easily modify and add food to your cart
• Quickly navigate categories, products, and ingredients with beautiful imagery
• Enable geolocation to find your closest Kairos restaurant
• Order food for pickup or delivery
• Save credit and debit cards for faster checkouts
• Earn and redeem rewards and offers
• Quickly reorder past orders
How to Order Kairos:
• Select your preferred ordering method, pick up or delivery
• Choose a category and add an item or modify an item to add to your cart
• After you’ve finished adding items to your order, select checkout from your bag
• Proceed through the checkout flow and monitor your progress from your order confirmation screen for delivery
• Visit your account to reorder past orders quickly
Kairos Mediterranean Creates Craveable Food!
Kairos is the ancient Greek word for “Supreme Moment” and there are many such apogees reached at Kairos every day. The moment our made-in-Mount Pleasant falafels sink into the cooker. The moment we drizzle tzatziki sauce over our succulent, slow-roasted lamb. The moment we serve our baba ganoush. We reach a golden summit providing our guests healthy dishes prepared with the highest quality ingredients for a truly savory experience. So, when you’re in the mood for a delicious pita, a fresh salad, or a craveable bowl, use your Kairos app to order and enjoy authentic Mediterranean cuisine.

bluejetty:00099023:android.description:
This thrilling free-to-play Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action. 
Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!
The Story
Journey along with lead character Yusol as she strives to rebuild her clan and enact justice against those who destroyed it. Follow her as she pursues the evil Yi Chun and unravels the mysteries of the Heaven's Fall Cult. Throughout the adventure, she’ll encounter an expansive cast of heroes, each with their own skills and story, who will join her resurgent clan and unite in the fight to defeat Yi Chun and Heaven’s Fall.
Dual Combat System
Seamlessly switch between real-time action and turn-based strategy.

For real-time action, one designated lead hero fights the various enemies supported by four skill-linked allies
Character Collection
Build & grow your 5-hero team to begin your journey. With over 40 heroes to unlock, each with their unique skills & stories, a variety of legendary characters awaits you to join your clan.
Visual Style
Immerse yourself in this anime-inspired world with majestic vistas, eerie forests, ancient deserts, and mythical dungeons of the Earthen Realm. Each hero models a distinctive look and feel evocative of the elements.
Deep Tactical Combat
To defeat your foes, master your fighting abilities with a wide array of combinations and skills. With each battle, tailor your team strategically in order to achieve victory across different opponents and environments.

bluejetty:00098145:ios.description:
A new client for car surveillance sentinel
Functions
• Parking surveillance: When the vehicle is parked with the engine off, the device works in power saving mode and keep connection 4G network, this app can wakeup and living view the surrounding situation anytime from anywhere. If the vehicle is impacted, vibrated or someone approaches it, the surveillance device will automatically start recording to document the surrounding situation, providing evidence for determining liability in accidents, preventing the vehicle from being damaged or stolen, etc. For example, if the vehicle is scratched by another vehicle in the parking lot, the surveillance sentinel can record this process to TF card and upload to cloud, send a notification to mobile app at the same time. 
• Driving recording: While the vehicle is in motion, it can continuously record road conditions, traffic signs, as well as the movements of the vehicles and pedestrians in front. Such recordings are helpful for clarifying liability in the event of traffic accidents.
Working principle
• Sensor triggering: The built-in gravity sensor or vibration sensor in the device will send a signal to the surveillance system and trigger the surveillance function to start when it detects that the vehicle's state change exceeds the set threshold.
• Loop recording: Generally, it adopts the loop recording method to store video files. When the memory card is full, it will automatically overwrite the earliest video files to ensure that the device can work continuously. The video triggered by vibration will be marked and never be overridden.

listings.description:
A new client for car surveillance sentinel

Functions

• Parking surveillance: When the vehicle is parked with the engine off, the device works in power saving mode and keep connection 4G network, this app can wakeup and living view the surrounding situation anytime from anywhere. If the vehicle is impacted, vibrated or someone approaches it, the surveillance device will automatically start recording to document the surrounding situation, providing evidence for determining liability in accidents, preventing the vehicle from being damaged or stolen, etc. For example, if the vehicle is scratched by another vehicle in the parking lot, the surveillance sentinel can record this process to TF card and upload to cloud,  send a notification to mobile app at the same time. 

• Driving recording: While the vehicle is in motion, it can continuously record road conditions, traffic signs, as well as the movements of the vehicles and pedestrians in front. Such recordings are helpful for clarifying liability in the event of traffic accidents.

Working principle

• Sensor triggering: The built-in gravity sensor or vibration sensor in the device will send a signal to the surveillance system and trigger the surveillance function to start when it detects that the vehicle's state change exceeds the set threshold.

• Loop recording: Generally, it adopts the loop recording method to store video files. When the memory card is full, it will automatically overwrite the earliest video files to ensure that the device can work continuously. The video triggered by vibration will be marked and never be overridden.

Welcome to Kathi Ross-Nash’s official training app – KRN Pilates. Based on the acclaimed Red Thread Pilates program. 
Powered by Balanced Body: The #1 choice of Pilates professionals since 1976. Trusted by hundreds of thousands worldwide.
KRN Pilates provides Pilates teachers and students alike with over 550 exercises and workouts. Whether you’re a master instructor or want to brush up on your basics, KRN has you covered.
HIGHLIGHTS
From KRN, the creator of The Red Thread Method®
Ft. top Instructors: Joel Crosby, Amanda Diatta, Leilani Crawford, & more
550+ exercises
Covers fundamental, intermediate, and advanced technique
Practice key movements: extensions, flexion, stability, twists, and so much more
Apple Health compatible
Save & track workouts
TOP PILATES TRAINING
KRN Pilates is a comprehensive library for Pilates instruction. 
The app features acclaimed international Instructors leading full-length Pilates workouts to get you moving, strengthening, toning, and gaining the benefits of authentic Pilates exercise programs!
MASTER MOVEMENT
 The progression of exercise videos demonstrates how to build strength and technique to master each Pilates exercise. The KRN Pilates workout library includes tutorials & workouts on the following and more:
The Hundred
Rolling Like a Ball
Corkscrew
Spine Twist
Roll Over
Teaser
Jack Knife
Boomerang
Control Balance
PILATES WORKOUTS MADE EASY
Create a workout schedule and monitor your progress. You can even sync with Apple Health!
Learn the basics like The Hundred and work your way to more advanced technique. Train alongside your Instructor of choice through mat routines or with equipment. Chairs, Arcs, Barrels, Reformers, and more available at https://www.pilates.com.
KEEP PROGRESSING 
New exercises and workouts are released every quarter so you can continue progressing in your journey! KRN Pilates is both the at-home and in-studio complementary workout app every Pilates enthusiast needs in their toolbox.
START FOR FREE TODAY
Start your free 14-day trial today to get unlimited access to KRN Pilates exercises and workouts you can do anytime, anywhere!
MORE INFORMATION
You will not be charged when you start your free trial. After the free trial ends, you will be auto-billed $5.99 USD per month and $39.99 per year (price varies by currency.) 
The KRN Pilates App utilizes the Apple Health Kit to track activity
Support: https://krnpilatesapp.com/support
FAQ: https://krnpilatesapp.com/faq

Add and edit products with a touch

bluejetty:00014887:ios.description:
Manage your business on the go with the WooCommerce Mobile App. Add products, create orders, take quick payments, and keep an eye on new sales and key stats in real time.
Add and edit products with a touch
Get started in seconds! Create, group, and publish products directly from your iPhone or iPad. Capture your creativity the moment it strikes – turn your ideas into products immediately, or save them as drafts for later.
Create orders on the fly
Once you have some products created, it’s simple. Choose items from your catalog, add shipping, and then fill in customer details to quickly create an order that syncs with your inventory.
Take payments in person
Collect physical payments using WooCommerce In-Person Payments and a card reader in Australia, Canada, Finland, Ireland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK, and the US. Tap to Pay on iPhone is available in the UK and US. Start a new order – or find an existing one that’s pending payment – then seamlessly accept payment.
Go from clicks to bricks
Turn any tablet into a powerful point of sale with WooCommerce POS. Search products, scan barcodes, apply coupons, and send email receipts, with all of your online and physical sales synced in real time. Available in Australia, Canada, Finland, Ireland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK, and the US.
Get notified of every sale
Now that you’re actively selling, never miss an order or a review. Keep yourself in the loop by enabling real-time alerts – and listen for that addictive “cha-ching” sound that comes with each new sale!
Track sales and bestselling products
See which products are winning at a glance. Keep tabs on your overall revenue, order count, and visitor data by week, month, and year. Knowledge = power.
WooCommerce is the world’s most customizable open-source eCommerce platform. Whether you’re launching a business, taking brick-and-mortar retail online, or developing sites for clients, use WooCommerce for a store that powerfully blends content and commerce.
Requirements: WooCommerce v3.5+.
View the Terms of Service at https://wordpress.com/tos/
View the Privacy Policy at https://automattic.com/privacy/
View the Privacy Notice for California users at https://automattic.com/privacy/#california-consumer-privacy-act-ccpa.

bluejetty:00073914:ios.summary:
NOTICE: Before you purchase Hondata Complete, download the "Hondata package" bundle advertised above instead. It includes Autolog, our new app at a discount.
Track performance of your car in real time by gauges and graphs. Troubleshoot mal
bluejetty:00073914:ios.description:
NOTICE: Before you purchase Hondata Complete, download the "Hondata package" bundle advertised above instead. It includes Autolog, our new app at a discount.
Track performance of your car in real time by gauges and graphs. Troubleshoot malfunctions by accessing the on board ECU. Know what is wrong with your car before taking it to the mechanic.Track fuel economy and save money on gas. These are just some of the features the Hondata app has to offer. Hondata app transforms your phone/tablet into an all in one performance tracking and troubleshooting tool for your car. 
The complete edition includes all the addons at a discounted price.
Fautures:
• Customizable gauges can track up to 80 sensors in real time including fuel economy, G-force and battery voltage.
• Read and Clear trouble codes and reset MIL (service engine light).
• Read from more than 40 diagnostics parameters including engine knock count, VTEC pressure and more.
• Metric and Imperial measures.
• Real-time user-defined sensor plotting. Graph up to 4 sensors at the same time on interactive graph that can be scrolled, paused and polled.
• Gauge list feature can track every sensor at the same time.
• CarPlay allows you to display sensor data in real time on car dash screen.
• Instant horsepower, mpg/kml fuel economy, boost pressure and G force tracking.
• Speed limit warning: Get notified when driving over speed limit.
• High coolant temperature warning gives you instant notification when your car is running too hot.
• HUD mode for dashboard view : Heads up display for driving at night.
• Two themes to choose from.
• landscape mode for all views.
• Fuel Economy:
 - Live and average fuel economy tracking for 0-5 min, 0-30 min and 0-2 hr intervals and a detailed summary.
 - Long term tracking with six different intervals. (1 week, 2 weeks, 4 weeks, 13 weeks, 26 and 52 weeks).
 - 4 different units of measure: MPG,KPL (Km/L), L/100 Km, Miles per imperial gallon.
 - Interactive graph of long term data that can be cropped and scrolled through.
 - Export fuel history to CSV file (spreadsheets).
 - Other statistics: Distance travelled, average speed, money spent, CO2 produced and fuel consumed.
 - 4 methods of calculation available. For non MAF equipped vehicles.
• Race track package: 
 - Real time lap data, gap delay time and position in race track using high frequency GPS tracking.
 - Comprehensive summary of race with lap times, speed fluctuations on track and more.
 - Get drag racing times (0-60 mph, 0-100 mph, 1/4 mile 1/8 mile etc.) 
 - Load and save unlimited number of tracks onto device.
 - Crucial racing data including real time horsepower, g-force and a detailed driving summary. Share your results with friends.
 - Transmission gear information and optional shifting assistant (for manual transmission vehicles) which notifies optimal moment for shifting.
 - Customizable view that toggles between speed/rpm gauge, real time track positioning and G-sensor feedback.
 - Record your race in HD with gauge and track overlays. (dash cam add-on required)
• Dashcam: 
Record smooth HD video with overlaying gauges (speed,rpm, etc), time, location (GPS coordinates) and G-force sensor in four different resolutions. Record from 80 sensors and up to 5 gauges.
• Sensor logger: 
 - Record as many sensors as possible.
 - Save graph sensor data to CSV file and export it for further analysis. 
 - Send real time data to a TCP socket (IP Address) over the network.
*Your vehicle must be equipped with MAF sensor for instant horsepower and torque readout*
*Your vehicle must be equipped with MAP sensor for boost pressure readout*
Visit www.hondata.com for more info.
For help: mobile@hondata.com

Your Xfinity experience, enhanced.

• Family Settings so you can set family-safe browsing and pause WiFi to any connected device.
• Ultimate control with tools to help you set up your WiFi, assign user profiles, and get help improving the performance of every connected device.
• Gateway Speed Test checks the internet speed delivered directly to your Xfinity WiFi Gateway
Getting started is simple. All you need is your Xfinity ID and the password you set up when you signed up for Xfinity.
Need help signing in?

• Or reset your Xfinity password: xfinity.com/password

*** CATTI备考专区 ***
【名师课程】
“李长栓名师课-北外高翻教授的CATTI翻译秘籍”、 “车云峰名师课-资深编辑带你翻译避坑”、“发音秘方-碎片时间习练标准英语语音”等名师课程点击即学，相关内容持续更新，为你的CATTI考试保驾护航。
【独家资料】
“时政语汇-CATTI常考必刷”、“中华思想文化术语-翻译、文化双提升”、“用英语讲述中国”等独家资料助你轻松备考，全面提升英语能力素养。
*** 内容特色 ***
【全国翻译专业资格（水平）考试（CATTI）推荐词典】
《新世纪汉英大词典》第三版
《新世纪汉英大词典》初版问世即广受赞誉，被称为第四代汉英词典的开山之作。第三版增收4000余条新词和近2万条新义新用法，收录条目总计近16万条，例证近17万个；同时特别增设翻译速查、翻译点津、话题词汇等专栏共132个，详解汉英翻译中的常见难点、疑点、易错点。
《新世纪英汉大词典》
《新世纪英汉大词典》由外语教学与研究出版社联合英国柯林斯出版公司历时八载共同编写而成，依托英语语料库the Collins Corpus，收录25万词条、35万义项和15万例证，提供10万搭配词，是目前规模最大的英汉词典。
【地道发音】
词目、英语例句、汉语例句的英译文均配有标准发音，英语词目额外支持跟读评测。
【双向句库】
32万英汉、汉英例句库，输入任意英语、汉语关键词，一站式查学两部权威词典中的全部相关例句。
【真实语料】
所收录例证依托英语语料库（the Collins Corpus），语料鲜活、实用、权威。
【翻译提升】
翻译速查、翻译点津、话题词汇、中国机构团体、中国世界遗产等20余个学习专栏，助你拓展主题词汇、丰富表达储备、解决翻译易错点，帮助CATTI考生及广大翻译工作者高效提升翻译水平。
【每日一学聚沙成塔】
图解文化词汇、新词精选、历史上的今天、每日一译、每日一词、每日用法等栏目，每天10分钟，识新词、读语法、懂搭配、会表达，让学习循序渐进、积少成多。
*** 功能特色 ***
【全能翻译】
● 文本、语音、拍照三种智能翻译方式，满足你学习、翻译、工作、日常交流等各种场景需求。
● 只需输入所查单词的完整句子，AI不仅能提供句子的翻译，还能智能判定句子中单词的词性、释义，点击单词即可一步定位到词典内容，查词更快、更准、更便捷。
【AI学词】
● 词表音频一键连播，边听边背，高效利用碎片时间。
● 个性化定制背诵计划，AI根据艾宾浩斯记忆曲线智能提醒复习，轻松记住单词。
● 各类背诵词书，一应俱全：四六级/考研/考博/专四/专八/雅思/托福/GRE/新概念全四册/时政语汇/中华思想文化术语等独家特色词表，满足多样化的词汇学习需求。
【全局点击查词】
学习时遇到不懂的词汇怎么办？无需退出当前界面，点击不懂的英语单词即可立刻查询，减去返回主界面再查词的操作步骤，不会的词一点即查，提高学习效率。
【学习记录云端存储】

【独家资料】
“时政语汇-CATTI常考必刷”、“中华思想文化术语-翻译、文化双提升”、“用英语讲述中国”等独家资料助你轻松备考，全面提升英语能力素养。

*** 内容特色 ***
【全国翻译专业资格（水平）考试（CATTI）推荐词典】
《新世纪汉英大词典》第三版
《新世纪汉英大词典》初版问世即广受赞誉，被称为第四代汉英词典的开山之作。第三版增收4000余条新词和近2万条新义新用法，收录条目总计近16万条，例证近17万个；同时特别增设翻译速查、翻译点津、话题词汇等专栏共132个，详解汉英翻译中的常见难点、疑点、易错点。

《新世纪英汉大词典》
《新世纪英汉大词典》由外语教学与研究出版社联合英国柯林斯出版公司历时八载共同编写而成，依托英语语料库the Collins Corpus，收录25万词条、35万义项和15万例证，提供10万搭配词，是目前规模最大的英汉词典。
 
【地道发音】
词目、英语例句、汉语例句的英译文均配有标准发音，英语词目额外支持跟读评测。
 
【双向句库】

【真实语料】

【翻译提升】

图解文化词汇、新词精选、历史上的今天、每日一译、每日一词、每日用法等栏目，每天10分钟，识新词、读语法、懂搭配、会表达，让学习循序渐进、积少成多。

bluejetty:00026290:ios.description:
Learn German with Dialogues - Your Ultimate German Learning Companion
Welcome to our free application designed to help you master the German language through engaging dialogues. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced learner, you will find a wide range of dialogues, each crafted to match your skill level. Written and narrated dialogues are accompanied by a series of questions to test your comprehension and reinforce your learning.
New and Improved Features:
- Interactive AI Conversations: Practice every dialogue live with our AI! Speak freely, get instant corrections on pronunciation and grammar, and have real back-and-forth conversations tailored to your level.
- Translation Options: Now, each dialogue includes translations in English and Spanish, making it even more accessible and useful for non-German speakers.
- Offline Access: All dialogues are downloaded at the start, allowing you to use the app offline whenever and wherever you want.
- PDF Export and Print: Convert dialogues into PDF format for easy printing and sharing.
- Enhanced Quizzes: Each dialogue now includes 5 questions to provide a more comprehensive understanding check.
- Adjustable Audio Speed: Customize the playback speed of the audio to suit your learning pace.
- Night Mode: Reduce eye strain and study comfortably with the app's night mode.
Why Choose Our App?
- Real Conversations with AI: Stop just listening – start speaking! The AI acts as your personal German conversation partner and corrects you in real time.
- Regular Updates: New dialogues are published weekly, ensuring that you have fresh and relevant content to continue improving your German skills.
- User-Friendly Design: The app is designed with simplicity and usability in mind, making it easy for anyone to navigate and use.
- 100% Free: Enjoy all these features at no cost.
How to Use:
- Read the Dialogues: Carefully go through each dialogue.
- Listen to the Audio: Ensure you listen to the narrated versions to perfect your pronunciation.
- Answer the Questions: Test your comprehension with the quizzes provided.
- Utilize the Translations: Refer to the translations in English and Spanish to aid your understanding.
- Download and Print: Take advantage of the PDF export options to study on the go.
With our new AI feature, you’re not just listening to dialogues anymore — you’re having real conversations and becoming fluent faster than ever!
Feedback and Support:
We are dedicated to improving your learning experience. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please contact us at info@zgdevelopment.ch. Your input is invaluable to us.
If you enjoy using the app, please rate us on the App Store and share it with others who might benefit from it.
Download the app now and embark on your journey to mastering German with engaging dialogues!

bluejetty:00186794:ios.summary:
All on board the Coding Express! Coding Express LEGO® Education introduces early coding concepts and 21st century skills to preschoolers.
Using the popular LEGO® DUPLO® train set, teacher guide and an easy-to-use app, preschool teachers ha
bluejetty:00186794:ios.description:
All on board the Coding Express! Coding Express LEGO® Education introduces early coding concepts and 21st century skills to preschoolers.
Using the popular LEGO® DUPLO® train set, teacher guide and an easy-to-use app, preschool teachers have all they need to teach early coding concepts.
TEACHER QUOTES
“I have never seen anything like Coding Express and I am very intrigued with its structure and the varying ways it can teach children specific skills they might not have gained through play before. I love its versatility and how the many different areas of play will keep most children occupied for a very long time.” Kate, preschool teacher, USA 
“Coding Express gives preschoolers a very different learning experience. Building different shapes with the train track helps them to understand the coding concept and combined with the educational activities and teacher material it makes early coding intuitive, fun and educational. The app enhances the experience and it gives the early learners more ways to learn about coding.” Wenting, pre-school and kindergarten teacher, China
With the Coding Express app and LEGO® DUPLO® solution you will get:
• 234 LEGO® DUPLO® bricks, including Push & Go train with lights and sounds, motor, color sensor, 5 color-coded action bricks, 2 railroad switches and 3.8 meters of train track
• Teaching materials that includes 8 online lessons, introduction guide, poster, 3 building inspiration cards for building 12 unique models, 5 getting started activities and 8 simple video tutorials
• Free app featuring 4 fun and educational activity areas, including:
o Journeys: Explore destinations and traffic signs. Learn about the sequencing of events, making predictions, planning and problem solving.
Characters: Support children’s social and emotional development. Children identify and examine the feelings of characters, considering the consequences for others. 
Math: Explore and understand how to measure, estimate distance and identify numbers.
Music: Learn about sequencing and looping. Compose simple melodies, explore different animal and instruments sounds.
• Key learning values include sequencing, looping, conditional coding, problem solving, critical thinking, collaboration, language and literacy, and expressing ideas with digital elements 
• Teaching solution and early coding toy for preschool children 2-5 years old; Developed using science, math and technology from the National Association for the Education of Young Children (NAEYC) and the 21st Century Early Learning Framework (P21 ELF) and the Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework.
*** IMPORTANT***
This is not a standalone educational app. This app is used to program the LEGO® Education Coding Express set, which is sold separately. Please contact your local LEGO Education reseller for further information.

Everything in one place
No switching between apps. Everything you need is right here in one place: your current account, investments, savings and loans.
Payments at rocket speed
I’ll transfer money from one account to another without unnecessary waiting. Need to settle up with your colleagues? Create a Payme link, scan an IBAN or QR code.

Business trip to the Czech Republic or holiday in Türkiye ? Press and hold the app icon and convert prices using the current exchange rate.

bluejetty:00122187:ios.summary: WHY IS IT THE BEST TIC TAC TOE GAME EVER CREATED? ⋆ Explosions ⋆ Fireworks ⋆ Glowing Effects ⋆ One and Two Players ⋆ Classic 3x3 Board ⋆ Extreme 5x5 and 7x7 Boards ⋆ Awesome Computer AI ⋆ Cool Sounds and Music ⋆ iOS Universal ⋆ Retina Grap
bluejetty:00122187:ios.description:
WHY IS IT THE BEST TIC TAC TOE GAME EVER CREATED? ⋆ Explosions ⋆ Fireworks ⋆ Glowing Effects ⋆ One and Two Players ⋆ Classic 3x3 Board ⋆ Extreme 5x5 and 7x7 Boards ⋆ Awesome Computer AI ⋆ Cool Sounds and Music ⋆ iOS Universal ⋆ Retina Graphics ⋆ Game Center Achievements
We set out to make the best Tic Tac Toe game for your mobile device. And we think we have done just that.
⋆ First, it has killer explosions and fireworks. Lots of 'em.
⋆ Second, it includes bigger boards to play on than just the standard 3x3 grid. Take your gameplay to the next level with 5x5 and 7x7 boards. Go extreme.
⋆ Third, our computer player rocks. It uses a predictive matrix combined with lots of mathematical goodness to give you a balanced fun game. It even talks to you with a sassy computerized robot voice.
The best news of all is this Tic Tac Toe game will always be FREE including all future updates. Here's the list of full features:
⋆ One or Two Player with 12 Levels of Computer Play
⋆ Play Classic 3x3 Tic Tac Toe where 3 in a row wins
⋆ Play 5x5 Pro Board where 4 in a row wins
⋆ Play 7x7 Extreme Board where 5 in a row wins
⋆ Awesome glowing graphics and animations
⋆ Killer fireworks, explosions, sounds, and music
⋆ Game Center Achievements - Classic Winner, Pro Winner, Extreme Winner, 2 Way Win, 3 Way Win - Collect them all!
⋆ Winning Photo - Share directly to Facebook, Twitter, or E-mail
⋆ Universal iOS so runs perfectly on iPad, iPhone, iPod touch
⋆ Retina graphics
Tic-tac-toe, also called noughts and crosses and X's and O's is a pencil-and-paper game for two players, X and O, who take turns marking the spaces in a 3×3 grid. The X player usually goes first followed by the O player. The player who succeeds in placing three respective marks in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal row will win the round. Win 3 rounds to win the game.
Included in Tic Tac Toe Glow are two new boards which takes this classic game to the next level. Our 5x5 grid requires 4 in a row to win and our 7x7 grid requires 5 in a row. It really adds a new level of fun and excitement!
Watch a video over at our website:
http://www.tmsoft.com/tictactoe/
Here are what our users are saying:
"Tic Tac Toe wasn't fun until now!"
"There is Tic Tac Toe and then there's Tic Tac Toe Glow!"
"Not your Father's Tic Tac Toe"

bluejetty:00134931:ios.description:
Do you want to pray more effectively for Israel and the Middle East?
The headlines move fast, and much of the coverage is confusing or one-sided. It's hard to know what is really happening in Israel, what it means in light of Scripture, and how to pray about it.
VFI News helps you stand with Israel, informed and in prayer. Written by the Vision for Israel team in Jerusalem, each edition brings you the key events shaping Israel and the nations, connects them to Bible prophecy, and gives you clear prayer points so you can intercede where it's needed most.
HOW IT WORKS
GET UPDATED: Read a concise roundup of the key news from Israel, Jerusalem and the Middle East.
LEARN: See how today's events relate to Biblical prophecy and God's promises to Israel.
PRAY: Use focused prayer points to pray for grace and provision where they're needed most.
Each edition takes about 8 minutes to read.
INSIDE THE APP
• Israel and Middle East news from a Biblical, Christian perspective
• Bible prophecy insight connected to today's headlines
• Prayer points for Israel, Jerusalem and the people of the land
• A clean, distraction-free reader with dark and light mode
• Share articles with friends, family and your prayer group
• Subscribe to get every new edition in your inbox
Don't watch from the sidelines, unsure of what's happening or how to respond. Join believers around the world who pray for Israel with understanding.
Download VFI News and read your first edition today.
VFI News is a free service by Vision for Israel.

bluejetty:00027059:ios.description:
Get the most out of your closet - for less than the price of a latte, you could change your relationship with clothes and find your unique personal style!
Stylebook® is the longest-running closet organization app for a reason - with over 90 features to help you curate your closet! This time-tested app is an expert wardrobe management and closet organization tool, and has been loved by customers for 15+ years.
Import your actual clothes in seconds with a variety of import tools, including AI image generation. Welcome to Engage, the app that brings together everyday savings, recognition, goals & challenges, wellbeing support and company updates.

bluejetty:00122224:ios.description:
TriPeaks Solitaire Rules
Setup
The game board in Tri Peaks Solitaire is made up of:
• Three Peaks: There are three peaks (pyramids), each one is 4 cards high. The peaks share the lowest level. The cards at the bottom are face up, the higher ones are face down.
• The Stock: The facedown pile on the bottom left. It is used to draw cards from and put on the Waste.
• The Waste: The faceup pile next to the Stock. It's empty in the beginning.
Gameplay
The objective of the game is is to move all cards from the three Peaks onto the Waste. You can only move open cards to the Waste, a card is considered open if there are no other cards covering it. At the beginning the whole bottom row is open. Once you move cards from the Peaks you open up other cards that you can then flip over and are then open to move to the Waste as well.
You can move a card onto the Waste if it ranks one higher, or one lower than the topmost card on the waste. E.g. if there's a 6 on the Waste you can move a 5 or a 7 there. Initially the Waste is empty and you can move any card there. You are allowed to "turn the corner", i.e. go K A 2 A K, you can put an Ace on a 2 or a King.
If you have no cards in the Peaks that can be moved to the Waste then you can get a card from the Stock and turn it over to the Waste. You can only go one time through the Stock, there are no resets allowed, so don't use the Stock unless you definitely can't move any cards from the Peaks.
Winning
You win the game by moving all cards from all three Peaks to the Waste. The cards left in the Stock when you finish does not matter.
Losing
When you can't move any cards from the Peaks and you have no more cards left in the Stock then you have lost the game. The game will notify you about this, but you are free to use the Undo button to try to figure out some other solution.
Scoring
The score is based on the number of cards left at the end. You win by having no cards left. The game also counts the moves you make to win, so a win with fewer moves is considered better. The game tracks the best results for each of the 50.000 numbered games, and you will be notified if you are the first to win a game, if you break a record, or if you have the best result for a particular game, even if you don't finish it.
Winnable %
According to Wikipedia the game was invented by Robert Hogue in 1989. He performed computer statistical analysis on the original game, which showed that over 90% of all dealt games are solvable.

Join Bubbu's world of fun! Play with your favorite virtual cat and pet friends.
Get ready for an exciting pet adventure with Bubbu and his friends! Start by adopting Bubbu and then take good care of your virtual cat every day. Ensure he's always happy, healthy, fed, and well-rested. Don't wait! A fantastic world of pets is waiting for you! 
EXPLORE A NEW WORLD
Being the very first kitty on Mars is super exciting and so much fun! Dive into the fantastic mysteries of the Red Planet and make Bubbu’s world colorful and magical! Bring about day and night, rain and sunshine, and even create beautiful rainbows. Watch Bubbu fly high over the kingdom, visit the city, jump into the lake, play mini-games, and enjoy spending time with new friends. Meet Cocco the hen and Mimmi's hologram, they both add some sweetness to Bubbu’s life.
HATCH & COLLECT PETS
Visit the hatchery to make adorable alien friends for Bubbu. Use the magical merging machine to combine two pets and witness a brand-new egg hatching before your eyes! Discover the joy of bringing pets to life and create a vibrant pet kingdom with each new friend you collect!
MEOW’S FASHION SALON
Explore a fabulous range of trendy outfits and adorable accessories for dress-up fun with your virtual cat! Transform your Bubbu into a true style icon with our fantastic selection of fashionable items.
DENTIST & DOCTOR GAMES
Sometimes, Bubbu isn't feeling too well and needs to visit the friendly pet doctor at the animal hospital. Help make Bubbu's tummy and throat better, fix his bones and teeth, and say bye-bye to fleas! Be the best vet and make Bubbu smile again!
MINI-GAMES
Hop into a world of super fun mini-games like Pixel Color, Egg Stack, Mars Explorer, Marble World, Bubble Pop, Alien Invaders, Pizza Maker, and many more to improve memory, creativity, and coordination. Play these games to level up your pet adventure, earn exciting achievements, and collect awesome rewards. These games promise endless entertainment and challenges for the whole family.
Ready for a pet adventure that's out of this world? Enjoy an epic space journey with your virtual cat Bubbu and his pet friends! 
This game is free to play but certain in-game items and features, including some of those mentioned in the game description, may require payment via in-app purchases which cost real money. Please check your device settings for more detailed options regarding in-app purchases.
Subscription: This subscription automatically renews every subscription period unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. 
The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC-approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO. If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy, please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml .

bluejetty:00120452:ios.name: Pepi City: Hospital Life
bluejetty:00120452:ios.summary: Welcome to Pepi City, the ultimate city life game where imagination never ends. Explore a colorful world, design your own avatars, and dive into locations packed with surprises. In this avatar life world, you decide how every story unfolds—
bluejetty:00120452:ios.description:
Welcome to Pepi City, the ultimate city life game where imagination never ends. Explore a colorful world, design your own avatars, and dive into locations packed with surprises. In this avatar life world, you decide how every story unfolds—no limits, only freedom to create and play! This is the perfect kids game for anyone who loves role-play, creativity, and endless stories in a vibrant city life adventure.
HOSPITAL
Step into the hospital and explore a buzzing city center of doctors, nurses, and patients in this interactive city life game. From x-rays to playful treatments, every tool and room is interactive. Kids can role-play as a doctor, nurse, or avatar patient, turning every visit to the Hospital into new stories across the Pepi City world.
BABY HOSPITAL
The Baby Hospital is full of newborns, caring parents, and sweet adventures, making it one of the most loved places in the Pepi City world. Feed, weigh, and comfort every baby while inventing heartwarming city life stories. Dress baby avatars in blankets, use real tools, and discover what it means to be a caring doctor in Pepi’s world. It’s the coziest spot in Pepi City, perfect for kids to explore empathy, joy, and create their own stories in this fun kids game. Every baby avatar becomes part of the city life adventures!
BABY SHOP
Visit the Baby Shop, a playful area of the city filled with clothes, toys, and surprises. Mix and match to create fresh outfits for your avatars or turn shopping into a fashion show. Try new accessories, style your baby avatars, and make every shopping trip an unforgettable city life moment. In this kids game, every choice sparks creativity and adds fun twists to your avatar life stories.
HOUSE
Everyday life becomes extraordinary in the House. Cook delicious meals, throw parties, decorate rooms, or just chill with friends, pets, and babies. Each corner is fully interactive and perfect for kids to reimagine routines or invent completely new stories. In Pepi City, even simple family tasks—like feeding a baby or calling a doctor—turn into exciting city role-play that makes this city life game unforgettable.
CREATE AVATARS
Your world, your rules, your avatars! Use the avatar editor to create families, neighbors, squads, or even baby characters. With endless outfits and styles, every avatar is ready to shine in your unique avatar life story. Build a cast of doctors, parents, and friends who bring Pepi City to life with personality and humor. This is where kids can freely create stories and experiment in a safe, colorful world.
YOUR CITY, YOUR STORY
Pepi City is more than just a game—it’s a living world where imagination drives every moment. Maybe today you’re running the hospital as a busy doctor, tomorrow you’re shopping for baby clothes, and the next day you’re hosting the wildest house party. With colorful avatars, hundreds of items, and limitless freedom to create, every play session in this city life adventure feels brand new. For every kids game fan, it’s the perfect way to explore, play, and invent endless stories. Pepi City is your world—create city life adventures with avatars any way you imagine.
Jump in, explore, and start your journey—your Pepi City avatar life begins now!

Subscription terms of use: http://www.pepiplay.com/terms-of-use/

Key Features:
⁃ Screen name is P. Log.
⁃ Track period, ovulation, fertile days, moods, weight and symptoms etc.
⁃ Predict following periods, ovulation and fertile days.
⁃ Two modules are provided to predict your periods, default days and average days.
⁃ Calendar design and icons to show your info visually.
⁃ Add or edit periods easily.
⁃ Graph to track your period days, cycle days, weight and temperature.
⁃ Receive reminder if periods is comings.
⁃ Receive reminder of breast self-exam.
⁃ Passwords to protect your info.
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ Export your data in format of HTML, CSV or PDF.
⁃ Add your own symptoms.
⁃ Six styles of free skins to select, not just adjusting home page.
⁃ Help documents to help you how to use this app.
⁃ Pregnancy module is provided, calculates delivery date and days remains.
⁃ Support units of lbs and kg, °F and °C.
⁃ Supports Wifi backup and restore.
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports iCloud Backup & Restore.
⁃ Supports transferring data to Health app.
⁃ Supports universal version.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
Let’s your periods in control and prepare well when those days are coming, instead of being overwhelmed by her sudden visit.

bluejetty:00162094:ios.summary:

Na área “Resumo”, acompanhe o seu desempenho e a
bluejetty:00162094:ios.description:
No aplicativo da Medway, você vai estudar com foco total na vaga de residência médica dos seus sonhos em qualquer lugar do Brasil, por meio de questões – o método mais eficaz de preparação.
Na área “Resumo”, acompanhe o seu desempenho e a média dos outros estudantes que utilizam o app para saber como você está em relação a eles. Continue a prova de onde parou, caso alguma não tenha sido concluída; e tenha acesso aos desafios sempre que eles forem lançados, bem como às publicações mais recentes e direcionamento para as aulas teóricas, hospedadas na plataforma Hotmart.
Já na área de “Provas”, você pode pesquisar ou acessar todas as provas completas, além de todos os desafios. Também pode, por meio de filtros, personalizar um simulado próprio, a fim de adaptá-lo às suas dificuldades. Sendo assim, adicione título, objetivo, ano, instituição, grau de dificuldade, temas, focos, imagens etc.).

Depois, é possível ver o comentário feito por especialistas e dar feedbacks. Nada melhor do que aprender com quem já foi aprovado e entende do assunto e do estilo de cobrança das questões.

bluejetty:00023513:ios.summary: After surviving a plane crash, you must collect resources to craft weapons and tools, build facilities and houses to withstand the elements of this strange island. Battle through various natural environments like fiery volcanoes, freezing g
bluejetty:00023513:ios.description:
After surviving a plane crash, you must collect resources to craft weapons and tools, build facilities and houses to withstand the elements of this strange island. Battle through various natural environments like fiery volcanoes, freezing glaciers, etc. and difficult obstacles such as mutant zombies, militias, wild creatures, etc. Do everything you can to get yourself home.
Game Features:
-MULTIPLAYER
To Survive on this mysterious deserted island, you must form friendships with players from around the world and gather the limited resources.
-CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT
Upgrade your character to stay alive and experience the excitement of what mother nature has to offer to its fullest.
-A UNIQUE ISLAND
The PVE part of this game is unlike any others. Survive and explore natural sceneries like beaches, tropical rainforests, swamps, and volcanoes. At the same time, you are battling your way through man-made obstacles, such as an expedition ship from the 1980s, many secret research labs, ancient underground ruins, and deadly abandoned temples.
-LEARN TO CRAFT AND BUILD
Collect materials and use them to build your own camp! Learn to craft various types of tools and weapons. You will need them to survive! Build your own unique camp with defensive facilities such as sensory tower, arrow tower, etc. and survival facilities like vegetable patches, where you plant seeds and grow food, or workbenches, where you make tools for hunting or gathering!
-PVP OR PVE
It's your choice! Whether to fight or work with other players!
-GO ON EXCITING ADVENTURES
This game was developed to provide players with the Ultimate experience of surviving on a deserted island. The PVE and PVP elements are something you can never find in any other game!
Can you survive this island and get yourself home?
--------------------
VIP Subscription:
1. You will receive a 7-day VIP after each subscription, which takes effect immediately after subscribing.
2. After activating VIP you will receive the privilege of Craft Anywhere, Backpack Expansion, Quick Search, Building Queue Expansion, Easy Collect, and Easy Sort. 
3. You will be able to claim 50 Crystals every day during the Subscription Period. 
Subscription Instruction:
1. Once the purchase is completed, you will be charged on your Apple Store Account. 
2. Subscription will be automatically renewed.You can turn off the Automatic Renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
3. Your account will be charged automatically within 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. You can manage your Subscription and turn off the Automatic Renewal in Account Settings. 
5. Terms of use: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula
6. Privacy policy: http://privacy.volcano-force.com/html/pp/en.html

Get ready for a classic puzzle experience that will captivate players of all ages and genders with Block Smash journey! Immerse yourself in the addictive world of block puzzles and indulge your love for timeless gameplay.

bluejetty:00186076:ios.name: Visual Anatomy
bluejetty:00186076:ios.summary:
Interactive reference with muscle action movies, free 1247 Gray's anatomy images add-on, 3D rotational models, full description, Latin names and audio pronunciation.
• Winners for 2011-2016 in Best Medical App (awarded by http://bestappeve
bluejetty:00186076:ios.description:
Interactive reference with muscle action movies, free 1247 Gray's anatomy images add-on, 3D rotational models, full description, Latin names and audio pronunciation.
• Winners for 2011-2016 in Best Medical App (awarded by http://bestappever.com)
• Visual Anatomy is recommended by top U.S.-licensed doctors on HealthTap (https://www.healthtap.com/#apps/375/promote)
• Support English, French, Spanish and German languages
OVERVIEW:
Visual Anatomy is an interactive reference, and education tool. It contains more than 500 high-resolution images (plus 141 single muscle images) and more than 850 feature points which can be interactively selected. Each feature has its own label and short description. Major muscles have action animations. The app also has search function which can be used as searching the labels of all feature points. In addition, 6 quizzes with 150 multi-choice questions also are included. It also has all Gray's anatomy images for a quick review.
••Differences between paid version and Lite (Free) version••
1. Paid version has deep muscles and muscle index table with audio.
2. Paid version has more than 40 muscle group action movies.
3. Paid version has more than 100 major muscle action movies.
4. Paid version has more than 200 bone markers.
5. Paid version has audio pronunciation for all anatomy terms.
6. Paid version has 150 more quizzes.
7. Paid version has all 1247 Gray's images.
8. Paid version has physiology animation videos
USES:
This app’s primary use is as a learning tool but can also be used for any professional who needs the occasional reminder. Additionally, this app is ideal for physicians, educators or professionals, allowing them to visually show detailed areas to their patients or students - helping to educate or explain conditions, ailments and injuries. It can be also used as human anatomy guide or anatomy dictionary.
FEATURES:
• Latin names
• No internet connection is required.
• Physiology animation videos
• Tap and Pinch Zoom - zoom into and identify any region, bone or other feature by tapping on the screen.
• 3D rotational models
• Quick Navigation - jump to a different system or organ by selecting the thumbnail.
• Great for learning anatomy and physiology
• Audio: Pronunciation guide for all anatomy terms. 
• High-resolution images.
• Free periodic updates.
CONTENTS:
1. Organ 3D overview
2. One of main sections - Muscles. It have 145 muscles including full description (ORIGIN, INSERTION, NERVE, ACTIONS) and cover all superficial muscles and most of deep muscles. A muscle index table with 145 single muscle images.
3. One of main sections - Bones with some bone markers.
Skeleton overview, Skull, Inferior and Superior skull,Neck Bones, Spinal Column, Ribs, Pelvic Girdle, Hand Bones, Foot Bones. It also includes ligaments in knee, shoulder and ankle joints.
4. Respiratory System(overview), Lung,
5. Digestive System(overview), Liver,
6. Urinary System,
7. Nervous System(overview), Brain, Central Nervous System,
8. Reproductive System (Male and female),
9. Senses (Finger, Hand, Ear ,Mouth, Nasal Cavity, Nose, Tongue,Human Denture)
10. Circulatory system. (Principle Veins and Arteries, Heart Anatomy, Head vessels)
11. Endocrine System (overview)
12. Lymphatic system
12. 6 quizzes with 150 multi-choice questions
13. 1247 Gray's anatomy images.
SEARCH:
When you input more than one characters, the search function automatically gives a list of potential key words. You can just select one of them from the list. The result will be the feature point on the anatomy image and label.
FEEDBACK:
I'm open to suggestions so don't hesitate to send me an e-mail if you have some feedback.
Email: imagemagicstudio@gmail.com

6. Urinary System,

12. Lymphatic system
12. 6 quizzes with 150 multi-choice questions
13. 1247 Gray's anatomy images.

bluejetty:00092294:ios.name: Brawl Bag - Merge & Fight
bluejetty:00092294:ios.summary:
ENEMIES BEWARE!
Set out on an adventure with your trusty backpack – it may not look like much from the outside, but thanks to the magic spell placed on it you can cram all sorts of powerful weapons inside that will aid you in your monster
bluejetty:00092294:ios.description:
ENEMIES BEWARE!
Set out on an adventure with your trusty backpack – it may not look like much from the outside, but thanks to the magic spell placed on it you can cram all sorts of powerful weapons inside that will aid you in your monster battles! This game comes complete with cute enemies, tons of collectible items, stress-free play, and so much fun!
This merge battle game is easy to play, making this perfect for all ages – each level stage you’ll be presented with various items your warrior can use to fight off the monsters. Add them to your backpack, and if they’re similar you can combine them to craft super powerful items. But be careful, your bag has limited space! Choose your items carefully, combine them wisely, and you’ll be zooming through levels and monster fights in no time. You’ll also be able to collect other items that will aid your progress, such as clothing and more!
LOOK FORWARD TO:
Fun fights – each level consists of several smaller stages, giving you the chance to hone your battle strategy and try out different weapons on the monsters. With levels only a few minutes long, you’ll be able to focus on gaining power and crafting new items as opposed to stressing about the waves of enemies approaching.
Tons of collectibles – clothing, weapons, monsters, and more! Chart what all weapons you’ve put in your backpack, which monsters you’ve fought and beaten, and of course, collect tons of neat outfits that will aid you in battle. Don’t forget to merge your collectibles to make them even more powerful too, you can never be overequipped!
Cute characters – Just because this is a fighting game doesn’t mean that it can’t be adorable too! The great graphics and fun music and sound effects will make the battle experience that much sweeter and help keep the mood entertaining and light.
Straightforward mechanics – No crazy rules or complicated procedures here! Sit back and relax as you merge weapons and items, then let your warrior take care of the hard battle work. Your backpack is also always visible, making it easy to see what all you have inside and what can be merged or crafted.
BATTLE ON
If you’re looking for a fun fantasy game that involves merging items, fighting monsters, and going on adventures, then download Brawl Bag today! By collecting and merging items in your bag you can create amazing power ups that will have you flying through levels, and each game session will leave you feeling relaxed thanks to the fun graphics and relaxed gaming style. So what are you waiting for, jump in the game now and get to collecting, strategizing, and winning!

bluejetty:00185613:ios.description:
Journey into the enchanting realm of mystical dragons! Immerse yourself in the captivating world where you can hatch, merge, and evolve your unique baby dragons in a vibrant city teeming with magical wonders, minigames, and exhilarating events.
Step into the extraordinary dragon farm simulator, where you tend to over a thousand dragons. Care for them as you feed, pet, and train these lovely creatures, witnessing their evolution into powerful warriors.
WELCOME TO DRAGOLANDIA
- Witness jaw-dropping visuals that bring the diverse islands and inhabitants of Dragolandia to life.
- Shape and adorn your own islands with farms, habitats, and unique decorations tied to special events.
- Experience the excitement of merging different species to hatch extraordinary, new dragons.

- Keep an eye out for rare and exclusive dragons to add to your magnificent collection.
- Join in seasonal events that offer unique opportunities to collect special dragon breeds.
ALWAYS A NEW ADVENTURE
- Embark on epic journeys across the land with your cherished dragon companions! Ascend through the ranks as your collection and skills seamlessly merge into an unstoppable force.
- Stay engaged with seasonal events and special quests added with each update, ensuring you never run out of activities and dragons to collect.

bluejetty:00159231:ios.description:
Bitoshi is a financial solution that provides individuals and businesses more ways to manage everyday finance and explore new money possibilities. Built on crypto infrastructure, Bitoshi brings together: 
• Crypto: Buy, sell, swap, send and receive supported cryptocurrencies.
• Fiat: Add money, manage your fiat, withdraw to bank and pay supported bills.
• Payments: Send & receive Crypto, and pay seamlessly virtual cards.
• Cross-Border: Send money globally. 
• Business Finance: Financial tools businesses need to go further.
BUY, SELL AND SWAP CRYPTO
Trade BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, cNGN, SOL, TON, BNB, PYUSD, TRX, LTC, and swap 500+ crypto. Explore supported coins and networks, view available rates and manage your portfolio.
ADD MONEY AND WITHDRAW
Add money (₦, GH₵, KSh), manage your fiat balance and withdraw to your bank account with ease. Your financial activity is organised in one platform, with access to account statements.
SEND AND RECEIVE CRYPTO
Send, receive and auto-convert supported assets across available networks. Make transfers to other Bitoshi users using usernames or addresses, or send to external wallets.
SEND GLOBALLY
Send money and crypto, make payments across borders (Ghana and Kenya) with ease. 
PAY EVERYDAY BILLS
Buy airtime and data, and pay for other eligible bills and services categories such as electricity and television subscriptions, using crypto or local currency (₦, GH₵, KSh).
MORE WAYS TO PAY
Explore the Bitoshi virtual card for supported online purchases and subscriptions. Your card gives you another way to make eligible payments beyond traditional crypto transfers.
GAMIFICATION, REFER AND EARN
Invite friends monthly, carry out gamified activities, climb the leaderboard and earn big rewards when all requirements are completed.
TRADE FOR LESS
Set price alerts for supported assets and receive notifications when your selected price conditions are met. Explore Bitoshi Hour for reduced trading rates on selected days and eligible transactions. Rates, conditions and availability may vary.
YOUR FINANCIAL ASSISTANT
Explore Bitoshi's AI Assistant for help navigating the app, understanding available features and finding relevant information. Use it as a guide for financial decisions.
MORE FOR BUSINESSES
Bitoshi OTC services support business-focused, cross-border and high-value transaction needs. Explore available services and speak with Bitoshi Support about the options suited to you.
ACCOUNT SECURITY AND SUPPORT
Set up your profile, turn on push notifications, manage your account security and access with passkeys, 2FA and Face Comparison. Access Bitoshi Support in-app when you need assistance.

Bitoshi is a financial solution that provides individuals and businesses more ways to manage everyday finance and explore new money possibilities. Built on crypto infrastructure, Bitoshi brings together: 
• Crypto: Buy, sell, swap, send and receive supported cryptocurrencies.

BUY, SELL AND SWAP CRYPTO

ADD MONEY AND WITHDRAW

SEND GLOBALLY

PAY EVERYDAY BILLS
Buy airtime and data, and pay for other eligible bills and services categories  such as electricity and television subscriptions, using crypto or local currency (₦, GH₵, KSh).

MORE WAYS TO PAY

GAMIFICATION, REFER AND EARN
Invite friends monthly, carry out gamified activities, climb the leaderboard and earn big rewards when all requirements are completed.

TRADE FOR LESS
Set price alerts for supported assets and receive notifications when your selected price conditions are met. Explore Bitoshi Hour for reduced trading rates on selected days and eligible transactions. Rates, conditions and availability may vary.

YOUR FINANCIAL ASSISTANT
Explore Bitoshi's AI Assistant for help navigating the app, understanding available features and finding relevant information. Use it as a guide for financial decisions.

MORE FOR BUSINESSES
Bitoshi OTC services support business-focused, cross-border and high-value transaction needs. Explore available services and speak with Bitoshi Support about the options suited to you.

ACCOUNT SECURITY AND SUPPORT
Set up your profile, turn on push notifications, manage your account security and access with passkeys, 2FA and Face Comparison. Access Bitoshi Support in-app when you need assistance.

bluejetty:00086662:ios.description:
- Знайдіть свого ідеального фахівця за допомогою нашого індивідуального алгоритму -
Щоб обрати спеціалістів, які допоможуть вам досягти ваших цілей, ми пропонуємо вам заповнити коротку анкету. У ній ви можете описати свої очікування від терапевта. На основі ваших відповідей ми запропонуємо список фахівців, які найкраще вам підходять. Ми враховуємо кожен аспект вашої анкети при виборі професіоналів, які допоможуть досягти ваших терапевтичних цілей.
- Тільки перевірені та сертифіковані терапевти -
Ми ретельно вивчаємо та перевіряємо всіх терапевтів, які знаходяться на платформі Rozmova. Ми перевіряємо їхню вищу освіту та професійні дипломи. Ми також підтримуємо прозору та надійну систему відгуків і приділяємо пильну увагу скаргам клієнтів. Ви можете перевірити всі дипломи та сертифікати на сторінках профілів наших терапевтів. Перед бронюванням сеансу ви можете переглянути відеовізитку терапевта та дізнатися про їх терапевтичний підхід. Крім того, ви можете зв'язатися з фахівцем через чат, щоб уточнити будь-які питання до початку сеансу.
- Плануйте сесії у зручний для вас час
В Rozmova клієнти можуть бронювати терапевтичні сесії з доступними терапевтами в той самий день, на відміну від інших платформ, де для запису необхідно вставати в чергу. Ми розуміємо, що психічне здоров'я є надзвичайно важливим і до нього слід ставитися відповідно. bluejetty:00127171:ios.description:
Explore your creativity by discovering Craft Cross Stitch: Pixel Art.
Embrace the wonderful world of magic cross-stitching by trying this brand-new pixel embroidery game with fabulous cross-stitch patterns.
Cross stitch is the ideal cozy art therapy for people who are methodical and is a great mindful activity to ease away the day’s stresses. Neuroscientists have discovered that crafting is good for our brains and helps ease the symptoms of anxiety, depression, and other disorders. Engaging in crafts produces the same effects as meditation because you get in the flow of your craft and forget life stressors.
Pull up a comfy chair and discover one of the most timeless crafts of all - it’s so easy to get started and the stitches from tiles come together number by number to create a pattern. Bring your creative vision to life at the speed of light with incredible art games. This wonderful stress-relief pixel coloring game will be easy to master, and your unique creations are certain to brighten up every day anytime anywhere. 
Begin creating masterpieces that will take everyone’s both adults and kids breath away:
- Reveal fun and easy-to-follow patterns with stunning results
- Color & sew with love, get daily bonuses and gifts
- Endless creative inspiration for a wonderful variety of themes
- Enjoy beautiful cross-stitch designs and customize your pictures with stickers
- Express your creativity with our coloring book, it is the perfect way to unwind and relax after a long day
When you've decided to embark on your color stitching journey we’ve got you covered with our addictive canvas pixel art game.
Whichever pattern you pick, happy stitching & coloring!
Introducing our latest feature: the Meta Room! Earn stars by embroidering beautiful pictures and use them to color and decorate items in your Meta Room. Unleash your creativity and personalize your space like never before. Dive into a world where your stitching skills bring your virtual home to life!
Privacy Policy:
https://www.playcus.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service:
https://www.playcus.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00185292:ios.summary:
The King’s lands are beset on all sides by bandits, goblins, and strange creatures, but an even more ominous threat looms in the dark tower on the horizon...
You’ve been recruited to lead a force of heroes to cleanse the land! Take command
bluejetty:00185292:ios.description:
The King’s lands are beset on all sides by bandits, goblins, and strange creatures, but an even more ominous threat looms in the dark tower on the horizon...
You’ve been recruited to lead a force of heroes to cleanse the land! Take command of your new guild, and recruit heroes from the local tavern to join your ranks.
Battle through an epic campaign spanning 6 zones, and get your hands on epic loot along the way. Train and Promote your heroes to unlock powerful skills, and form the ultimate team!
Upgrade and reforge your items to create the legendary artifacts you’ll need to take down the most powerful bosses in the land.
REAL-TIME 3D BATTLES
Watch your heroes fight in real-time 3D rendered battles, or send them off and check back later to claim the loot! Gain experience to promote your heroes to the next level, and unlock powerful new skills.
DEEP RPG STRATEGY
Create your ideal party from over 100 different class combinations from the 4 primary schools: Defense, Healing, Support, and Magic. Redefine the classic roles of tank healer and dps with creative hybrid classes that suit your playstyle!
MULTIPLE GAME MODES
Race to be the first to finish the Campaign, push farthest in the Solo, Duo, or Party Trials, or create the ultimate 8-man team to take down Raid bosses. Assert dominance in PvP Arena battles!
EXCITING ROADMAP
From limited-time events to PvP to brand new items, you can expect a ton of cool updates as the game grows. We’re a small indie team that loves games as much as you do, and we can’t wait to see you in King’s Call!
Join us on Discord: discord.gg/CpKxHJ3
Featuring Music by Matthew Pablo
http://www.matthewpablo.com

bluejetty:00070816:ios.name: Sensors Toolbox
bluejetty:00070816:ios.summary: Sensors toolbox is the absolute all-in-one diagnostic tool that lets you know virtually everything about your mobile device status. Get full information about all sensors supported by your tablet, smartphone or wearable device. View in comf
bluejetty:00070816:ios.description:
Sensors toolbox is the absolute all-in-one diagnostic tool that lets you know virtually everything about your mobile device status. Get full information about all sensors supported by your tablet, smartphone or wearable device. View in comfortable layout all data from your mobile device sensors in real time, make a sensors tests. Check data on chart (graphic view) and text output available for each sensor and check a detailed description of each detectors and parameters.
All multi tools and sensors device you need in one app: altimeter, metal detector, compass, sport tracker and much more.
This sensors tool box app gives you access to data from:
- accelerometer readings (linear acceleration and gravity sensors)
- gyroscope (calibrated and uncalibrated)
- device 3D orientation
- kinetics sensors
- rotation vector sensors
- other motion and position sensors
- magnetometer, ambient magnetic field values strength (micro Tesla, µT) 
- barometer, pressure sensor
- location, accuracy, altitude
- battery status
- sound level meter and microphone meter (decibel)
- device front and back camera resolution
- smartphone display size, resolution
- device, phone memory, RAM and CPU parameters
and others sensors available in your mobile device. 
With this sensors multitool app you can check what kind of sensors contain your device and test all of this. It supports all the sensors on device and it will tell you which of them are not supported by your hardware.
If you have any problems with this app or ideas to develop, please send us message to apps@examobile.com
Have a fun at work with this ultimate tool!

bluejetty:00045378:ios.name: Ricky Kalmon: Daily Motivation
bluejetty:00045378:ios.summary:
Pause, reset, and redirect your mind with guided meditation, mindfulness, self-hypnosis, and daily motivation designed to inspire calm, clarity, confidence, and a growth mindset.
Mindset expert, author, speaker, and celebrity hypnotist Ric
bluejetty:00045378:ios.description:
Pause, reset, and redirect your mind with guided meditation, mindfulness, self-hypnosis, and daily motivation designed to inspire calm, clarity, confidence, and a growth mindset.
Mindset expert, author, speaker, and celebrity hypnotist Ricky Kalmon shares powerful techniques for personal and professional growth through guided audio experiences that help reduce stress, improve focus, strengthen self-belief, and unlock greater potential. Whether your goal is relaxation, better sleep, improved performance, or a daily mindset reset, you'll discover practical tools to help you create lasting positive change.
The app also features guided meditations, self-hypnosis sessions, mindfulness exercises, breathing techniques, relaxing music, calming sounds, and daily motivation to support your journey toward a more focused, balanced, and empowered life.
PROGRESS TRACKING
Meet your daily streak. Every day you show up, your flame grows: red, then gold, then blue. See how many days in a row you've kept it lit, and how many days you've shown up over the past year.
AI RICKY 
AI RICKY is your on-demand AI mindset coach, delivering personalized guidance on mindset, business, personal growth, golf, and sports performance. Develop a growth mindset, build confidence, navigate challenges, and achieve greater success in professional and personal growth. 
DAILY MOTIVATION
Daily Motivation provides fresh inspiration and practical mindset insights every day to help you stay focused on your goals and potential. Receive daily encouragement, growth mindset reminders, and actionable ideas that empower you to think bigger, overcome challenges, and create lasting success.
MEDITATION
Meditation programs designed to help you quiet the noise, reduce stress, and create greater focus in your daily life. Through guided sessions, you'll learn to reset your mindset, improve mental clarity, and develop a stronger sense of calm, confidence, and presence.
RELAXATION & STRESS RELIEF
Stress can affect your focus, energy, decision-making, and overall well-being. These guided programs help you recognize stress triggers, shift your perspective, and respond more effectively so you can stay calm, focused, and in control. 
SLEEP
These guided sleep sessions help you disconnect from the day, quiet mental chatter, and drift naturally into deep, restorative sleep so you can wake up renewed and ready for tomorrow.
SELF-HYPNOSIS
These self-hypnosis sessions help reinforce positive beliefs, strengthen confidence, improve focus, and support lasting personal and professional growth.
GOLF AND SPORTS MENTAL CONDITIONING
These guided programs help athletes strengthen focus, build confidence, manage emotions, stay present, and develop the mental toughness needed to perform at their highest level.
RELAXING MUSIC AND SOUNDS
Create the perfect environment for relaxation, focus, reflection, or rest. Enjoy a collection of soothing music and calming sounds designed to help you unwind, reduce distractions, and enhance your overall sense of well-being throughout the day.
Free and In-App Subscription
This app is free to download and includes access to select content. To unlock unlimited access to all mindset programs, a monthly or annual subscription is available.
Your subscription includes a free 7-day trial. At the end of the trial period, your payment method will be charged based on the subscription plan you selected unless canceled before the trial ends.
Payment will be charged to the payment method associated with your Apple ID when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal settings at any time on your iPhone by going to Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
For more information on our terms of service and privacy policy, please visit https://www.rickykalmon.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00126992:ios.description:
Connect with Sadhguru and practice Isha Yoga on the official Sadhguru App! Discover Yoga for beginners and benefit from free Yoga and meditation practices that can help you overcome stress and anxiety, and establish lasting calm and joy, in just a few minutes a day.
Sadhguru App is available in 12 languages – Russian, French, Spanish, German, Hindi, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Marathi, Malayalam, Bengali and Tamil.
Start your day with Sadhguru’s daily quotes, stay up to date with his latest articles, listen to his podcasts, and watch videos on a wide range of topics including spirituality, success, Yoga, meditation, relationships, health, fitness, and living a joyful and stress-free life.
Sadhguru’s Guidance and Wisdom
Start your day with Sadhguru – Quotes for your daily dose of insight and inspiration
Daily Sadhguru Wisdom Videos – Short daily wisdom bites from Sadhguru to help you start your spiritual life
Sadhguru Videos, Articles, and Podcasts – Latest videos and articles on a wide range of intriguing topics, and podcasts, so you can access Sadhguru’s wisdom wherever you are.
Free Yoga Practices
Yoga for Health – A simple way to activate the energy nodules in your joints and exercise your muscles, bringing ease to the whole system.
Yoga for Immunity – Practices to help enhance your immunity and lung capacity
Yoga for Success – A vertical spine corresponds to a leap in capability in evolution. This simple practice keeps the spine healthy and active, naturally leading to success.
Yoga for Overall Wellbeing – Yoga Namaskar is a simple and powerful process that activates the lumbar region and strengthens the muscles along the spine to prevent the collapse of the spine due to ageing.
Yoga for Peace – The Nadi Shuddhi practice cleanses the nadis, - the pathways through which pranic energy flows, - resulting in a balanced system and psychological well-being.
Yoga for Joy – Nada Yoga - the Yoga of sound or reverberation, – allows you to utter the sounds that create an inner atmosphere of joy, making it a natural way to be.
Yoga for Inner Exploration - Shambhavi Mudra is an easy, effortless process that enhances your perception and makes you receptive to that dimension of life often termed Grace.
Yoga for Love – The many nerve endings in your palms make them very sensitive. By placing them together in Namaskar, you can change your chemistry to foster love within.
Guided Meditations
Isha Kriya – Learn a free 12-minute guided meditation designed by Sadhguru. Daily practice of Isha Kriya helps bring health, dynamism, peace and well-being.
Sadhguru Presence – Experience Sadhguru's presence daily at 6:20 PM through a 7-minute guided chant.
Infinity Meditation - Designed by Sadhguru, this 15-minute Infinity-guided meditation creates stability and balance in one’s energies and can bring one to an experience of boundlessness.
Chants - Meditate to bliss chants Nirvana Shatakam and Gurupaduka stotram and carry the exuberance through the day.
Chit Shakti Meditations – Using the power of the mind to create what one wants in one’s life is called Chit Shakti. 
Inner Engineering - Seven 90-minute sessions impart potent tools from the ancient science of Yoga, with the potential to transform how you live, conduct, and experience your life.
Sadhguru Exclusive - Sadhguru Exclusive is a unique video platform to explore mysticism and spirituality with Sadhguru. It contains captivating glimpses of Sadhguru, revealing never-before-seen content deep within the Isha archives. Immerse yourself in many engaging series - each one featuring a unique selection of Sadhguru’s timeless wisdom.

bluejetty:00042965:ios.name: IslamOne Quran & Hadith
bluejetty:00042965:ios.summary:
IslamOne brings the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and supplications together in one app — fully readable in English or Urdu, completely free, with no ads and no subscription.
Choose English or Urdu as your reading language and the whole app
bluejetty:00042965:ios.description:
IslamOne brings the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and supplications together in one app — fully readable in English or Urdu, completely free, with no ads and no subscription.
Choose English or Urdu as your reading language and the whole app follows.
QURAN
• Four ways to read: Translation, Tafseer, Surah Mushaf and Parah Mushaf, one tap apart
• 22 translations — 9 English (Saheeh International, Pickthall, Yusuf Ali, Taqi Usmani, Maududi and more) and 13 Urdu
• Tafheem ul Quran and Maarif ul Quran in full English translation — rarely available free
• Word-by-word translation in English and Urdu
• Transliteration throughout for non-Arabic readers
• Translation Only mode: read the meaning ruku by ruku, without the Arabic
• Search in Arabic with or without harakat, in English or in Urdu
• Pin your favourite surahs to the top, bookmark verses with notes, and pick up where you left off
• The dua for completing the Quran at the end of the last parah
AUDIO RECITATION
• Listen to any surah with your choice of reciter
• The Mushaf follows the recitation, highlighting each ayah as it is recited
• Download surahs for offline listening — no internet needed
• Playback speed, surah skip and a floating player you can keep open while you read
• Play from any Ruku in the Mushaf
• Optional Urdu translation audio
HADITH
Eight books in full English translation, including all six major collections — Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abu Dawood, Sunan Nasai, Jame' Tirmidhi and Sunan Ibn Majah, plus Muwatta Imam Malik and Shamail Tirmidhi. Three further books (Mishkaat, Musnad Ahmad, Maarif ul Hadith) are available in Urdu. Narrators, text and takhreej are shown in colour for easier reading.
PRAYER TIMES & QIBLA
• Accurate timings for your location, with every major calculation method and custom adjustments
• Adhan notifications, including the full Adhan
• Qibla compass
• Hijri calendar with manual adjustment for local moon sighting
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for the daily verse, prayer times, fasting and duas
SUPPLICATIONS
Authentic duas organised by occasion, with English translation and transliteration, repeat counters, bookmarks and search. Pin the categories you use most. Dua of the Moment suggests the right dua for the time of day and the Islamic calendar — morning, evening, Ramadan, Hajj and Eid.
HAJJ & UMRAH
A step-by-step guide to performing Umrah and Hajj, with recorded duas, in English and Urdu — plus the duas of the journey.
DAILY REMINDERS
A Quran verse chosen for the time and the date (Al-Kahf on Fridays, the fasting verses in Ramadan), with a dua in the evening. Tap to read.
ALSO INCLUDED (URDU)
Complete Seerat-un-Nabi (PBUH), the lives of 33 Sahabah, fiqh rulings, Islamic history and poetry — a full Urdu library alongside the English one.
MADE FOR YOU
• Dark Mode that follows your iPhone, or stays Light or Dark
• 19 theme colours
• Pinch to resize text in the Quran, hadith and dua readers
• Share a verse as a link that opens straight in IslamOne
• Spot a mistake? Report it from the verse, hadith or dua itself
WHY ISLAMONE
• 100% free — no ads, no subscription, no locked features
• Read offline: the Quran, translations, hadith and duas are all on your device
• Built for bilingual households: read in English, share with family who read Urdu
Download IslamOne and share it with your family and friends. Jazak Allah Khair!
