bluejetty:00017180:ios.description:
Hey, what song is that? SoundHound makes it simple to identify music playing around you. Whether you’re in the car or out and about — open the app, hit the big orange SoundHound button, let your phone listen for a few seconds, and we’ll tell you exactly what’s playing! It's been called pure magic — and with 300M+ downloads and billions of songs discovered — we tend to agree.
SoundHound comes equipped with “Hey SoundHound…”, an incredibly powerful way to interact with the app using your voice. “Hey SoundHound…” can help you navigate the app, activate the orange button, and playback songs hands-free. Simply say ‘Hey SoundHound...’ from any screen and say a command!
Discovering new music is only half the fun of SoundHound. We’re music lovers too, so we’ve created an incredible experience for you to relive your discoveries with our music player. Connect your Apple Music or Spotify account to listen, build playlists, explore music across genres, and find new favorites - all with real-time, karaoke-style lyrics using LiveLyrics®. Don’t have an Apple Music or Spotify subscription? No sweat, we have you covered with our free, built-in YouTube player. This is your music journey.
Curious to know more? Here’s everything you need to know!
DISCOVER
• Tap the SoundHound button in the app, in the notification center widget, or via 3D touch on the app icon to discover music playing around you! We’ll let you know everything about the song including title, artist, album, and lyrics!
• Have a song stuck in your head? Press the SoundHound button, sing or hum the tune, and we’ll do the rest!
• Keep track of all your discoveries in your own personal history
• Use the Apple Watch app to quickly identify music and sing-along with LiveLyrics. Users with a cellular-enabled Apple Watch can use the app without being connected to an iPhone
PLAY
• Listen to songs and view lyrics in our free, built-in YouTube player
• Simply say ‘Hey SoundHound....’ from any screen or tap the microphone on the play page. Once you see the listening panel, you can follow up with commands including:
App Navigation: ‘Hey SoundHound… Show me my discoveries’
Help/Questions: ‘Hey SoundHound… Show me what I can say’
Music Discovery: ‘Hey SoundHound… What’s that song?’
Song Playback: ‘Hey SoundHound... Play Hello by Adele’
Lyrics Search: ‘Hey SoundHound... Show me lyrics to Castle on the Hill’
Top Charts: ‘Hey SoundHound...Play today’s top songs’
Playlists (Spotify account & registration required): ‘Hey SoundHound… Play my Discover weekly playlist on Spotify’
Add to Spotify Playlist (Spotify account & registration required): ‘Hey SoundHound… Add this song to my playlist’
CONNECT AND SHARE
• Build personalized playlists through Apple Music or Spotify (SoundHound account and music subscription required)
• Access Spotify playlists for a richer playback experience through SoundHound
• View and interact with real-time, moving lyrics for your songs with LiveLyrics
• Keep all of your discoveries synced across multiple devices
• Share your music discoveries to Facebook, Twitter, messaging services, and email!
Upgrade to SoundHound∞ for an ad-free experience: https://04ii.app.link/RXaRXypntA
SoundHound is powered by Houndify, an independent voice-enabled AI platform that enables natural, conversational intelligence on any product.

bluejetty:00040737:ios.description:
We have developed Bible Reading Made Easy to supply Christians with high quality resources for spiritual devotion, as well as to spread and bear witness to the gospel of the heavenly kingdom to more and more people. Through this app, you can use a variety of Bible translations to compare readings so that it is more convenient for you to understand the Bible. We have also prepared for you rich spiritual content and testimony articles that are true to life. We hope that these can help you solve the problems and confusions that you have in your spiritual and daily life, establish a normal relationship with God, and obtain more enlightenment from God.
The app functionality is simple and clear enough for anyone to use, so wherever you are, you can start your spiritual journey at the touch of a button in your spare time.
Why Use Bible Reading Made Easy?
• It is completely free and you can enjoy all the features at no cost. This app allows you to read the Scriptures hassle-free.
• Handpicked Bible passages come with interpretations to give you a relaxing reading experience.
• Bible Study provides you with high-quality articles explaining Bible passages, as well as Bible study topics of concern for Christians, to guide you into more profound study of the Bible.
• The app includes articles explaining biblical prophecies to help you study the fulfillment and accomplishment of God’s prophecies about the last days, so that their true meaning is made clear.
• With a handpicked selection of testimony articles, we share with you real experiences of Christians who have relied on God and seen God’s deeds when they were faced with difficulty and tribulation in their lives to allow you to sense God’s love and salvation.
• Here you can find hymn videos, gospel films, and all sorts of videos on Christians’ lives of faith, giving you a greater understanding of God’s work and opening more truths and mysteries to you.
• All sorts of beautiful images are available for you to download and share free!
Features
• Custom images: A simple, easy way to create your own images, adding your favorite Bible verses.
• Q&A: Whether it’s a question that comes up while reading Scripture or a difficulty you encounter in everyday life, you can ask us anything. You can also search for key terms to find the answers you’re seeking.
• Scripture navigation: Provides convenient and flexible methods for navigating the Scriptures to help you more quickly locate the passages of the Bible you need to begin your journey of reading the Scriptures.
• Multi-text comparison: Allows simultaneous comparison of multiple translations of the Bible, making reference and comparison of Scripture convenient.

The app functionality is simple and clear enough for anyone to use, so wherever you are, you can start your spiritual journey at the touch of a button in your spare time.

• It is completely free and you can enjoy all the features at no cost. This app allows you to read the Scriptures hassle-free.
• Handpicked Bible passages come with interpretations to give you a relaxing reading experience.
• Bible Study provides you with high-quality articles explaining Bible passages, as well as Bible study topics of concern for Christians, to guide you into more profound study of the Bible.
• The app includes articles explaining biblical prophecies to help you study the fulfillment and accomplishment of God’s prophecies about the last days, so that their true meaning is made clear.
• With a handpicked selection of testimony articles, we share with you real experiences of Christians who have relied on God and seen God’s deeds when they were faced with difficulty and tribulation in their lives to allow you to sense God’s love and salvation.
• Here you can find hymn videos, gospel films, and all sorts of videos on Christians’ lives of faith, giving you a greater understanding of God’s work and opening more truths and mysteries to you.
• All sorts of beautiful images are available for you to download and share free!

Features
• Custom images: A simple, easy way to create your own images, adding your favorite Bible verses.
• Q&A: Whether it’s a question that comes up while reading Scripture or a difficulty you encounter in everyday life, you can ask us anything. You can also search for key terms to find the answers you’re seeking.
• Scripture navigation: Provides convenient and flexible methods for navigating the Scriptures to help you more quickly locate the passages of the Bible you need to begin your journey of reading the Scriptures.
• Multi-text comparison: Allows simultaneous comparison of multiple translations of the Bible, making reference and comparison of Scripture convenient.

Cleaner PRO is your intelligent tool for keeping your device organized, efficient, and performing at its best. Powerful Features at a Glance
Smart Photo & Video Cleaner
Automatically scan and clean your photo gallery by detecting similar images, blurry shots, screenshots, and large videos. Keep only what matters and recover valuable storage space with confidence.
Calendar Cleanup
Easily remove outdated or irrelevant calendar events to keep your schedule clean and organized.
Contact Organizer
Detect and manage duplicate or incomplete contact entries. Maintain a clear, accurate address book effortlessly.
Device Monitor

bluejetty:00095999:ios.name: Pines Peak - Merge Adventure
bluejetty:00095999:ios.summary:
Play our new casual merge game! Meet Pines Peak, the new mobile casual game for the whole family! Our casual merge game is designed for the whole family!
Escape from the routine and relax! For any age and gender! A klondike of adventures!
bluejetty:00095999:ios.description:
Play our new casual merge game! Meet Pines Peak, the new mobile casual game for the whole family! Our casual merge game is designed for the whole family!
Escape from the routine and relax! For any age and gender! A klondike of adventures! A real treasure island in the world of travel! The main characters are Alex and Emma. Let's get to know them better! 
After her husband's betrayal, Alex returns to her mother's old family farm with her daughter, Emma. But instead of a quiet life, she's faced with debts and visits from her ex-husband Graham and his lawyer, who are trying to take the land away. The farm is the only thing the family has left, and Alex decides to fight for it at any cost.
Emma learns to find joy even in difficult circumstances: she meets their neighbors, adopts a cute puppy, helps her mother set up their new life, and curiously delves into all the secrets the farm holds. Emma becomes the main incentive for Alex not to give up: after all, her daughter's future depends on her determination.
As the farm gradually comes back to life, friends and allies appear by their side: caring neighbor Marge, loyal puppy Pixie, old flame Sebastian, and childhood friend Cassandra. Together, they restore buildings and fight injustice. But with each victory, Alex faces new mysteries on her path: a strange black car outside the house, a weird key with the initials "V. V.", and the shadow of Mayor Vivienne. Her visits start to look less and less like concern for the life of the neighborhood and more like a hidden threat.
Balancing between family problems, budding feelings for Sebastian, and a dangerous investigation, Alex gets closer to the truth step by step. Her goal is to save the farm, protect Emma, and get back what was taken from her.
Features:
- Merge items to help Alex and her daughter Emma in their mystery adventure!
- Many colorful characters, each with their own backstory and profession.
- Lots of animals in each location of our casual game, Pines Peak!
- Set out for the ruined family farm in the rural US and work your way to other iconic places!
- Each adventure is an exciting story in a new location. Pines Peak is a mix of different genres and moods!
- Build a farm, a hotel, a mansion, where each guest has their own secrets.
 - Pines Peak also has a huge number of different mini-games! Play to your heart's content!
- Every month, there is an update with new mechanics or timed events. We release a new adventure every week!
- Limited-time expeditions with new mechanics: treasure rooms, crafting, garden beds, energy generators in locations, tournaments, season passes, the wheel of fortune, etc.!
The great merge journey is about to begin! Have fun exploring the worlds of Pines Peak.

bluejetty:00144664:ios.description:
mit.dk is your digital entrance to important interactions with the public and private sector – secure and simple.
The purpose of mit.dk is to make your everyday life easier. It’s free to use and all you need is a MitID.
• You can handle the digital post you receive or send, intuitively and easily.
• You can read, answer, and act on important messages from both public and private senders.
• Safely and securely, you can pay with e.g., MobilePay or a bank payment. mit.dk will help you to complete payments in due time, and it’s simple to sign up for Betalingsservice.
• Documents, contracts, or agreements are signed with your MitID directly on the document you have received in mit.dk.
• When you need to share sensitive information and documents, you can do so from mit.dk, securely and with no hassle. 
• Use your protected mit.dk profile as your access card. Without logging in again, you can access various self-service options and websites of the companies and public authorities that uses mit.dk. You only need to log into mit.dk once.
The first time you use mit.dk you simply need to sign up with your MitID and fill out a few details. Afterwards, you can quickly and securely log into the app by using facial recognition, fingerprint, or a pin code of your choice. 
You decide how mit.dk notifies you about new messages. You can receive a push notification on your mobile device, an e-mail, or a text message sent to your phone. You will also be notified if you must act on an important request.
Log into mit.dk via the app or www.mit.dk, where you can find additional information.
Enjoy a more simple, secure, and convenient way of handling important digital post with mit.dk!

bluejetty:00179637:ios.description:
Looking to make more informed football betting decisions? This app combines data-driven predictions, expert analysis, and live scores to help you better understand matches before and during kickoff.
Access football predictions across a wide range of leagues and tournaments worldwide. Our analysis is powered by advanced algorithms and real match data, taking into account key factors such as team form, head-to-head history, injuries, suspensions, and performance trends. This allows you to evaluate matches with more confidence instead of relying solely on intuition or unreliable sources.
In addition to predictions, the app provides in-depth insights into match dynamics, betting trends, and performance patterns. These insights are designed to help users gain a clearer picture of upcoming fixtures and understand how games may unfold.
Stay up to date with live scores and match events as they happen. Follow matches in real time and track results alongside pre-match analysis, all in one place.

bluejetty:00016039:ios.description:
Belote & Coinche: le Défi - Install the new Belote game now!
Welcome to the new universe of Belote and Coinche, Belote & Coinche: le Défi!
This free game is dedicated to all enthusiasts who want to recreate the atmosphere of live games.
Dive into an adventure full of challenges, prizes, and pure excitement.
Key Features:
● Play for free and online: Download the game for free and join thousands of online players.
● Daily bonuses and free chests: Special prizes await you every day. The more you play, the more you win.
● Special events and tournaments: Celebrate unique moments with thematic events and compete in exciting tournaments.
● Mini-games: Between games, enjoy slot machines and scratch cards to earn extra prizes.
● Variety of tables: Choose your table based on the level and stakes you want to bet.
● Advanced Coinche: Try the Tout Atout and Sans Atout options for even more fun.
Exclusive news:
● Weekly Championship: Every Tuesday, the championship of your rank begins, where you can earn points by winning games or completing recipes. Climbing ranks brings you increasingly rich rewards. Only the best will scale the heights of the championship!
● Join Clubs: Win games to open your club's chest. Exchange ingredients with other members, improve your club's league and get bigger prizes.
● Monthly Pass: Play Belote or Coinche and unlock a chest every day! Chests also allow you to earn stars to play at the exclusive premium table! Activate Gold and Ultra passes to get even richer rewards like the booster for the horse race!
● Premium Pass Table: Participate in the new premium table and win extraordinary prizes for your club. Use the stars earned by completing the stages of the Monthly Pass.
● Horse Race: Help your club's stable reach the top to get an exclusive badge. But be careful not to be demoted!
● The Gourmet Palace: By winning Belote and Coinche games, collect ingredients to prepare delicious recipes. Each dish prepared brings you special prizes. Unlock all the restaurants and win more and more prizes!
● Safe: Every time you play a game, deposit coins and tokens in the safe for free. You can decide to open the safe at a special price by the end of the month before it resets.
The higher your rank, the bigger your safe!
Don't know the rules of the game? No problem, learn how to play with a practical and fast tutorial, available at any time.
A welcome gift awaits you!
Open the game for the first time and receive a super welcome gift!
Start your journey in Belote & Coinche: le Défi on the right foot!
What are you waiting for?
Download Belote & Coinche: le Défi now and join a community of card game enthusiasts.
Your first gift awaits you in the game, ready to start this exciting adventure!
Do you have questions or comments?
Contact us through the in-game support or write to us at help@whatwapp.com.
Also, follow us on our Facebook page: BeloteLeDefi.
Attention:
The game is aimed at an adult audience and is NOT categorized as a real betting game, it is not possible to win real prizes and money with the use of this application. Frequent playing of this game does not correspond to a real advantage in betting sites where such a game is present.

bluejetty:00122985:ios.summary:

- A real-time forex calendar with complete eve
bluejetty:00122985:ios.description:
We're excited to release the official IOS App of Myfxbook.com, the leading social forex community with over 280,000 forex trading accounts connected!
Our iOS app offers the following features:
- A real-time forex calendar with complete event data and notifications.
- A complete view of your forex portfolio including watched accounts.
- Real-time streaming rates for over 60 forex currency pairs and commodities.
- Real-time forex news.
- Lightning fast user interface.
- Live streaming rates for over 60 forex currency pairs and commodities.
- Live Forex charts with technical analysis.
- Live forex news.
- Live price notifications.
- Live community outlook with custom notifications.
- Calculators to help you plan your trades.
- Simple, intuitive and lightning fast user interface.
The app will keep you easily up to date with the forex markets with the help of the following sections:
- Portfolio: the portfolio section will show you your Myfxbook portfolio including a growth chart, quick stats and the current status of the account (trades, orders and history). Don't have a portfolio yet? Then go to our website and register a free account.
- Economic Calendar: be in sync with the markets up to the minute with our live economic calendar covering over 30 different currencies with easily readable data. Each event can be drilled down for an explanation and historic levels.
- Markets: you can view over 60 different currency pairs in truly real time, tick by tick (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDCAD, USDJPY, AUDUSD and more), including the changes in 9 different time-frames in just one glance. Want to be alerted of a specific price? No problem - just set up an alert and get notified in real time. The markets section shows you forex patterns in real-time in each and every timeframe in one simple screen.
- Forex News: the news section will show you a streaming feed of economic news items streaming in real time from major news providers - you can even view news of specific instruments (for example EUR, USD or Gold).
- Community Outlook: a real-time outlook for different currency pairs as can be seen in the Myfxbook website. Each pair will include the full data such as the amount of open positions, total volume and more. Set up unlimited notifications for different levels (for example if long sentiment is over 50%).
- Calculators: when planning your next trade, use the calculators to calculate an entry price, position size, margin or risk value for a better money management.
- Privacy Policy - https://www.myfxbook.com/privacy
- Terms of Use - https://www.myfxbook.com/terms
Please rate us and provide feedback so we can enhance the Myfxbook app even further - contact us at ios@myfxbook.com.

bluejetty:00163102:ios.summary:
Xuan Lan Yoga es la mejor plataforma para aprender y practicar yoga y meditación online desde tu casa, con acceso ilimitado a clases y rutinas de yoga para mejorar tu bienestar cada día.
XLYStudio es un espacio de yoga online creado por Xu
bluejetty:00163102:ios.description:
Xuan Lan Yoga es la mejor plataforma para aprender y practicar yoga y meditación online desde tu casa, con acceso ilimitado a clases y rutinas de yoga para mejorar tu bienestar cada día.
XLYStudio es un espacio de yoga online creado por Xuan Lan Yoga para llevar un estilo y una filosofía de vida más saludable, fomentando el bienestar mental.
Esta app de yoga y bienestar te ofrece un catálogo de más de 2.500 vídeos en los que podrás encontrar clases de yoga de más de 14 estilos de yoga clasificadas por duración de la clase, nivel de práctica e intensidad. 
También podrás practicar mindfulness y meditación con nuestras más de 150 meditaciones guiadas disponibles. 
Queremos ayudarte a integrar el yoga y la meditación en tu día a día. Es por eso que en XLYStudio encontrarás una gran variedad de clases con más de 50 profesores certificados en yoga.
También estamos comprometidos con fomentar una mejor calidad de vida y bienestar mental. Por eso, más de 35 expertos en yoga y bienestar han colaborado con nosotros para ofrecerte los mejores consejos sobre salud natural, nutrición, psicología, filosofía…
Puedes llevarte nuestra app de yoga donde quieras para practicar donde sea: en casa o en tus vacaciones desde cualquier parte del mundo. Descarga los videos en la app y sigue con tu rutina de bienestar mental también en modo offline.
¿QUÉ OFRECE XUAN LAN YOGA?
- Nuevos videos de yoga en español cada semana sin anuncios
- Clases de yoga de distintas intensidades y duraciones
- Yoga en directo cada semana
- Más de 14 estilos de yoga diferentes
- Fitness y pilates
- Meditación y mindfulness
- Contenidos de bienestar mental
- Entrevistas con expertos del ámbito del bienestar
- Rutinas y retos de yoga
- Práctica sin acceso a Internet
- Descuentos en programas y otros productos de Xuan Lan Yoga
14 DÍAS DE PRUEBA GRATIS ¡SIN COMPROMISO!
Descargar la app de yoga y bienestar mental es completamente gratis. Explora y disfruta todos los contenidos, te ofrecemos 14 días de prueba gratis al darte de alta*. 
Cancela o edita tu suscripción en cualquier momento.
*La prueba gratis solo se ofrece una vez para nuevas altas.
¿PARA QUIÉN ES XUAN LAN YOGA?
Esta app de yoga y bienestar mental es para todas las personas que quieran generar un hábito de práctica regular.
Si buscas yoga para principiantes, XLYStudio ofrece clases para aprender las bases e iniciarse en el yoga desde cero. Además, podrás empezar con clases más cortas y sin la presión de que nadie te está observando. Practica yoga a tu ritmo y contigo mismo.
Puedes elegir entre nuestros dos planes: mensual y anual.
APP DE MEDITACIÓN
XLYStudio incluye meditaciones guiadas, mindfulness, meditaciones con japa mala, meditaciones en silencio... Aprende a meditar si eres principiante o sigue avanzando en tu rutina.
XUAN LAN YOGA
Xuan Lan es profesora de yoga y experta en bienestar mental, considerada por muchos como referente del mundo del yoga en España y Latinoamérica. Embajadora y principal impulsora del yoga en español.
XLYStudio ofrece una suscripción de renovación automática:
Recibirás acceso ilimitado al contenido de yoga en todos tus dispositivos. El pago se carga a tu cuenta en la confirmación de la compra. Los precios varían según la ubicación y se confirman antes de la compra. Después de la prueba gratuita, la suscripción se renueva automáticamente a la tarifa mensual a menos que se cancele al menos 24 horas antes del final del período de prueba. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente cada mes a menos que se cancele al menos 24 horas antes del final del período de facturación actual. Administra tu suscripción en Configuración de la cuenta.
Para obtener más información, consulta:
Condiciones del servicio: https://studio.xuanlanyoga.com/pages/terminos-y-condiciones
Política de privacidad: https://studio.xuanlanyoga.com/pages/politica-de-privacidad

bluejetty:00156327:ios.name: TRUE MANAGER™ AIR
bluejetty:00156327:ios.summary: With TRUE MANAGER™ AIR Mobile App and a "TRUE" branded blood glucose wireless meter, you can track data to get valuable insights that link daily activity with your glucose results. Easy-to-read charts, graphs and customizable notes make und
bluejetty:00156327:ios.description:
With TRUE MANAGER™ AIR Mobile App and a "TRUE" branded blood glucose wireless meter, you can track data to get valuable insights that link daily activity with your glucose results. Easy-to-read charts, graphs and customizable notes make understanding data actionable. Also, share data with healthcare providers, friends, and family to help manage diabetes. 
Features:
o Simple to navigate logbook shows date, time, blood glucose results and event tag from meter
o Additional event tags may be added to results in addition to personal notes
o Each blood glucose result is color coded to indicate if you are within acceptable range. You may customize the ranges given to you by your healthcare professional or use the default setting which are the established 2015 American Diabetes Association guideline target ranges (mg/dL): 
YELLOW = Above Normal, greater than 130
GREEN = Normal, 80-130
RED = Hypoglycemic, less than 70
NOTE: A doctor or healthcare professional determines how often to test and what the target ranges are for blood glucose results. 
o Six Reports provide total insights :
▪ Average Report - View 7, 14, 30, 60, 90 and 120 day averages to review general trending and spot areas for improvement.
▪ Conformance Report - This report displays pre- and post- meal glucose results in a pie chart format. Each pie chart is divided into color coded sections identifying the percentage of glucose results that are above, within or below targeted ranges for each testing time. 
▪ Glucose Trend Report - This graph can be customized by target range, date and time to reveal patterns and to quickly identify glucose results that are too low or too high.
▪ Logbook Report - Review all glucose results, including control results, over a specific time period in chronological order.
▪ Modal Day/Week Report - View all results in specific time blocks per day or week. Color coded for easy review of glucose results within, above or below customized target ranges. 
o Share data via PDF through email with healthcare providers, friends and family.
o Help screens are available on most pages if assistance is needed. 
Important Information:
• TRUE MANAGER AIR App is not for diagnostic use.
• NEVER change your treatment plan without consulting a Doctor or Healthcare Professional.
• TRUE MANAGER AIR App is for use with only specified supported mobile devices. Go to www.trividiahealth.com/truemanagerair for a list of compatible mobile devices.
• This product is intended for single patient use to support better diabetes management without providing specific treatment or treatment suggestions. 
• Refer to your "TRUE" branded wireless glucose meter Owner’s Booklet for pairing instructions.

bluejetty:00100447:ios.description:

- Clear the stage by removing all arrows from the screen

- A minimalist design with no unnecessary elements

bluejetty:00182999:ios.name: Critical Ops: Online PvP FPS
bluejetty:00182999:ios.summary:
Critical Ops is a 3D multiplayer FPS designed exclusively for mobile. 
Experience intense action, where fast reflexes and tactical skills are essential to success. Are you ready to prove yourself in the most skill-based mobile FPS?
FEATU
bluejetty:00182999:ios.description:
Critical Ops is a 3D multiplayer FPS designed exclusively for mobile. 
Experience intense action, where fast reflexes and tactical skills are essential to success. Are you ready to prove yourself in the most skill-based mobile FPS?
FEATURES
Critical Ops is a first-person shooter that features competitive combat through beautifully crafted maps and challenging game modes. Battle it out alongside your band of brothers or lead an individual scoreboard. Will you fight as a member of Coalition or The Breach to resolve the next high-stakes standoff?
The outcome is determined by your skill and your strategy. Every fraction of a second and every small delta in your aim or timing can make all the difference. Critical Ops has no in-app purchases that give a competitive advantage. We guarantee a fair-to-play experience.
Master a variety of modern weapons such as grenades, pistols, submachine guns, assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, and knives. Improve your aiming and shooting skills by competing in intense PvP gameplay. Competitive ranked matches pit you against other similarly skilled operatives. Grow into a hero.
Go social! Call out to your friends and invite them to join your clan. Host private matches and organize tournaments to win prizes. You are strong by yourself, but stronger as a team.
Critical Ops expands the world of esports onto mobile platforms. Spectate the pros in action or squad up with your friends and build your dream competitive team. Join our vibrant esports scene and become legends.
GAME MODES
Defuse
Two teams, two goals! One team plants and defends the bomb until detonation, while the other tries to prevent its arming or defuse it.
Team Deathmatch
Two opposing teams battle it out in a timed deathmatch. Play with all the fury of war and make each bullet count!
Elimination
Two teams fight it out until the last man. No respawn. Counter the attacks, survive, and dominate the battlefield!
GAME TYPES
Quick Games
Play all the available game modes in quick, matchmade games with operatives of similar skill level. Gear up and fire!
Ranked Games
Operatives compete for points and secure their rank through victory in a competitive matchmade adaptation of Defuse. Climb to the top of the ladder! 
Custom Games
The classic way of playing Critical Ops. Join or host a room of any of the available game types or create your own. Host password-protected private rooms.
REGULAR UPDATES
We regularly improve performance, add themed events, new features, rewards, and expand cosmetic customization options to deliver the best possible experience.
MOBILE FIRST. FLAWLESSLY OPTIMIZED.
Critical Ops is natively designed for mobile. It’s lightweight and fully optimized to work on a wide array of devices. No additional downloads are required.
Critical Ops is and always will be a free-to-play game. Purchases are purely cosmetic.
Download now and join the Critical Ops community!
Follow us on social media:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CriticalOpsGame/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CriticalOpsGame
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/CriticalForceEnt
Discord: https://discord.gg/criticalops
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/CriticalOpsGame/
Website: https://criticalopsgame.com
Privacy Policy: https://criticalopsgame.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://criticalopsgame.com/terms/
Critical Force website: https://criticalforce.fi/
Developed by Critical Force — dedicated to building meaningful mobile multiplayer gaming experiences.

bluejetty:00145538:ios.description:
Viva o Sodexo Direct
Aqui no app você aproveita toda a experiência digital de relacionamento com os restaurantes corporativos e cafeterias da Sodexo Onsite. O Sodexo Direct é o app relacional que te possibilita inúmeras comodidades na sua jornada de alimentação com a Sodexo.
Sua experiência agora é 24/7, conte com toda a facilidade de acesso ao site Sodexo via Direct.
Nosso objetivo é ser o seu canal de relacionamento com a Sodexo, independente do modelo de serviço de alimentação que você tenha disponível.
Com o Sodexo Direct você pode:
Consultar Informações do restaurante local
Quer consultar o cardápio do dia ou quer estar antenado nas novidades especiais? Aqui é o local certo para obter as informações diárias de tudo que acontece no restaurante ou cafeteria Sodexo.
Saudabilidade
A Sodexo é líder mundial em serviços de qualidade de vida e por isso o tema de saúde alimentar é muito importante para nós. Mais Saúde na sua via é o que queremos e temos uma série de conteúdos e indicadores de saudabilidade disponíveis para que saiba exatamente o que está consumindo ou para se manter informado sobre o tema.
Conveniência
No Direct você pode ter a sua experiência de compra Phygital, ou seja, compre online e retire no caixa ou receba seu produto em um dos pontos de entrega via Direct evitando filas.
Experiência Autônoma
Com o Direct você pode acessar um de nossos pontos de venda de micromercado e realizar todo o seu processo de compra de forma autônoma, segura e sem atrito.
Benefício
No Direct, você pode ter benefícios exclusivos, como descontos em produtos de cafeterias, conteúdos exclusivos e muito mais!
Acessibilidade
Conte conosco para conseguir fazer sua jornada com nosso menu em libras
Agora, se você quer consultar o seu saldo do cartão refeição ou alimentação, não poderemos lhe ajudar por aqui, acesse o app Pluxee Brasil.

bluejetty:00120593:ios.name: Speak for Yourself
bluejetty:00120593:ios.summary: Speak for Yourself is an application designed by two speech language pathologists specializing in Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) with an evidence-based foundation. This application is consistent with motor learning princi
bluejetty:00120593:ios.description:
Speak for Yourself is an application designed by two speech language pathologists specializing in Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) with an evidence-based foundation. This application is consistent with motor learning principles, uses a word-based vocabulary of the most frequently used words in communication, and contains features important in developing automaticity and language. Individuals learn to use their communication device with the same principles they use to play an instrument or type on a keyboard. Speak for Yourself has the capability to begin with one word, but contains almost 11,000 Smarty Symbols® and allows the user the potential to access almost 14,000 words, with no more than two touches to say a word. Complex page navigation and scanning are eliminated to allow fast, consistent access to language! Powered by CereProc's speech system to give our voices character, emotion, and personality. 
With the release of version 2.3, users can choose to include voice options from Acapela Text-To-Speech from Acapela Group through in-app purchasing. 
Regardless of their current language level, this application can meet people where they are and provide language for a lifetime, because it’s a basic human right to Speak for Yourself.

bluejetty:00045354:ios.description:
SENDY is an online marketplace and Gear Hub that lets community members Buy, Sell and Rent Adventure Sports equipment anywhere in North America.
BUY IT.
SENDY makes it safe and easy to find used equipment beyond just your local area.
SELL IT.
No more gear sitting around in garages and closets. SENDY makes it safe and easy to turn gear into cash.
RENT IT.
Find and rent gear from stores and individuals anywhere and anytime with the click of a button.
SENDY is designed to get more people outside, get more people connecting with each other, the natural world, and their own true nature.
SENDY is about a community. A community that helps each other get outside, get in their bodies, and feel the way nature always meant for them to feel.
We don’t just want a happy planet, we want happy people too, and SENDY is the tool we can use to solve both problems. What do you have that someone else might need? Every single piece of gear that finds a new home is one less new product getting pumped out of a factory and shipped around the world. Every single piece of gear that finds a new home helps someone chase their dreams, drop into their bodies and focus on what matters.
The problem is not that we don’t have enough things, it’s that those things are inefficiently distributed. We have the power to change this forever. And by We, I mean You. Every single individual reading these words. If every one of us makes sure that we let nothing go to waste, nothing sit around collecting dust and getting outdated then the problem is solved. Imagine a world in which everyone who wants to thrive in nature has what they need to do so. Imagine the generations of lives that can change if we give families the tools to return to the great outdoors.

Speed and Convenience

- Get regular updates on the status of your transfer

Great exchange rates and low fees starting at $0 means more of your hard-earned money makes it back to the ones you love back home.

bluejetty:00186143:ios.name: Teach Your Monster to Read
bluejetty:00186143:ios.summary: Welcome to Teach Your Monster to Read, the award-winning app that makes learning to read fun and engaging! Our educational phonics and reading games have helped millions of children build essential literacy skills. Create your own monster a
bluejetty:00186143:ios.description:
Welcome to Teach Your Monster to Read, the award-winning app that makes learning to read fun and engaging! Our educational phonics and reading games have helped millions of children build essential literacy skills. Create your own monster and embark on a magical journey through interactive games designed for home and school use. With a safe, trusted, and highly recommended approach, Teach Your Monster to Read offers phonics-based reading games for all levels. Teaching through play is what we do best—download today and start your child’s reading adventure!
TEACH YOUR MONSTER TO READ FEATURES
INTERACTIVE KIDS READING GAMES
• Take your custom-designed monster through educational games that are suitable for ages 3-6. 
• Improve letter sound recognition with reading games
• Explore a world of phonics and educational games that teach your child to read sentences
• Easily track their player’s progress to identify areas where their reader may need extra support
PHONICS & READING GAMES DESIGNED BY EXPERTS
• Designed in collaboration with Roehampton University and leading game designers
• Phonics tools and educational games that complement phases 2-5 of UK Government-approved Letters and Sounds and other major systematic synthetic phonics programmes
• 3 reading games designed for those in preschool, primary school, kindergarten, and first grade
EDUCATIONAL PLAY AT NO ADDITIONAL COST
• Teach Your Monster to Read is available on iPad and iPhone
• Explore phonics and educational games without in-app purchases, hidden costs, or in-game adverts
• Teach Your Monster to Read supports your child through every step of their reading journey
HEAR FROM TEACHERS AND PARENTS WHO USE OUR READING GAMES
"This game is the absolute best quality phonics game I have come across for educational and fun value."
Marie Lewis, Rochdale
“My class have reaped loads of benefits from using the programme and the difference in some of their reading skills has been dramatic."
Maria Andrews, Foundation Phase Teacher
"This is a fabulous game. I'm not kidding when I say that my daughter essentially learned all her letter sounds using First steps, with relatively minimal input from me! Great for parents to practise their letter sounds too."
Eleanor Jones
PART OF THE USBORNE FOUNDATION CHARITY
Teach Your Monster to Read has been created by Teach Monster Games Ltd. which is a subsidiary of The Usborne Foundation. The Usborne Foundation is a charity founded by children’s publisher, Peter Usborne MBE. Harnessing research, design and technology, we create playful media addressing issues from literacy to health.
Teach a monster today when you download our educational app! 
Teach Monster Games Ltd is a subsidiary of The Usborne Foundation, a registered charity in England and Wales, charity number 1121957.

bluejetty:00171384:ios.name: Orthodox Bible
bluejetty:00171384:ios.summary: The Orthodox Bible mobile app for every Orthodox Christian! This app is the perfect resource for those who want to study and explore the Orthodox Christian faith. With the Orthodox Bible app, you can access the full text of the Old and New
bluejetty:00171384:ios.description:
The Orthodox Bible mobile app for every Orthodox Christian! This app is the perfect resource for those who want to study and explore the Orthodox Christian faith. With the Orthodox Bible app, you can access the full text of the Old and New Testament. The app also includes daily readings and a Orthodox Calendar of feasts and fasts, making it easy to stay connected to your faith every day. The Orthodox Bible app is an essential tool for everyone going through their own spiritual journey.
Features: 
 Daily readings
 Daily prayers: morning, meal and evening prayers
 Audio Psalms
The translation of the Old Testament from the Septuagint into English is a process that involves both linguistic expertise and a deep understanding of the historical and cultural context of the original texts. The Septuagint, often abbreviated as LXX, is an ancient Greek translation of the Hebrew Bible, specifically the Old Testament, which holds significant importance in the history of biblical scholarship. 
Use this app to track the dates of other religious holidays in the Orthodox calendar such as Christmas, Epiphany, Theophany, and the Dormition of the Theotokos. These holidays are based on the liturgical Orthodox calendar, which is a cycle of readings and liturgical services that are used in the Orthodox churches. The liturgical Orthodox Calendar follows the same patterns and themes throughout the year, and it is closely tied to the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. Why follow the Orthodox calendar: mindfulness and introspection, humility recognizing one's own smallness in the grand scheme of God's plan and purpose.
 - Build discipline and routine in one's spiritual practice
- Foster a deeper sense of connection to the divine
- Take time to reflect on the sacrifices and teachings of Jesus Christ by observing religious holidays
- Foster a sense of community and shared spiritual practice with other Eastern Orthodox believers.
The Orthodox calendar, also known as the Julian calendar, is the calendar used by many Eastern Orthodox churches around the world to determine the dates of religious holidays and observances. It is based on the Julian calendar, which was introduced by Julius Caesar in 45 BC and is currently 13 days behind the Gregorian calendar. The Orthodox calendar has different dates for Easter and other religious holidays, which are based on the liturgical calendar. It is an important part of the religious tradition and culture of the Eastern Orthodox churches. The Orthodox calendar is currently 13 days behind the Gregorian calendar, which is widely used in the Western world. This difference is due to the fact that the Orthodox churches did not adopt the Gregorian calendar, which was introduced in 1582 by Pope Gregory XIII as a reform of the Julian calendar. The Gregorian calendar has a leap year rule that eliminates the accumulated error of the Julian calendar, so the Orthodox church still use the Julian calendar. The Orthodox calendar follows the same month names as the Julian calendar, which are: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November and December. However, the Orthodox calendar has different dates for Easter, which is the most important religious holiday for Christians. The Orthodox Easter is always celebrated on the Sunday following the first full moon after the vernal equinox. This is different from the Western Easter, which is always celebrated on the Sunday following the first full moon on or after the vernal equinox.

Ganit Prakash-X is an independent Mathematics learning app developed especially for Bengali medium students of Class 10.

With its clean design, detailed solutions, and interactive visuals, Ganit Prakash-X stands out as one of the most complete and trusted Bengali-medium math learning apps for Class 10 students.
________________________________________

• Step-by-step explanations: Build strong concepts with simple, logical solutions.
• Well-labeled diagrams: Clear illustrations for all Geometry chapters.
• Animated construction lessons: Understand drawing and construction procedures visually.
• Practice problems: Includes numerous solved questions inspired by real exam patterns.
• MCQ exercises: Over 500 multiple-choice questions with detailed answers for exam and concept practice.
• Offline support: Learn anytime, anywhere, without constant internet access.
• Complete Bengali interface: Every explanation, term, and instruction is in Bengali for native learners.
________________________________________
💡 Why Students Choose Ganit Prakash-X
• Comprehensive coverage of Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Mensuration, and Statistics
• Designed according to Class 10 learning goals to support school exams and revision
• Combines clarity, accuracy, and visual learning to make mathematics easier
• Developed with a focus on minimizing errors and improving understanding
• Trusted by many students as a go-to app for Bengali medium mathematics learning
________________________________________
📚 Note
Ganit Prakash-X is not affiliated with or endorsed by any education board, school, or government organization.
All materials are independently created to support learners and improve math understanding.

Lifey: Video Forums for Real-Life Advice
Lifey is a video forum app where real people answer real questions — on camera. Browse over 1,400 video forums on college, careers, health, money, dating, parenting and more, with 35,000+ honest answers from people who've actually been there.
What makes a video forum different
A text forum gives you opinions from strangers. A Lifey video forum gives you faces, voices and real experience. Every answer is a short video from someone who lived it — so you can read tone, sincerity and context that text can never carry.
Find the forum for your question
Thousands of video forums, organised by the things people actually search for:
• Colleges, majors, high school and homeschool
• Careers, job hunting, leadership and retirement
• Health conditions, mental health, fitness and weight loss
• Personal finance, budgeting, frugal living and scams
• Dating, marriage, parenting, pregnancy and divorce
• Countries, US cities, travel, and moving
• Faith, service missions and life stories
Anyone can add a video answer. Pick a forum, record a short video, and help the next person facing what you already figured out. It takes a couple of minutes and it stays there for whoever needs it.
Safe, moderated, family-friendly
Every video is reviewed before it appears. No explicit content, no profanity, no cyber bullying— just people helping people.
Why people use Lifey
• 1,400+ video forums across education, careers, health, money and relationships
• 35,000+ video answers from real people
• Moderated and family-friendly — safe to hand to a teenager
• Free to browse, free to contribute
"If you feel you have wisdom to share with someone out there, this is a wholesome place to do that." — Emily G.
"As a Dad of teens this is gold to me — an app with content I can trust through and through." — Jason H.
Download Lifey and find the video forum for whatever you're facing.

bluejetty:00035443:ios.description:
The GoZone app makes it easier than ever to move around Denton County, TX! With a few taps in the app, book a ride and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the affordability and efficiency of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are priced comparable to public transportation, and you can add people to your bookings for even less. GoZone offers one of the most affordable rideshare options in the nation!
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
How does GoZone work?
GoZone is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the app, input your location and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making public transportation easier than ever before!
How long will I wait?
- You’ll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking.
- You can also track your vehicle in real-time using the app.
Questions? Reach out at gozone@dcta.net.
Loving your experience so far? Give us 5-star rating with your feedback!

bluejetty:00027951:ios.description:
Welcome to Hotel Rush: Merge Story, the ultimate merge game where your inner business tycoon meets heartwarming adventure! In this tycoon game, you’ll step into the world of hospitality—take over a charming inn or mansion, rebuild, renovatae, and restore it to glory. Whether you’re a fan of decor games, design games, or puzzle games, this free hotel game delivers a perfect blend of home design games, merge adventure, and idle hotel gameplay.
Begin Your Hotel Journey – Hotel Rush: Merge Story
You inherit a dusty old hotel, inn, or manor full of hidden treasures and family secrets. With your merge skills, you combine everyday objects—can merging an heirloom and a broken lamp unlock a hidden estate secret?
How to Play – Merge, Decorate & Manage
• Merge game mania: match and merge objects—broken tools, heirlooms, décor pieces—to create upgraded items and unlock new floors. Enjoy the merging games flow, whether online or merge games offline.
• Decorating as you go: use your new tools to design the lobby, rooms, and gardens. From interior design touches to sweeping mansion makeover scenes, your creativity shines in home décor, house design, and family home games style.
• Adventure meets business: act like a hotel manager or business tycoon—hire staff, manage services, clean rooms, upgrade facilities, and expand your venture.
Why You’ll Love This Free Hotel Game
Easy merge mechanics make this 3d merge and merge story experience accessible and addictive.
Design freedom: unleash your sense of style through designing games elements—decorate each room just how you envision.
Casual yet deep: perfect as a family game, whether you're tackling quick merges or immersing in full merge adventure sessions.
No Wi-Fi needed: enjoy it as a no wifi game, merging and designing on the go, offline.
Key Features
— Dynamic gameplay: turn everyday items into powerful tools with every merge game step.
— Engage in decor games fun by designing hotel interiors, exterior façades, and grand manor spaces.
— Blend adventure and storytelling as you help Ted uncover hidden family heirlooms and legacy.
— Manage your hotel empire with hotel manager mechanics—staff, upgrades, and customer satisfaction.
Solve engaging puzzles to restore rooms, renovate the estate, and solve puzzles that reveal new secrets.
Join the world of Hotel Rush: Merge Story
Whether you're a fan of merge games, design games, house games, or tycoon games, this merge design masterpiece combines all your favorite themes into one relaxing yet deeply rewarding home design games experience. So start your merge adventure, become a savvy business tycoon, and show off your design and merge skills. Welcome to your dream hotel game, where happy merge home stories come alive.

bluejetty:00184172:ios.description:
Get instant and secure access to your accounts, deposit cheques, pay your bills and transfer money with Consolidated Credit Union mobile banking app. View your account balances onscreen without even having to log in, convenient for when you’re standing in the checkout line.
Everyday banking in the palm of your hand, no matter where you are.
FEATURES INCLUDE
QUICKVIEW
ACCOUNT DETAILS
BILL PAYMENTS
REMOTE DEPOSIT*
SCHEDULED TRANSACTIONS
TRANSFERS
INTERAC® e-Transfer
MESSAGES
ATM LOCATOR
FINANCIAL CALCULATORS
ACCESS
You log in to the app with the same membership details as online banking and once you log out or close the app, your secure session will end. Learn more about how we keep your information secure.
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have logged in to online banking. If you are not an online banking member, you can still use the Branch/ATM locator, Rates and our Contact Us information.
SECURITY
Bank securely and with confidence. Our mobile banking app uses the same high level of security as our online banking. For information on security, please see our security section on our website.
PRIVACY
Your privacy is important to us. We never use your information for any other purpose other than delivering financial services to you. For information on our Privacy Policies, and how we keep your information safe, please see our privacy section on our website.
LEGAL
If you install the Consolidated Credit Union app, then you must review and are subject to the terms and conditions found on our website, and the Membership Terms and Conditions that you would have received when your account was opened. If you would like to obtain an updated copy of the Membership Terms and Conditions, please contact us.
By downloading the credit union mobile banking application, you consent to the installation of this app, its future updates and upgrades. You can withdraw you consent at any time by deleting the app.
FEES
There is no charge for the app but mobile data downloading and internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
*The Deposit Anywhere feature uses the camera function on the mobile device
INTERAC® e-Transfer is a trademark of Interac Inc. used under licence by Consolidated Credit Union Deposit Anywhere™ is a registered trademark of Central 1 Credit Union used under licence by Consolidated Credit Union

bluejetty:00115717:ios.description:
Join thousands of users taking back control of their habits with BEATR, an app built to help you strengthen discipline, improve focus, and stay consistent. Whether you want to reduce distractions, strengthen self-control, or create a healthier daily routine, BEATR gives you the tools to stay consistent.
Our system helps you reshape everyday patterns, build better routines, and develop lasting discipline. With a structured 90-day program, daily checklists, and real-time progress tracking, you can follow your own consistency over time.
WHY USERS CHOOSE BEATR
BUILD DISCIPLINE
BEATR's step-by-step system turns intent into a daily practice. Personalized strategies and an AI-powered coach help you stay consistent through challenges and setbacks.
STAY CONSISTENT
Daily exercises, check-ins, and practical challenges keep you focused. Replace unproductive routines with intentional actions and build momentum every day.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Monitor streaks, mood, and consistency with real-time tracking. Set goals, unlock achievements, and follow your progress across focus, discipline, and well-being.
VISUALIZE YOUR GROWTH
Every positive action contributes to your personal progress. Watch your consistency build over time as you stay committed to your goals.
LEVEL UP YOUR STATS
Turn daily effort into visible progress. Complete check-ins, challenges, and milestones to level up key areas like focus, discipline, and well-being.
SUPPORT SYSTEM
Stay accountable and connected. Build consistency through structured guidance and a system designed to keep you on track.
POWERFUL TOOLS
Access AI-powered guidance, focus tools, and structured self-improvement systems designed to help you stay in control.
BUILD A STRONGER FUTURE
Improve focus, build confidence, and create a more disciplined lifestyle. Start today and keep working at it.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Unlock unlimited access to all premium features with a BEATR subscription, including AI guidance, daily check-ins, advanced tracking, and exclusive content.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchase of a subscription.
BEATR is a self-improvement tool and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a qualified professional for any health-related concerns.

bluejetty:00124228:ios.name: Snow Town - Ice Village World
bluejetty:00124228:ios.summary: City building game “Snow Town” is the ultimate challenge for ambitious mayors and creative city designers. Despite your age, indulge yourself in all aspects associated with the job and life of a city manager. Organise employees for the comp
bluejetty:00124228:ios.description:
City building game “Snow Town” is the ultimate challenge for ambitious mayors and creative city designers. Despite your age, indulge yourself in all aspects associated with the job and life of a city manager. Organise employees for the companies in your city by taking good care of housing facilities, and make sure your citizens are happy by providing the best community services and education possible. Don’t forget to include a fire station and police station, but also the best library that money can buy. A proper balance is the essence for growth, but growing a beautiful city is just as attractive for your citizens as it is for you - as the designer of it all. A dazzling big city or even metropolis is the ultimate reward for you to show off with! Enjoy this game from age 4 to 80!
Your city in the snowy world of Snow Town is despite the strong cold wind and the icy temperatures anything but a boring or unattractive place, or an ice village. Your citizens are happy to show themselves and let themselves be heard. Happy citizens go hand in hand with growth and prosperity, and all their happiness and joy is the reward for you--their mayor--for all your hard work and clever planning in this prosperous city.. But then, it doesn’t come for free. First you need to get your hands dirty and the job done! Tap and build away!
In Snow Town there is a huge collection of buildings and decorations that you can build. Your own imagination is the limit of what you can achieve, and you will continue to push your boundaries during play. Use the multitude of game options to build your dream village in your own pace, and don’t forget to enhance it with an efficient road network and some slippery footpaths.
It doesn’t matter what type of player you are or what your age is. Maybe you prefer to play several short sessions a day, or maybe you are the kind of mayor that likes to get your teeth into the challenge and play for hours in a row? Snow Town offers enough variety and options to play the way you like it, when you like it. Fast or slow, short or long, relaxed or fanatical, it’s all there for you to enjoy!
Is your Snow Town city going to be your personal masterpiece? Nothing will be in your way once you start building in this game brought to you by the true masters of the genre. Tens of millions of players have preceded you in the mobile city building games by Sparkling Society, the absolute number 1 of the world!
- Choose from over 100 different buildings, parks and decorations.
- Age independent 
- A fun and rewarding challenge to balance citizens, work and community facilities.
- Beautiful images, a city in snow was never more visually stunning.
- Many hours of gameplay, free of charge.
- Play it your way, your style, you decide. Flexibility is key.
- Millions of people around the globe play the city building games from Sparkling Society.

bluejetty:00177722:ios.summary: SoundNote offers AI-powered transcription features that easily generate meeting minutes, class notes, interview summaries, and paragraph summaries. It allows you to quickly capture important information, save time, and enhance work efficien
bluejetty:00177722:ios.description:
SoundNote offers AI-powered transcription features that easily generate meeting minutes, class notes, interview summaries, and paragraph summaries. It allows you to quickly capture important information, save time, and enhance work efficiency. The AI-driven transcription and summarization features significantly reduce work time and provide a smarter, more productive work environment.
Supporting MP3, WAV, and M4A formats, SoundNote is a high-quality voice recorder with speech-to-text conversion and AI noise reduction capabilities. It's the perfect solution for anyone needing to manage voice memos, including business professionals, reporters, tutors, audio experts, sound engineers, and students.
With excellent playback control and audio editing features, SoundNote makes it easy to edit and modify recorded files for greater efficiency.
It supports Apple Watch and is available on both iPhone and iPad.
■ Main Features
· AI-powered meeting minutes, lecture notes, interview summaries, and general summarization
· AI noise reduction
· Speech-to-text transcription
· Live Activities (Dynamic Island), Now Playing
· Direct recording in MP3, WAV, and M4A formats
· High-quality audio recording
· Unlimited recording time
· Background recording
· Wave display for recording status
· Various audio quality options (11,025KHz, 22,050KHz, 44,100KHz, 48,000KHz)
· Mono/stereo recording
· Playable on various media
· Resume recording after phone call pause (up to 3 minutes)
· Add descriptions to recordings
· Easy and fast to use
· Display file size
· Safe stop for low battery or storage space
· Bluetooth support
· Music library import function
· File sorting
· Voice-to-text transcription
■ AI-powered
· Meeting minutes, lecture notes, interview summaries, and general summarization
· Noise reduction
· Speech-to-text transcription
■ Powerful File Sharing & Management
· Transfer files via iTunes, Email, AirDrop, or Wi-Fi
· File sharing with other apps (“Open in”)
■ Folder Management
· Create, edit, delete, and organize folders efficiently
■ Playback Control
· Repeat, slow, or fast play; adjust playback speed (0.1x ~ Play)
■ Trim & Cut Audio
· Trim and cut recordings as needed (MP3, WAV, M4A formats)
■ Audio Visualization
· Visualize recordings to identify sections easily
■ Sound Tags
· Add tags to specific locations for instant playback
■ File Combination
· Combine multiple audio files into one, creating a custom sequence
■ PREMIUM Subscription
· Payment will be charged to your Apple ID upon confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal charges occur within 24 hours of the period's end. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your App Store account settings.
Subscription Options:
· Monthly Subscription: Auto-renew with 3-day free trial, unlocks all features / AD-Free
· Yearly Subscription: Auto-renew with 3-day free trial, unlocks all features / AD-Free

bluejetty:00187274:ios.description:

The result is an increase in productivity and customer satisfaction rates. Everyday, tens of millions of users in over 150 countries and in organizations such as Deutsche Bahn, The US Navy and Credit Suisse trust Rocket.Chat to keep their communications completely private and secure.
By opting for Rocket.Chat, users also benefit from free audio and video conferencing, guest access, screen and file sharing, LiveChat, LDAP Group Sync, two-factor authentication (2FA), E2E encryption, SSO, dozens of OAuth providers and unlimited users, guests, channels, messages, searches and files. Users can set up Rocket.Chat on cloud or by hosting their own servers on-premises.
With thousands of contributors and stars on Github, Rocket.Chat has the world’s largest community of chat developers in the open source communication sector.
When you choose Rocket.Chat, you join an ever-growing passionate community that constantly improves our platform with us :)

* Media Embeds

* Remote Locations Video Monitoring
* Native Cross-Platform Desktop Application

bluejetty:00153465:ios.name: Model Face AI
bluejetty:00153465:ios.summary:
This is your glow up era. Model Face AI gives you every tool you need to unlock your best look — all in one app.
From jawline and symmetry analysis to AI hairstyle try-ons and face shape breakdowns, Model Face AI is the most complete glow
bluejetty:00153465:ios.description:
This is your glow up era. Model Face AI gives you every tool you need to unlock your best look — all in one app.
From jawline and symmetry analysis to AI hairstyle try-ons and face shape breakdowns, Model Face AI is the most complete glow up experience available. Just snap or upload a photo, and the app gets to work — analyzing your features, showing your model version, and guiding you with personalized tips to help you look your absolute best.
Everything you need to glow up — in one place
Model Face AI isn’t just about how you look now — it’s about showing what’s possible and helping you get there. Whether you’re curious about your facial symmetry, wondering which haircut suits you, or trying to understand your unique traits like face shape, undertone, or eye type, this app has you covered.
Try on your dream hairstyles
No more guessing. Instantly try 20+ hairstyles, built with powerful AI models for realistic, face-fitting results. Whether you’re going for bold, clean, trendy, or classic, you’ll see how each cut actually looks on you — not on a model or a filtered overlay. Choose with confidence before you ever step into the salon.
See your model version
We all have a version of ourselves at our peak potential. Model Face AI shows you what that looks like — using ideal lighting, angles, and subtle structure tweaks to reflect your best features. It’s an inspiring, motivating way to start your glow up journey.
Get deep symmetry and jawline analysis
The app carefully maps your facial structure — measuring how balanced your features are, whether your vertical thirds are even, and how strong your jawline looks from the front and side. It even reveals which side of your face is more photogenic. Small changes make a big difference, and now you’ll know exactly where to focus.
Understand your side profile
Don’t forget your profile. We’ll help you break down how your nose, chin, and jawline flow together from the side — and give you clear tips on what enhances your look from every angle.
Discover what makes your face unique
Model Face AI tells you exactly what face shape you have (oval, round, square, heart, diamond, or oblong), what kind of eye shape you’re working with (almond, hooded, monolid, etc.), your eyebrow type, and even your undertone (warm, cool, neutral). These details unlock smarter choices for haircuts, makeup, accessories, beard styles, and more — all matched to you.
Track your glow up over time
Model Face AI doesn’t stop after one scan. You can come back anytime, compare your progress, and keep leveling up your look. Whether you’re just starting out or already in transformation mode, this app gives you the tools to keep going.
Some features require a subscription. You’ll find full pricing details inside the app.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/modelfaceai-pp
Support: https://sites.google.com/view/modelfaceai-help

bluejetty:00157415:ios.description:
Thousands of people—competitors & spectators—use Rodeo Results to register horses, find/enter events, view results, and track the careers of both themselves and their horses.
There are 4 levers that drive Western sports:
- Registries
- Databases
- Events
- Media
The legacy industry puts each level in different/separate places. Rodeo Results combines them on one platform.
This allows us to deliver better service, instantly, anywhere, anytime. It puts the control into your hands.
Said differently, Rodeo Results gives you full autonomy and power. The catch is that producers must use our software.
Key Features:
- Register & Paper Your Horse
- Sell & Transfer Horses
- Retire Horses
- Search & Browse Events
- Enter Events
- Message Event Organizer Directly On The App
- Link Accounts to Manage Family Members
- View Event Info.
- View Draws, Live & Final Results
- Notifications:
-- When a Rider/Trainer Enters Your Horse
-- When Draws are Posted
-- When Classes Start
-- Notifications of Your Time/Score
-- Notifications When Results are Posted
- Automatic Career Stat Tracking for Competitors
- Automatic Career Stat Tracking for Horses
- Sire & Dam Tracking
- Track Other Competitors
- Track Specific Horses
- Notifications of Competitors’ Performances
- Notifications of Horse Performances
- Spectate Mode For Enthusiasts
Whether you’re looking to stay on top of your results, follow competitors, or track stats for yourself and your horses, Rodeo Results makes it simple. 
Together, we’ll reimagine Western Sports with software as its foundation and forge Western heritage for the digital age. 
Download the app for a breath of fresh air!

The image
bluejetty:00016863:ios.description:
Have you ever wanted to take a photo in low light conditions?
Due to complex mathematical algorithms Night Eyes provides residual light amplification in real-time for your iPhone, iPad and iPod touch without additional hardware.
The image is illuminated in real-time (without delay). You can also switch the light amplification mode to exposure mode for better quality. With an exposure time of up to one second you will be able to view the smallest details. It's ideal for twilight situations.
The luminance histogram shows you the brightness level in real-time.
Zoom in inconspicuously using the 10x digital Live Zoom - and shoot your photos.
You've naturally got many different color filters to choose from.
The most important functions are:
- Three amplification modes
- Up to 1 second * exposure time
- Residual light amplification
- True low light enhancement
- Real-time luminance histogram
- Volume Up (+) Photo Capture
- 10x digital live zoom
- Tap to focus
- Color filters: green, red, blue, b/w, sepia, etc.
- Take HD photos
- Landscape and portrait modes
- Supports the front & back cameras
- Supports LED lights
- Supports EXIF-data
*) only on supported devices
A good camera and a powerful processor are required, to get the maximum picture quality.
All the screenshots listed were taken with an iPhone and iPad and are genuine!
Please note that this app does not provide true night vision functionality. The iPhone, iPad and iPod touch have no infrared amplifier, as a result no pictures can be taken in total darkness; a minimal level of light is still required, which can be ascertained by the camera's sensors. The preview will also be delayed in exposure mode. In addition the camera must be held stable for exposure time.

bluejetty:00126627:ios.description:
Measuring area and distance on the map, made easy with this app.
## Usage ##
Press "+" button or press and hold screen to drop a pin.
- App will determine distance between points when pins are placed on the map.
- After placing three or more pin, area inside those pins will be calculated. You can make changes by dragging existing pin around or delete it in 'Edit' menu.
- To get the best result. Please drop the first one on the centre of the area. Then drop the others around in clockwise.
Press "Clear" to clear all pins and lines.
Press "Locate" to move the map to your current location.
Press "Edit" to Save/Load results for future use.
Note 1: Distance between points are calculated base on earth curvature. Straight lines are just for visual aids only.
## Subscriptions ##
"Area & Distance - Map Measure" is completely free to use with all features. You can subscribe to this application to remove ads.
Device subscriptions are available in these plan and will renew automatically each month, six months or year, unless cancelled.
(Per month) - $1.99
(Per six-months) - $9.99
(Per year) - $17.99
Pricing shown is for the United States store. Pricing in other stores will vary.
Payment for subscriptions will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by going to your Apple Account Settings after purchase or by clicking the “Purchase / Manage Subscription. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Subscription cannot be cancelled during the active subscription period
More information: https://mapnitude.com/distance
Privacy policy: https://mapnitude.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://mapnitude.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00127714:ios.name: Tangelo - Get Food Prescribed!
bluejetty:00127714:ios.summary:
Tangelo makes it easy to access affordable food prescriptions tailored to improve your health. As soon as you’re approved, we activate your food prescription and you can choose from healthy foods prescribed just for you!
GET PRESCRIBED HEA
bluejetty:00127714:ios.description:
Tangelo makes it easy to access affordable food prescriptions tailored to improve your health. As soon as you’re approved, we activate your food prescription and you can choose from healthy foods prescribed just for you!
GET PRESCRIBED HEALTHY FOOD
Our prescription process is simple and only takes a few minutes! Answer a few questions about how you eat today, and we measure the nutrient gaps in your diet that impact your health conditions. Then we write a food prescription for the foods you should be eating less of and more of to improve your health!
GET PRESCRIBED FOOD PAID FOR
We work with your health plan to get the cost of your personalized food prescription covered! More and more health plans across the country are covering the cost of prescribed healthy foods for their members. If your health plan doesn’t offer coverage, we offer a self-pay option using a nutrition incentive! And we accept SNAP-EBT!
GET PRESCRIBED FOOD DELIVERED
Once we confirm your coverage, your prescribed food is delivered directly to your doorstep! Every dish you receive is approved for your chronic health conditions by clinical nutrition experts, and we work with you to learn what dishes you like and don’t like to constantly improve the meals you can choose from each week!
MEASURE PROGRESS AND GET REPRESCRIBED
As you enjoy your prescribed foods week-after-week, we’ll check-in to measure your progress and understand how your diet quality is improving. As you keep going, you’ll get represcribed and we’ll help extend your coverage and connect you with additional benefits.

bluejetty:00129732:ios.name: Eterspire MMO
bluejetty:00129732:ios.summary:
Eterspire is the best indie mobile MMORPG. With no auto-play, PC crossplay, truly free-to-play progression, and full controller support, it delivers a real MMO experience you can play anywhere.
Explore a vast fantasy world full of charming
bluejetty:00129732:ios.description:
Eterspire is the best indie mobile MMORPG. With no auto-play, PC crossplay, truly free-to-play progression, and full controller support, it delivers a real MMO experience you can play anywhere.
Explore a vast fantasy world full of charming characters, team up with friends for co-op battles, and level up through real grinding. Join one of the friendliest communities in any MMO and discover new content updates every two weeks!
GRIND FOR GEAR
Level up by defeating monsters, completing quests, and collecting loot. There are no paid top-tier weapons or shortcuts. Your strength comes only from dedication, strategy, and skill. It’s the MMORPG you earn.
MASTER PVE TRIALS WITH FRIENDS
Form parties of up to 4 players to face Trials: wave-based PvE challenges filled with rare loot, EXP, and powerful boss encounters. Coordinate with your party, conquer Aetera’s toughest challenges, and claim your rewards.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR ADVENTURER
Choose your class and define your style. Use crafting to turn gear into cosmetics, so you can wear your favorite armor and weapons without losing stats. Create a unique look no matter how you fight.
CHALLENGE REMNANTS FOR EPIC DROPS
Battle Remnants, massive endgame monsters that drop EX gear, rare familiars, and valuable cosmetics. With strategy and teamwork, you could score legendary loot or a major power boost.
PLAY ANYWHERE WITH CROSSPLAY
Whether on PC, Mac, or Mobile, your progression is always with you. Eterspire supports full crossplay and controller support, offering one of the best MMORPG experiences across platforms.
JOIN A TRUE MMORPG COMMUNITY
Eterspire is more than just an RPG, it’s a living, growing fantasy world. Chat, trade, join guilds, and explore with adventurers across the globe. Take part in community contests, in-game events, and Discord Q&As with the devs.
DISCOVER THE WORLD OF AETERA
From lush valleys and deep forests to ancient ruins and frozen tundras, Aetera is packed with dungeons, secrets, and unforgettable characters. Shape your own legend as you explore this vast MMO world.
NEW CONTENT EVERY 2 WEEKS
With biweekly updates, new features, and regular events, Eterspire evolves alongside its community. Every patch brings fresh adventures, challenges, and rewards.

bluejetty:00087470:ios.summary: The first Ethereum-themed match-2 game to hit the crypto-verse and the app store is here! Ethereum Blast puts an intergalactic sci-fi spin on the classic blast-2 puzzle game. Each level puts you in the midst of a puzzle-solving mission of e
bluejetty:00087470:ios.description:
The first Ethereum-themed match-2 game to hit the crypto-verse and the app store is here! Ethereum Blast puts an intergalactic sci-fi spin on the classic blast-2 puzzle game. Each level puts you in the midst of a puzzle-solving mission of epic proportions. Your mission is simple: blast your way through hundreds of levels by completing unique targets at every turn. 
In each space-filled mission, it’s your job to help our “Ethereum space ranger” blast like-colored stones in groups of 2 or more while defeating unique space-themed obstacles. These obstacles include sticky space monsters, ghastly worm holes, evil alien forces and tons more!
