Designed to let you focus on reading, Yomu has no unnecessary prefer
bluejetty:00060776:ios.description:
Yomu is an independent reader for book lovers. Yomu’s design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability and distraction-free reading.
Designed to let you focus on reading, Yomu has no unnecessary preferences. Just open a book and start reading. Yomu’s fluid layout dynamically adjusts all text properties and margins depending on your preferred styles and device, giving you an optimal reading experience.
FORMATS
Yomu supports standard ebooks without digital rights management.
Supported formats:
- EPub (.epub)
- Mobi (.mobi, .prc)
- Kindle (.azw, .azw3, .kf8)
- Comics (.cbz, .cbr)
- PDF (.pdf) 
Choose free books from publishers such as Standard Ebooks or Project Gutenberg. Download ebooks directly from your browser or copy files from other apps. Import files with iCloud Drive, iTunes File Sharing, or from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, OPDS and Calibre.
READER
The reader's design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability.
Choose your favorite theme font (Lato, Georgia, Lexend, OpenDyslexic, ...), reader mode (day, sepia, grey, black, ...), select a preset or custom font size, content layout (page, scroll) and many more options. All settings can be saved as your personal default for each book.
Swipe or tap to go to the next page. You can also use the book's content outline or table of contents to navigate to another chapter.
While reading EPub, Mobi and Kindle books, select text to take notes or highlight favorite sections. Create bookmarks or search inside ebooks to quickly find anything you are looking for.
LIBRARY
Organise your books in an easy to use library.
Manage your library by creating folders or tags to organize your books. Sort your collection either by title, author, series, recently read or drag and drop for a custom order.
You can edit a document's title, author, summary, cover or any other meta data. Save or export your books with all information and annotations in text, markdown or json format.
CLOUD
Yomu's Cloud Library (pro only) stores your books and annotations securely in Apple's iCloud.
Keep all your ebooks safe and at hand on whatever device. Every time you change something on one device, it's synced to all your other devices. Always have the latest version, when you start reading on your iPad and continue on your iPhone on the go.
Please note that you need to be signed in on your device with the same Apple ID on all platforms.
WIDGETS
See your recently read books or highlighted quotes.
Yomu includes widgets to quickly view and open your books and quotes. Add a widget from the gallery and choose a list from the options. Tap on an entry to continue reading where you left off.
YOMU PRO
Yomu is free to use and includes all basic features.
Every ebook format, theme or setting is available and lets you try out the unrestricted reader. However, the free version has some limitations and does not include certain features.
Upgrade to Yomu Pro to get:
- Cloud Library: Store and sync your library with Apple’s iCloud.
- Unlimited Documents: No limit on the number of documents.
- No Advertisement: Free version can display ads.
Yomu is an independent app, your purchase supports the further development.
When you buy an in-app purchase, you are doing so through Apple’s App Store and agree to their terms and conditions. Payments will be charged to the credit card of your Apple account.
SERVICE
Yomu is available for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
In contrast to other apps, Yomu does not collect or sell any personal information. And it keeps your data private.
Terms of Service:
https://www.yomu-reader.com/terms/
Privacy Policy:
https://www.yomu-reader.com/privacy/
Support:
https://www.yomu-reader.com/support/

PLAY WITH FRIENDS ON ANY PLATFORM!

bluejetty:00160822:ios.description:
My Pregnancy Guide is one of the most popular pregnancy calculator and tracker apps. It's your companion throughout your pregnancy journey, God willing, with daily pregnancy tips and weekly information about your baby's growth and your body's changes.
The app is easy to use and requires no sign-up or personal information — just the first day of your last menstrual period, or your expected due date if you already know it and prefer to track with it.
NEW IN THE APP:
• A completely redesigned, modern and easy-to-use interface.
• Now available in both English and Arabic — switch the language anytime from Settings.
• Live Chat: talk with moms and moms-to-be in real time in the community chat room.
• Cycle tracking mode: not pregnant? Track your period, ovulation days, and fertility window.
• Hospital bag checklist: a ready-made list of essentials for mom and baby, with the ability to add your own items.
• Digital tasbeeh (prayer beads) to keep your dhikr anytime.
• Weekly mood tracker: share how you feel this week and see how other expecting moms voted.
• Follow other members, and post or comment anonymously.
APP FEATURES:
• Your baby's heart is beating inside you, growing day by day. Receive fun, heartwarming weekly messages from your baby in a chat-style format.
• Community: post questions, answer others, and connect with expecting moms who share your interests.
• A full pregnancy calculator in your hands: we calculate your pregnancy and the days remaining.
• We tell you your expected due date.
• Pregnancy is calculated the same way your doctor and ultrasound do — the most accurate method, God willing.
• Know exactly which week of pregnancy you're in, and which day of that week.
• We calculate your current pregnancy month and explain how months are counted.
• Pregnancy is divided into three trimesters, with the end date of each one.
• Daily tips with a daily reminder so you can follow your pregnancy day by day.
• Detailed weekly information about your baby's development across all 40 weeks.
• Detailed weekly information about your body's changes across all 40 weeks.
• Weekly ultrasound-style images showing how your baby looks, plus your baby's size this week compared to a fruit or vegetable.
• My Pregnancy Guide works offline, with only the internet-dependent features unavailable.
All medical information in this app is collected from general sources and may not necessarily fit your specific case. Always visit your doctor regularly and follow their advice — they know your health condition best.
You are part of the My Pregnancy Guide community. We'd love to hear from you — tell us what's on your mind!
info@wecareapps.net

facebook.com/pregnancytrackerarabic
Private Facebook group for questions:

bluejetty:00120601:ios.name: Statue of Liberty
bluejetty:00120601:ios.developer: The Statue of Liberty - Ellis Island Foundation Inc.
bluejetty:00120601:ios.summary:
Discover the Statue of Liberty in a new and innovative way. 
The Statue of Liberty is more than a monument. She is a symbol of freedom to millions around the world. This app uses Augmented Reality and immersive storytelling
bluejetty:00120601:ios.description:
Discover the Statue of Liberty in a new and innovative way. 
The Statue of Liberty is more than a monument. She is a symbol of freedom to millions around the world. This app uses Augmented Reality and immersive storytelling to bring the Statue to life anywhere. Now you can experience the iconic monument from wherever you are.
The app features multiple AR experiences that allow you to explore the iconic monument from new perspectives and at new depths. Through the app, users can access the Statue in ways that few have been able to do before. A rich curation of stories and visual media walks you through more than 150 years of the Statue’s history — from her origins in France in 1865 to the opening of the new Statue of Liberty Museum in May 2019. The app also features two immersive audio experiences: An exclusive podcast transports listeners to critical moments in the Statue of Liberty’s history; and an interactive audio tour guides visitors to 35 points of interest as they explore Liberty Island on foot.
Features:
Torch Panorama (AR)
Experience a rare view from the Statue of Liberty’s torch, wherever you are. This AR experience offers breathtaking views of Liberty Island and the expansive New York Harbor. Watch the New York City skyline as the sun rises and falls. No one has seen this view since 1916, when public access to the torch was shut down.
Making of Lady Liberty (AR)
Explore the engineering marvel and global symbolism of the Statue of Liberty by placing her right in front of you. Augmented Reality allows you to interact with the most accurate 3D model of the Statue to date. See how the exposure to the elements over time transformed her original copper luster into the iconic green patina we see today. And look inside the Statue to explore Gustave Eiffel’s trussed iron tower.
Life-Size Model (AR)
Study a life-size 3D model of the Statue of Liberty’s left foot using Augmented Reality. Place the model in front of you, pinch and zoom in to scale, and marvel at its size.
Historical Time-lapse (180° Experience)
Watch Manhattan’s skyline evolve over the past 200 years through a time-lapse video set from the view point of Lady Liberty’s crown.
Historical and Educational Content
Discover exclusive content curated from the National Park Service archives. Read about the Statue of Liberty’s origins and the visionaries and innovators that brought the monument to life. Reflect on how the Statue’s meanings changed in times of war and peace, and as new waves of immigrants sailed by. Go behind the scenes of the Statue’s restoration and the new museum with the Foundation that has been preserving Lady Liberty’s legacy since 1982.
On-Island Audio Tour with Map and Podcast Mini-series
To complement the launch of the new museum, the Statue of Liberty app provides access to an audio tour and guided map when visiting the island. In addition, a newly released podcast, Raising the Torch, is available for all users to listen whether they’re getting ready to visit Liberty Island or exploring from thousands of miles away. This specially produced podcast includes first-person narratives and interviews with historians, who tell the fascinating and winding origin story of the iconic Statue of Liberty.

Through the app, users can access the Statue in ways that few have been able to do before. A rich curation of stories and visual media walks you through more than 150 years of the Statue’s history — from her origins in France in 1865 to the opening of the new Statue of Liberty Museum in May 2019. The app also features two immersive audio experiences: An exclusive podcast transports listeners to critical moments in the Statue of Liberty’s history; and an interactive audio tour guides visitors to 35 points of interest as they explore Liberty Island on foot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
Features:

Torch Panorama (AR)
Experience a rare view from the Statue of Liberty’s torch, wherever you are. This AR experience offers breathtaking views of Liberty Island and the expansive New York Harbor. Watch the New York City skyline as the sun rises and falls. No one has seen this view since 1916, when public access to the torch was shut down.

Making of Lady Liberty (AR)
Explore the engineering marvel and global symbolism of the Statue of Liberty by placing her right in front of you. Augmented Reality allows you to interact with the most accurate 3D model of the Statue to date. See how the exposure to the elements over time transformed her original copper luster into the iconic green patina we see today. And look inside the Statue to explore Gustave Eiffel’s trussed iron tower.

Life-Size Model (AR)
Study a life-size 3D model of the Statue of Liberty’s left foot using Augmented Reality. Place the model in front of you, pinch and zoom in to scale, and marvel at its size.

Historical Time-lapse (180° Experience)
Watch Manhattan’s skyline evolve over the past 200 years through a time-lapse video set from the view point of Lady Liberty’s crown.

Historical and Educational Content
Discover exclusive content curated from the National Park Service archives. Read about the Statue of Liberty’s origins and the visionaries and innovators that brought the monument to life. Reflect on how the Statue’s meanings changed in times of war and peace, and as new waves of immigrants sailed by. Go behind the scenes of the Statue’s restoration and the new museum with the Foundation that has been preserving Lady Liberty’s legacy since 1982.

On-Island Audio Tour with Map and Podcast Mini-series
To complement the launch of the new museum, the Statue of Liberty app provides access to an audio tour and guided map when visiting the island. In addition, a newly released podcast, Raising the Torch, is available for all users to listen whether they’re getting ready to visit Liberty Island or exploring from thousands of miles away. This specially produced podcast includes first-person narratives and interviews with historians, who tell the fascinating and winding origin story of the iconic Statue of Liberty.

bluejetty:00147513:ios.description:
Welcome to La Terminal, your mobile command center for AI coding agents.
Connect to OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, or OpenClaw from anywhere, with full SSH and Mosh support for resilient, always-on sessions.
More than just a simple command-line shell, La Terminal provides a fully-native, first-class touch experience for command-line hackers on iPhone and iPad.
Built on Open Source:
From the original developer of Midnight Commander, the open source visual file manager for Linux, La Terminal provides a comprehensive Xterm/DEC VT terminal emulator experience based on the popular open source SwiftTerm library with powerful client amenities for serious command-line aficionados.
Command Search:
Use Command Search to quickly find the command you are looking for. Search your own command history and our comprehensive workflow gallery to find and execute commands. Create and edit your own workflows for a variety of tasks, including running frequently used commands, automating a series of commands, or just tracking down a complex command that might be difficult to recall.
AI-powered assistant:
Get help writing Linux, Mac, or Windows terminal commands using plain English, such as “extract the name property inside the article element from a json file” or “list the most CPU consuming Kubernetes pods”.
Eye candy:
La Terminal sports a fully themeable experience accented with beautifully captivating live-effect backgrounds powered by Metal Performance Shaders.
Secure Enclave:
Your private keys are stored in the secure enclave so your private key can never be found in plain text.
Powerful status visualizations:
La Terminal’s resource monitoring tools put powerful CPU and memory use visualizations, as well as a native process explorer, right at your fingertips. Resource monitoring visualizations are accessible from the top of any connected terminal, and process explorer tools provide multiple views into CPU, memory, and disk utilization. Thumbnail snapshots show previews of connected hosts along with system load over time in the active Terminals view. Network monitoring plots data traffic on a world map to help you understand the sources and targets of connections to and from your connected hosts.
iCloud for everyone:
La Terminal makes it easy to switch between your iPhone, iPad, and Mac by syncing your settings and keys over iCloud - like magic!
Host platform aware:
Whether you’re managing a dozen Linux VMs on AWS or Azure, logging into zsh on your Mac desktop, or configuring your latest IoT Raspberry Pi project via bash, La Terminal provides the most productive experience possible on a mobile device. La Terminal is even Windows-aware to ensure PowerShell power users can enjoy a delightful ssh experience, too.
International support:
La Terminal delivers extensive support for international terminals, including rendering internationalized output as well as support for internationalized input methods from native iOS dictation and international keyboards.
La Terminal Pro features
- Complete SFTP File Manager
 - Upload, download and navigate remote filesystems with our native SFTP client.
 - Files can be uploaded or downloaded to the local device via the iOS Files app, or copied between remote hosts.
- Files app support
 - Access files on any configured La Terminal host using Apple’s Files app and other File Provider-enabled apps.
- SSH Agent Forwarding
 - Use locally configured keys to authorize connections when SSHing between remote hosts.
- All Live Backgrounds
 - Choose from our full library of GPU-accelerated Live Backgrounds to customize your terminal experience.
Terms of Service: https://la-terminal.net/la-terminal/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://la-terminal.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00018663:ios.description:
Feed those in need, one picture at a time.
Over 40 million Americans currently face hunger, not knowing where they will find their next meal. GiftAMeal allows you to help at no cost.
Simply take a photo on the GiftAMeal app at a participating restaurant to provide a meal to someone in need in your community. Share your picture on social media to give additional meals! Your photo can be of food, drink, a receipt, friends, something cool at the restaurant, or even a selfie.
How does it work? Restaurants pay to be on our app as a mix of marketing and giving back - it’s free for you! Anytime you take a photo at one of our participating restaurants, GiftAMeal makes a donation to a local food bank. These donations go towards distributing nutritious food to neighborhood pantries where those in need can access it.
Over 1 million meals have been gifted to those in need so far. And every meal makes a difference. Bridgett, a single mom who previously relied on a local pantry for support, shared her story with us: “My daughter is 15. The food program really, really helped us. Her grades have gone sky-high. We’re in a good place now - we have a house and food and now we’re going to give back.”
Help someone like Bridgett with GiftAMeal today!
Follow us on social media:
Facebook: @GiftAMeal
Instagram: @GiftAMeal
Twitter: @GiftAMeal
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Learn more at: www.giftameal.com

APLICATIVO DE GESTÃO, COMUNICAÇÃO E SEGURANÇA DE CONDOMÍNIOS.
Nosso objetivo é facilitar a vida de síndicos, porteiros e moradores de condomínios. 
Chega de papel! Tudo que você precisa em um só lugar. Reservas, ocorrências, visitantes, cadastro de moradores, informativos, enquetes, documentos e muito mais.
Tudo isso a dois cliques do seu smartphone. 
Através de um sistema 100% online, é possível enviar aviso aos moradores, marcar assembleias, reservar espaços em comum, realizar enquetes, controlar os acessos na portaria e muito mais.
VEJA TUDO QUE PODE CONTROLAR DO SEU CELULAR
LIVRO DE OCORRÊNCIAS
Seu livro de ocorrência digital e portátil! Registre reclamações, sugestões, acompanhe o tratamento e seja notificado quando a ocorrência for resolvida. 
ENTREGAS E ENCOMENDAS
Gestão completa das entradas e saídas de todas as correspondências. Seja notificado quando a sua encomenda chegar.
AUTORIZAÇÃO DE VISITANTES
Envie um QRCODE para seu convidado. Seja notificado quando eles chegarem. 
CONTROLE FINANCEIRO
Emita boletos, controle a inadimplência, automatize suas cobranças, pagamentos, controle a folha de pagamentos, e-social, emita seus balancetes. 
MANUTENÇÃO
Controle das manutenções periódicas. A administração será avisada que uma manutenção esta próxima.
PRODUTOS E SERVIÇOS
Conheça e avalie serviços fornecidos por outros moradores.
INFORMATIVOS
Baixe o regimento interno e atas. Seja notificado quando um novo aviso for postado pela administração.
VOTAÇÃO DIGITAL
Vote temas importantes sem aglomerações.
INSCRIÇÕES EM ATIVIDADES
Se inscreva nas atividades oferecidas pelo condomínio. Seja notificado quando surgirem novas vagas.
RESERVAS
Consulte a disponibilidade e reserve/cancele sua área de lazer.
PREGÃO ELETRÔNICO
Cadastre fornecedores e faça seus pedidos de compra. Receba os orçamentos e selecione a melhor proposta.
VOTAÇÃO ONLINE
Faça uma pesquisa rápida e liste as assinaturas digitais dos moradores.
FORNEÇA UMA NOVA EXPERIÊNCIA AOS SEUS CONDÔMINOS

bluejetty:00019530:ios.summary:
Great to see you, Commander!
War Robots is the biggest shooter game about giant robots that fits into your pocket. Join epic PvP battles against rivals from all over the world and show them who’s the smartest, fastest, toughest pilot around
bluejetty:00019530:ios.description:
Great to see you, Commander!
War Robots is the biggest shooter game about giant robots that fits into your pocket. Join epic PvP battles against rivals from all over the world and show them who’s the smartest, fastest, toughest pilot around! Prepare for surprise attacks, intricate tactical maneuvers and other tricks up enemies’ sleeves. Destroy! Capture! Upgrade! Become stronger — and prove yourself as the best mech commander in the War Robots online universe!
MAIN FEATURES
- Choose your fighter. Over 50 robots with unique designs and powers let you find a style to call your own.
- Play how you want. Want to crush and destroy? To save and protect? Or just annoy the hell out of your enemies? You can do it all with the massive selection of weapons, including ballistic missiles, plasma cannons, and giant shotguns!
- Customize. Each robot can be fitted with weapons and modules of your choice. Find your favorite combo and show everyone what you’ve got!
- Battle together in multiplayer. Team up with other people! Join a powerful clan to find trusty partners (and friends!), or even start your own!
- Battle on your own. Prefer playing solo? Lone wolves can express themselves in special modes like Arena or Free-for-All!
- Explore the lore. The War Robots world grows and expands with every update, and the ever-growing community is always ready to help you.
Looking for more action?
Check out the latest news on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/warrobots/
…or Twitter: https://twitter.com/WWR_by_Pixonic
Watch War Robots TV on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/WALKINGWARROBOTS
Hop on Reddit for in-depth discussions: https://www.reddit.com/r/walkingwarrobots/
And visit our official website for articles, patch notes and development stories: https://warrobots.com
Note: War Robots requires a stable internet connection for the best gameplay experience.
Good hunting, Commander!
PLEASE NOTE! War Robots is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. In-App purchases may include random items. The application contains ads.

 Learn the most effective and easiest way to w
bluejetty:00180608:ios.description:
Are you ready for a fresh new take on Fitness that delivers results? Well.. then you're in the right place. Turn your device into a portable gym with the Calisthenics Bodyweight Plans today!
 Learn the most effective and easiest way to workout your entire body. Now you can workout at home, in a park, in a gym - anytime, anywhere and track your progress and statistics like never before!
 Whether you’re a beginner or seasoned veteran, this is the only app you will ever need to get into shape!
 Choose from a wide range of pre-made workouts or create your own workout. Know which muscles will be activated and the intensity level of cardio and strength in each workout.
WORKOUT FEATURES
 - Free workouts that you can personalize for yourself
 - 75+ predefined workout routines
 - 150+ different exercises 
 - Create your own unlimited custom workouts
 - 1000+ custom routines
 - Know which muscles you are working on with each workout
 - Save your workouts and use them offline
 - Youtube Links and Descriptions for every exercise
 - Timer
 - Listen to your favorite music during workout
ANALYZE YOUR PROGRESS
 - Detail workout progress through various comparisons, graphs and charts
 - New timer during exercises - you can track everything: total time of workout, performing time etc...
 - Track the exact number of repetitions or time you made for each exercise
 - All the data from workouts and exercises are saved.
 - New calendar: access the saved data through an awesome new calendar // navigate through days of the calendar and see when you worked out and what routines you did and how many exercises you did. Awesome no?
 - Workout progress - see the routines you did and the progress you made on each routines.
 - Beautiful graphics so you can see how you progress on each exercise
 - Exercise progress - see the exercises you did and how many repetitions or time.
 - Access to a lot of general data: how many calories you burned since your first workout, how many calories per workout, how much time you worked out, average time of workout, how many cycles you worked out in total etc...
 - Instructions for hundreds of exercises, sorted by body region, muscle of target, and the equipment needed.
 - Track your weight
 - Body Tracker : you can add your the measurements of your body: Shoulder, Upper Arm, Lower Arm, Calf, Ankle, Neck, Chest, Waist, Hip, Thigh and see the chart of all of them
 - calculate BMI
Any ideas, advices or bugs that I need to crush? Waiting for your e-mails!
***Love our app? Please help us out and take a moment to review us on the App Store!***
We offer 3 different types of subscriptions:
- Subscription length: 1 month
- Free trial: 3 days
- Price for the subscription after free trial: $1.99
- Subscription type: auto-renewable
- Subscription length: 6 months
- Price for the subscription: $9.99
- Subscription length: 12 months
- Price for the subscription: $17.99
- Payment will be charge to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to the user's account settings after purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

- Terms: http://lupu.digitallabs.ro/StreetWorkout/Terms/
- Contact: http://lupu.digitallabs.ro/StreetWorkout/Contact/

bluejetty:00017776:ios.description:
CSB iBank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CSB iBank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Turn your debit card off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CSB iBank Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a CSB iBank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00117033:ios.description:
EPICK is the peer-to-peer way to trade on sports. Buy and sell event contracts on real games — player props, game outcomes, and season-long futures — on a CFTC-regulated exchange.
No house. No bookmaker's line. Buyers and sellers trade directly with one another, so the market — not an operator — sets the price. Think an outcome is more likely than the market says? Take a position. See the price move your way? Trade out before the game is even over.
WHAT YOU CAN TRADE
• Player props — put real conviction behind your read on individual performances
• Game outcomes — take a side and let the market price your edge
• Season-long futures — back your calls on awards, standings, and titles all year
• NFL, NBA, and international soccer at launch — more sports rolling out
WHY EPICK
• Truly peer-to-peer — EPICK never takes the other side of your trade
• Market pricing — the crowd sets the price, not an operator's algorithm
• No limits on winners — we never restrict you for being right
AVAILABILITY
EPICK is available to eligible users in applicable U.S. jurisdictions. Identity (KYC) verification is required.
Think you've got the edge? Download EPICK and take your position.
If you or someone you know has a gambling problem and wants help, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

bluejetty:00150617:ios.description:
ML Calendar 2026 is the app containing multilingual calendar of three languages i.e. English, Punjabi and Hindi, for the year 2026. It is intended to provide users, important dates about Nanakshahi Calendar (as per SGPC) and General dates of festivals, important events, mainly prevalent in Punjab and its neighbouring states of India.
Main Features:
1. Simple to use with a user friendly interface.
2. No requirement of internet for calendar use. Internet is required for listening live kirtan and to access support URL and privacy policy URL
3. Displays full month dates in normal as well as Punjabi months.
4. Has two modes like Nanakshahi and General to display important dates.
5. Easy to change the calendar language into either English or Punjabi or Hindi Language.
6. Audio player to listen live kirtan from Sri Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar.
App user instructions:
For Calendar
As the user installs and runs the app first time, he is prompted to choose the language from English or Punjabi or Hindi. After tapping next button, user navigates to the main calendar page displayed in chosen language. The calendar displays the current month and current date (highlighted in pink colour). The important dates list can be scrolled up/down to view all dates. User can change the mode of calendar into Nanakshahi or General by tapping the buttons provided at bottom of the screen. User can also view the calendar and important dates of any month by using the horizontally scrolling 'Months menu' at the top of calendar. User can change the calendar language at any time by tapping 'Select Language' button and selecting desired language i.e. English, Punjabi or Hindi.
For the purpose of viewing the app's privacy policy, user can tap the 'Info' button at the bottom of main screen. User can use button for 'Privacy Policy'. Please note that internet connection is not required for the functioning of app, however it is required for accessing 'Privacy Policy' URL.
For Live Kirtan
For listening to live kirtan, user phone should be connected to internet. User can play the live kirtan by tapping the yellow button on top left of the screen. As the user taps the play button, a "Wait" label with activity indicator, shall appear on the right side of play button. When the channel is ready, the "Wait" label and activity indicator shall disappear and a green label marked "Playing" shall appear in its place. Also a yellow alert with text "Live Kirtan from Sri Harmandir Sahib", will also appear for short duration.
There may be case sometimes that due to some technical problem at kirtan source, the kirtan may not be available. User can wait till the technical problem is resolved. 
Important: 
If there is disruption in the internet connection while live kirtan is being played, there shall be a screen alert to indicate internet error. In that case, user should close the app, connect to internet and restart the app. Only then live kirtan shall be available.

bluejetty:00068394:ios.description:
MealKeyway: Enjoy the convenience of app ordering with your favorite restaurant in mind. This is a customized online ordering app launched by MenuSifu, dedicated to providing diners with a convenient ordering experience and exclusive discounts.
FEATURES: Effortlessly discover the menu, place orders, and review your order history and receipts. Receive timely notifications to keep up with your favorite restaurants' latest trends and promotions from your favorite restaurants. Choose between delivery and pickup for the service that suits you best.
HOW IT WORKS: To get started, simply scan the MealKeyway app QR code provided by the restaurant. You'll typically find this QR code on restaurant posters, menus, flyers, or banners. It may also be available on the restaurant's website or social media profiles.
NOTES: MealKeyway is not your typical food-ordering marketplace app. We prioritize specific restaurants that have chosen to participate in our rewards program. For the app to work correctly, it is imperative that restaurants partner with MealKeyway. Additionally, users must link their app to the unique QR code provided by the restaurant to ensure proper functionality.
If you have any questions, please contact our customer support team at 212-898-0888 or assist@menusifu.com

Sonic the Hedgehog and his friends are back in an action-packed runner game!
Catch speed fever as you relive the Sonic legend. Run, jump, dash or fly across the road and through exciting platformer levels. Unlock new characters including Tails, Knuckles and more, each with their own unique abilities you can power up. Rush to save Sonic's universe by fighting Dr. Eggman across 4 iconic locations.
All this in a compact download size, so just about anyone can jump-start their day with some high-speed arcade action!
SONIC FEATURES
• Dash through 4 iconic locations with super graphics. WARNING: May cause a rush of excitement. 
• Unlock loads of characters like Tails, Knuckles, Shadow the Hedgehog and more high-speed legends, each with their own super abilities.
• Overcome an endless rush of obstacles and villains, including the nefarious Dr. Eggman himself!
• Listen to iconic tracks as you run for heart-pounding fun!
• Pick up your favorite buddies, each with their own super skill! And remember: Choose them wisely to combine their skills and help you win!
• Power up your favorite characters to improve their abilities.
• An exciting story full of super characters and fun twists.
• Jump into a variety of fun arcade experiences with replayable levels & loads of objectives. Whatever road you dash down, it's guaranteed to have endless enjoyment!
• Discover the mysterious Bonus mode that's a real rush of fun with a dash of speed fever!
• Enjoy skill-based combo gameplay using simple controls, plus an auto-run mode so anyone can jump in on the action!
• You can play the game completely offline after your first session!

bluejetty:00161488:ios.description:
The SWIplus app: your connection to Switzerland
The SWIplus app from Swissinfo provides you with the most important and relevant information and news from Switzerland – all in one place from Swissinfo via SRF, RTS and RSI. 
Your centralised and free access to all information from Switzerland.
The most important news from Switzerland
Everything at a glance – receive the most important and relevant information and news from Switzerland every day, specially curated for Swiss citizens abroad. Immerse yourself in what moves Switzerland, learn more about Switzerland in the world, stay informed and updated about elections and votes, access information on the Swiss Abroad community, emigration and life abroad, as well as access to the Swiss Broadcasting Corporation (SBC) news programmes.
My SWIplus: Your personalised feed
Register and design your news feed by subscribing to your favourite topics and content and selecting your preferred cantons. Select a second language and discover even more articles, videos and podcasts. Mark articles that you like or that you would like to read later.
All in one place
Swiss elections and votes, Switzerland in the world, community, emigration, life abroad – and much more. Discover the topic overview and easily access the content that interests you, with coverage from Swissinfo as well as the Swiss Broadcasting Corporation (SBC) SRF, RTS and RSI.
Download the SWIplus app and stay in touch with Switzerland
Swissinfo – the Swiss voice in the world since 1935 – is the international public online medium of the Swiss Broadcasting Corporation (SBC) for the Swiss abroad and for a global audience interested in Switzerland.
If you have any questions about the app, send us an email at swi.plus@swissinfo.ch

bluejetty:00185127:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate motorsport show your way with the MotoGP™ App!
Download it on any device and enjoy every lap and session, wherever and whenever you want. Unleash the power of this all-inclusive sport tool and never miss a moment of the best show in motorsport!
AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH, FRENCH, GERMAN, ITALIAN, SPANISH, PORTUGUESE, JAPANESE & INDONESIAN.
A spectacular range of features in a single app:
• RACE CENTRE: A MotoGP™ fan essential
Stay connected to the exhilarating world of MotoGP™ anytime, anywhere with the Official App! Enjoy full LIVE coverage of every Grand Prix, Live Timing for each session, and access to the latest news, results, and Championship standings. Don't miss a beat of the excitement—download the Official App now!
• Personalised experience
Configure your account and enjoy your favourite sport as never before with personalised notifications.
Stay in the know about your favorite riders with ease! Keep a close eye on all the news surrounding the riders you support the most. Stay up-to-date with their latest results, standings, and never miss any updates again. With the MotoGP™ Official App, you'll never lose track of your favorite riders. Stay connected and be the first to know!
• Watch every race LIVE & OnDemand (VideoPass subscription)
Full LIVE coverage of every GP in HD 1080p@50, from start to finish. Pause or rewind all the action and resume playback wherever and whenever you want.
Enjoy your favourite sport with more than 45,000 videos including full GP races, interviews, highlights, technical features, summaries, and much more.
Customize your viewing experience by choosing your favorite layout on the MotoGP™ Official App! Watch up to four out of the six available feeds simultaneously, giving you the flexibility to follow multiple angles of the action. Please note that audio commentaries and subtitles on VideoPass are currently provided exclusively in English
• LiveTiming
Follow the action as it unfolds with the extensively updated Live Timing feature, and watch lap times progress as the riders speed through each sector of the track. Split times, sector tracking and exclusive data allows you to see exactly how the riders are performing throughout each lap and chart the riders as their teams and mechanics do. Available to you LIVE!
• CIRCUIT MODE: Enjoy a true fan experience at the circuit
Don't miss any action when trackside! Check out the latest Fan Zone updates and access FREE Live Timing and Tracking on your phones.
To enjoy MotoGP™ like never before, download the Official MotoGP™ App today!

bluejetty:00099356:ios.name: Renovation Day: House Makeover
bluejetty:00099356:ios.summary:
►WHAT A MESS
Your brand new home is a royal mess after a tornado tore through and shredded everything. But luckily for you in this house flipper simulator game, you’ve got a can-do attitude and a hammer, so nothing can stand in your way! G
bluejetty:00099356:ios.description:
►WHAT A MESS
Your brand new home is a royal mess after a tornado tore through and shredded everything. But luckily for you in this house flipper simulator game, you’ve got a can-do attitude and a hammer, so nothing can stand in your way! Get to cleaning up and unpacking everything as you also rebuild, decorate rooms, and make your house a home.
►DECOR? FOR SURE!
● Guide your character through the mess – collect all the materials you can, these will be super useful for making decor and fixing up all the buildings on your property. Go from room to room and clean them up, then give them a great interior makeover, and unpack some nifty furniture to make them feel super cozy. You’ll be able to pick from various decor items to best suit your tastes, meaning this house makeover simulation is sure to please budding designers, creatives, and anyone looking to enjoy some house flipper action with none of the stress!
● Collect to create – while not fully an idle game, there are still a lot of great idle aspects, such as your ability to collect materials and transform them into more useful items that you can use to decorate and makeover your home. Leave no pile of trash unturned in your search for building materials, you never know what you might need next!
● Decorate with decor – earn points to help you advance through levels by choosing from pieces of decor to fill your house. Let your design instincts guide you as you choose from various plants, chairs, paintings, and more to make your interior design really pop.
● Whimsical graphics – if you love architecture and design, you’re sure to love the fun graphics and effects that our developers have included to make this game maximum fun. Renovating a home and picking the best design can be stressful, even in a game, so we made sure to keep things fun and lighthearted so that you can enjoy all the redecorating fun. Plus, there are no timers or other timed tasks, so you can enjoy running around doing as you please.
►AWESOME ARCHITECTURE
Come on in and give Renovation Day a try today for tons of fun and stress-free decorating fun. You’ll be collecting building materials and using these to rebuild and renovate your home. Along the way, pick out sweet decor items and enjoy uncovering all sorts of rooms that need your design touch to make them perfect. With cute graphics this game is perfect for all ages, allowing everyone to have fun gathering items and letting their inner interior designer free, with none of the stress that real home reno brings.
Download it now and go renovate houses!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

apple-itunes:6819981217.name: LL Pair: Developer Mode
apple-itunes:6819981217.description:
Designed for LocationLab users, LL Pair helps you prepare Developer Mode and pair locally on an iPhone running iOS 27 or later. Export the resulting pairing file for use with LocationLab or other tools that support this format. LL Pair itself does not require those apps to be installed.
If Developer Mode is missing from Settings, use the Show It option in LL Pair, then enable it in system Settings, restart, and confirm as iOS instructs. LL Pair cannot turn on the system switch for you.
Once enabled, select the LL Pair pairing host in Settings and enter the code shown by the app. After pairing succeeds, send the file directly to a compatible version of LocationLab or export it to a destination you choose.
Pairing credentials remain on this iPhone unless you explicitly send or export them. Keep the file secure. LL Pair does not provide location or VPN features and does not download a Developer Disk Image.
